Towards Pose-Robust Few-Shot Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

vision-language-action model pose robustness canonicalization world anchoring few-shot fine-tuning

简要说明：WACO 是一种基于世界锚定的规范化框架，利用单帧 RGB-D 和正运动学估计并修正相机与机器人基座位姿变化，使 VLA 操作策略对位姿偏移鲁棒，无需额外数据或测试时校准，在仿真和新基准及真实机器人上均达到最优性能。

TLDR: WACO is a world-anchored canonicalization framework that makes VLA manipulation policies robust to camera and robot-base pose shifts using a single RGB-D frame and forward kinematics, without extra data or test-time calibration, achieving state-of-the-art performance on a new benchmark and real robot tasks.

Abstract: Fine-tuning a vision-language-action (VLA) model on a few dozen demonstrations is the standard way to put a manipulation policy on a robot, yet the resulting policy silently assumes that the camera and the robot base stay exactly where they were during data collection: a bumped tripod or a base re-docked a few centimetres away makes it reach for the wrong place. We show that both failures are one phenomenon, a change of the camera-to-base extrinsic that the policy has memorised, and that the robot carries everything needed to undo it. We introduce WACO, a world-anchored canonicalization framework for VLA models: the arm, placed by forward kinematics at the measured joint angles, serves as a metric calibration target, and the static scene serves as the world anchor that tells a moved camera from a moved robot. From a single RGB-D frame, WACO estimates both shifts without ground-truth extrinsics or extra data, canonicalises the image to the calibration viewpoint and the state, action and start pose to the calibration base frame, and fine-tunes the unmodified policy under the artefacts of its own estimator. We also introduce LIBERO-PoseShift, the first benchmark for RGB VLAs with graded camera, base and compound shifts. Across LIBERO-PoseShift, the LIBERO-Plus camera track and four real-world tasks on a UR5e robot, WACO consistently outperforms the standard few-shot recipe and prior viewpoint-robust methods, raising shifted success by 13.2 points in simulation and by 36.7 points on the real robot, recovering 90% of the simulation gap to a ground-truth oracle and 87% of the real-robot gap, and establishing a new state of the art among methods that use no perturbed training data, with no test-time calibration. Project page: https://peacelwh.github.io/WACO/.

摘要（中文）：在数十条示范数据上对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型进行微调，是让机器人获得操作策略的标准方式，然而由此得到的策略会静默地假设相机与机器人基座在数据采集期间的位置完全保持不变：一旦三脚架被碰歪，或基座重新对接时偏移了几厘米，机器人便会抓向错误的位置。我们表明，这两种失败实为同一种现象——即策略所记忆的相机到基座外参发生了变化——而机器人自身已具备消除该变化所需的一切信息。我们提出WACO，一种面向VLA模型的世界锚定规范化框架：机械臂通过正运动学定位于实测关节角度处，作为度量校准目标；静态场景则充当世界锚点，用于区分相机发生移动还是机器人发生移动。仅凭单帧RGB-D图像，WACO即可在无真值外参或额外数据的情况下估计两种位移，将图像规范化至校准视角，并将状态、动作和起始位姿规范化至校准基座坐标系，进而在自身估计器所产生的伪影条件下对未修改的策略进行微调。我们还提出了LIBERO-PoseShift，这是首个针对RGB VLA模型、包含分级相机位移、基座位移及复合位移的基准测试。在LIBERO-PoseShift、LIBERO-Plus相机轨道以及UR5e机器人上的四项真实世界任务中，WACO一致性地优于标准少样本方案和现有视角鲁棒方法，在仿真环境中将位移场景成功率提升了13.2个百分点，在真实机器人上提升了36.7个百分点，分别恢复了与真值参考方法之间90%的仿真差距和87%的真实机器人差距，并在不使用任何扰动训练数据且无需测试时校准的方法中确立了新的最优水平。项目主页：https://peacelwh.github.io/WACO/。

Authors: Wenhao Li, Zhongyi Han, Yuhao Wei, Liang Han, Yilong Yin, Liqiang Nie

HINT-WAM: Hindsight-Informed Training for World Action Models VLA

world action models self-distillation hindsight flow-matching robot manipulation

简要说明：HINT-WAM提出了一种用于世界动作模型的在线自蒸馏框架，利用演示中的未来视频作为特权信息，在模型自身的采样轨迹上提供密集的动作监督，从而无需环境奖励或模拟器交互即可提升机器人操作的任务执行能力。

TLDR: HINT-WAM introduces an on-policy self-distillation framework for world action models, using hindsight video from demonstrations as privileged information to provide dense action supervision during the model's own sampling trajectories, improving robot manipulation task execution without environmental rewards or simulator interaction.

Abstract: World action models (WAMs) have shown promising generalization and data efficiency in robot manipulation by coupling action generation with predictions of future visual dynamics. Translating these capabilities into reliable task execution, however, remains a challenge for existing post-training methods. Offline supervised fine-tuning provides dense supervision on expert trajectories, but its flow-matching action expert is trained only on noised demonstration actions and never on the intermediate states produced by its own sampler; task-specific adaptation can also compromise pretrained capabilities. On-policy reinforcement learning trains on the policy's own behavior, yet sparse task rewards make exploration and credit assignment difficult, while dense reward shaping still provides scalar evaluations rather than direct action targets. We introduce \textbf{HINT-WAM}, the first on-policy self-distillation framework that supervises the action expert on its own sampling trajectories using hindsight, the future video of the demonstration, as privileged information available to the WAM itself. For each demonstration observation, the student generates its action through its own denoising trajectory, and at the states along this trajectory the same model acts as a teacher conditioned additionally on this hindsight, providing a conditional action distribution as a dense training target, while the student sees only deployment-time inputs and needs no environmental rewards or simulator interaction. To transfer this supervision to a flow-matching action expert, HINT-WAM distills the teacher into the student with an energy score, a distribution-level objective that matches the teacher's action distribution from the student's own samples rather than regressing its velocity field. The project web is available in https://tuandattt.github.io/hintwam/.

摘要（中文）：世界动作模型（WAMs）通过将动作生成与未来视觉动态预测相结合，在机器人操作中展现出了良好的泛化能力和数据效率。然而，将这些能力转化为可靠的任务执行，对于现有的后训练方法而言仍是一项挑战。离线监督微调在专家轨迹上提供了密集监督，但其流匹配动作专家仅在带噪演示动作上训练，从未在其自身采样器产生的中间状态上训练；任务特定的适配也可能损害预训练能力。在线策略强化学习基于策略自身行为进行训练，但稀疏的任务奖励使得探索和信用分配变得困难，而密集奖励塑形仍然提供标量评估而非直接的动作目标。我们提出\textbf{HINT-WAM}，这是首个在线策略自蒸馏框架，利用事后信息——演示的未来视频——作为WAM自身可获得的特权信息，在其自身采样轨迹上监督动作专家。对于每个演示观测，学生模型通过自身的去噪轨迹生成动作，而在该轨迹上的各状态处，同一模型作为教师，额外以该事后信息为条件，提供条件动作分布作为密集训练目标，同时学生模型仅看到部署时输入，不需要环境奖励或模拟器交互。为了将此监督迁移到流匹配动作专家，HINT-WAM通过能量分数将教师蒸馏到学生，这是一种分布级目标，从学生自身样本中匹配教师的动作分布，而非回归其速度场。项目网页可见于https://tuandattt.github.io/hintwam/。

Authors: Phuong Tuan Dat, Qi Li, Xinchao Wang

DRIFT: Detachable Reasoning for Runtime-Flexible and Efficient End-to-End Driving AutonomousDriving

end-to-end driving vision-language models runtime-flexible reasoning lightweight language model surrogate reasoning features

简要说明：DRIFT 提出了一种高效的端到端自动驾驶框架，使用轻量级语言模型（<150M 参数）进行场景描述和动作注释，并通过运行时灵活的规划模块，可在推理时通过替代推理特征绕过语言模型而不会牺牲驾驶性能，在 Bench2Drive、NAVSIM 和 AlpaSim 基准上以较低计算成本取得了强劲结果。

TLDR: DRIFT introduces an efficient end-to-end autonomous driving framework that uses a lightweight language model (<150M parameters) for scene description and action commentary, with a runtime-flexible planning module that can bypass the LM via surrogate reasoning features without sacrificing driving performance, achieving strong results on Bench2Drive, NAVSIM, and AlpaSim benchmarks at low computational cost.

Abstract: The integration of vision-language models (VLMs) into end-to-end (E2E) autonomous driving has demonstrated strong potential by providing scene description and reasoning capabilities. However, VLMs are computationally expensive, and switching language reasoning on and off at runtime without hurting closed-loop performance has not been demonstrated, which hinders practical adoption. To address these issues, we propose DRIFT, an E2E autonomous driving framework that integrates a lightweight language model (LM) for visual question answering and action commentary. By efficiently projecting intermediate driving representations into the language embedding space, we demonstrate that a compact LM (<150M parameters) can achieve strong scene description and action commentary. Furthermore, we introduce a runtime-flexible planning module that is trained on surrogate reasoning features distilled from the LM and can be conditioned on either the LM or the surrogate reasoning features at inference. This design enables bypassing the LM entirely when required by deployment constraints, without sacrificing driving performance. With only 255M parameters, DRIFT reaches up to a Driving Score (DS) of 97.03 and a Success Rate of 89.39% (mean over three runs) on Bench2Drive by interleaving its LM and surrogate reasoning at a chosen reasoning rate. This is on par with the strongest non-language models while being far more compact than existing VLM-based models. DRIFT further achieves competitive results on the real-world NAVSIM and AlpaSim benchmarks at significantly lower computational cost than existing VLM-based approaches. Project page: https://drift-e2e.github.io/

摘要（中文）：将视觉-语言模型（VLMs）集成到端到端（E2E）自动驾驶中，通过提供场景描述和推理能力，已展现出强大的潜力。然而，VLMs计算成本高昂，且在不损害闭环性能的前提下于运行时动态切换语言推理功能尚未得到验证，这阻碍了其实际应用。为解决这些问题，我们提出了DRIFT，一种端到端自动驾驶框架，集成了轻量级语言模型（LM），用于视觉问答和动作评论。通过将中间驾驶表示高效投影到语言嵌入空间，我们证明了一个紧凑的LM（参数量小于1.5亿）即可实现强大的场景描述和动作评论能力。此外，我们引入了一个运行时灵活的规划模块，该模块基于从LM中蒸馏出的替代推理特征进行训练，并可在推理时根据需求选择以LM或替代推理特征作为条件输入。这一设计使得在部署约束要求时能够完全绕过LM，而不牺牲驾驶性能。DRIFT总参数量仅为2.55亿，在Bench2Drive上通过以选定的推理率交替使用LM和替代推理，取得了高达97.03的驾驶评分（DS）和89.39%的成功率（三次运行的平均值）。这一表现与最强的非语言模型相当，同时比现有基于VLM的模型紧凑得多。此外，DRIFT在真实世界的NAVSIM和AlpaSim基准上以显著低于现有基于VLM方法的计算成本取得了具有竞争力的结果。项目页面：https://drift-e2e.github.io/

Authors: Emad Aghajanzadeh, Bethany Anne Wong, Leonhard Kunze, Moritz Thoma, Maximilian Forstenhäusler, Nael Fasfous, Manoj Rohit Vemparala, Pierpaolo Mori, Christos Anagnostopoulos, Daniel Mueller-Gritschneder, Ulf Schlichtmann

Ego2X: Contact-aware Transfer from Egocentric Human Data to Any Robot Manipulation

contact-aware transfer egocentric video robot data generation inverse kinematics vision-language-action model

简要说明：Ego2X 利用以接触为中心的物体交互表示，将单目第一视角人体视频转换为可用于灵巧手和平行夹爪的物理可执行机器人数据，提高了接触实现率和下游 VLA 策略成功率。

TLDR: Ego2X converts monocular egocentric human videos into physically executable robot data for dexterous hands and parallel grippers using a contact-centric object-interaction representation, improving contact realization and downstream VLA policy success rates.

Abstract: Embodied models depend on real interaction data, yet collecting it on physical robots is slow and labor-intensive. Recent ego-to-robot pipelines retarget first-person view human videos to robot data via transferring hand and arm motion. They judge fidelity mainly by visual appearance. However, trajectories often fail in terms of physics: fingers hover beside objects, and grippers close on empty space. We argue that how the object moves and the contacts that drive the motion count. Thus, we present Ego2X, an object-centric framework that converts monocular egocentric video into physically executable robot data across dexterous hands and parallel grippers. Ego2X centers on CORE (Contact-centric Object-interaction REpresentation), which records each contact on the object by its surface anchor, as well as relative force, grasp mode, and interaction state. Throughout the pipeline, CORE corrects hand-object drift via object-relative constraints, steers inverse kinematics toward contacts the robot must realize, and preserves held objects during arm erasure and robot compositing. On HOT3D, contact-driven correction reduces in-contact hand depth error by 33.7%, while on EgoDex, contact-driven retargeting realizes 62.9% of annotated contacts, surpassing the official HuRo pipeline (27.9%). In RoboTwin 2.0, post-training X-VLA on Ego2X episodes alone, without simulator demonstrations, raises task success rate from 40.5% zero-shot to 67.0% across 200 paired scenes. We will publicly release our conversion pipeline and CORE-annotated dataset for dexterous hands and parallel grippers.

摘要（中文）：具身模型依赖于真实的交互数据，然而在物理机器人上采集这些数据既缓慢又耗费人力。近期提出的自我到机器人（ego-to-robot）流水线通过迁移手部和手臂运动，将第一人称视角的人类视频重定向为机器人数据。此类方法主要依据视觉外观来判断保真度。然而，轨迹往往在物理层面存在缺陷：手指悬停在物体旁，夹爪在空无一物的空间中闭合。我们认为，物体的运动方式以及驱动这种运动的接触信息才是关键。为此，我们提出了Ego2X，一个以物体为中心的框架，能够将单目自我中心视频转换为灵巧手和平行夹爪均可物理执行的机器人数据。Ego2X的核心是CORE（以接触为中心的物体交互表示），它通过表面锚点记录物体上的每一次接触，同时记录相对力、抓取模式和交互状态。在整个流水线中，CORE通过物体相对约束修正手—物体漂移，引导逆运动学朝向机器人必须实现的接触点，并在手臂擦除和机器人合成过程中保持被抓取物体的稳定。在HOT3D数据集上，接触驱动的修正将手部接触深度误差降低了33.7%；在EgoDex数据集上，接触驱动的重定向实现了62.9%的标注接触达成率，显著超过官方的HuRo流水线（27.9%）。在RoboTwin 2.0中，仅使用Ego2X生成的数据对X-VLA进行后训练，而不依赖仿真器示范，即可在200对场景中将任务成功率从零样本的40.5%提升至67.0%。我们将公开发布我们的转换流水线以及带有CORE标注的灵巧手和平行夹爪数据集。

Authors: Xinke Lyu, Bowen Yang, Zhicheng Wang

CoRA-VTLA: Contact-Guided Attention and Queryable Response Memory for Tactile Post-Training VLA

tactile post-training contact-guided attention queryable response memory vision-language-action models precision manipulation

简要说明：CoRA-VTLA 通过触觉后训练增强预训练的视觉-语言-动作模型，利用可查询的动作-响应记忆和接触引导的注视监督，提高了仿真和真实机器人任务中的精确操作成功率。

TLDR: CoRA-VTLA enhances pretrained vision-language-action models with tactile post-training, using a queryable action-response memory and contact-guided gaze supervision to improve precision manipulation success in simulation and real-robot tasks.

Abstract: In precision manipulation, small errors in alignment or force can cause jamming or deformation, making contact feedback essential for adapting pretrained vision-language-action (VLA) models to these tasks. A single tactile observation leaves the response to recent actions ambiguous. Direct tactile fusion during post-training can also disperse the action expert's visual attention and reduce the share it allocates to contact regions. To address these challenges, CoRA-VTLA augments pretrained VLAs with lightweight tactile modules. A queryable action-response memory retrieves recent contact responses so that the action expert can combine them with immediate tactile feedback. Contact-guided gaze supervision concentrates the visual attention of the tactile semantic token on image regions corresponding to fingertip contact. CoRA-VTLA achieves 73.33% mean success across three MuJoCo tasks, compared with 50% for direct tactile fusion with the same sensor inputs. It also achieves 67% success on an optical-tactile task from the public UniVTAC benchmark and 66.7% mean success across three real-robot tasks. These results show that tactile post-training helps pretrained VLAs adjust to changing contact.

摘要（中文）：在精细操作中，对准或力上的微小误差可能导致卡阻或变形，因此接触反馈对于使预训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型适应这些任务至关重要。单一的触觉观测无法明确对近期动作的响应。在后训练阶段直接进行触觉融合，也可能分散动作专家的视觉注意力，并降低其分配给接触区域的关注份额。为解决这些挑战，CoRA-VTLA 为预训练 VLA 增加了轻量级触觉模块。一个可查询的动作-响应记忆库检索近期的接触响应，使动作专家能够将其与即时触觉反馈相结合。接触引导的注视监督将触觉语义标记的视觉注意力集中于与指尖接触对应的图像区域。CoRA-VTLA 在三个 MuJoCo 任务上实现了 73.33% 的平均成功率，而使用相同传感器输入的直接触觉融合仅为 50%。在公开的 UniVTAC 基准的光学触觉任务上，其成功率达到 67%，并在三个真实机器人任务上实现了 66.7% 的平均成功率。这些结果表明，触觉后训练有助于预训练 VLA 适应变化的接触状态。

Authors: Chengye Song, Rui Song, Shengqi Wang, Jiawei Zhang, Hongzhou Wang, Xueyang Guo, Yang Liu

3DTouch: A Tactile-aware VLA Model with 3D Geometric Relations for Dexterous Manipulation VLA

tactile sensing dexterous manipulation vision-language-action model 3D geometric relations contact-rich manipulation

简要说明：3DTouch通过整合3D视觉-触觉表示和几何关系，增强视觉-语言-动作模型在灵巧操作中的表现，在真实世界的接触丰富任务中取得了显著改进。

TLDR: 3DTouch enhances vision-language-action models for dexterous manipulation by integrating 3D visuo-tactile representations and geometric relations, achieving significant improvements in real-world contact-rich tasks.

Abstract: In contact-rich dexterous manipulation, occlusion by the fingers and interacting objects obscures local geometry, preventing visual observations from fully capturing contact locations. Visually similar scenes may also differ subtly in the relative positions of interacting objects, leading to different contact states. We propose 3DTouch, a tactile-geometric conditioning approach for vision-language-action (VLA) models. 3DTouch constructs a shared 3D visuo-tactile representation by expressing RGB-D scene points and dense five-finger tactile measurements in the robot-base frame, preserving each taxel's spatial location and force vector. Hand-object and object-object relations derived from hand landmarks and pose-aligned reconstructed surfaces explicitly describe the relative arrangement of interacting entities. Together, these representations condition the VLA action expert on spatially localized contact forces and relative surface geometry, providing explicit cues for contact adjustment and object alignment. We evaluate 3DTouch on five real-world contact-rich dexterous manipulation tasks using a UR7e robot arm equipped with an XHand dexterous hand. 3DTouch improves the average success rate by 42 percentage points over the corresponding VLA baseline and by 20 percentage points over the strongest evaluated alternative. Ablation studies reveal the complementary benefits of scene geometry and spatial tactile feedback, with further gains from shared spatial grounding and explicit geometric relations.

摘要（中文）：在接触丰富的灵巧操作中，手指及交互物体的遮挡会遮蔽局部几何信息，使得视觉观测无法完整捕捉接触位置。视觉上相似的场景，其在交互物体的相对位置方面也可能存在细微差异，从而导致不同的接触状态。我们提出了3DTouch，一种用于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的触觉-几何条件方法。3DTouch通过在机器人基座坐标系中表达RGB-D场景点与密集五指触觉测量，构建共享的三维视觉-触觉表示，从而保留每个触觉单元的（taxel）空间位置与力向量。基于手部关键点和姿态对齐后的重建表面推导出的手-物关系与物-物关系，显式描述了交互实体间的相对排列。这些表示共同为VLA动作专家提供了空间定位接触力与相对表面几何的条件信息，为接触调整和物体对齐提供了明确的线索。我们在配备XHand灵巧手的UR7e机械臂上，对五项真实世界的接触丰富灵巧操作任务进行了3DTouch评估。与对应的VLA基线相比，3DTouch将平均成功率提升了42个百分点，相较于评估中最强的替代方法也提升了20个百分点。消融研究揭示了场景几何与空间触觉反馈的互补优势，而共享空间定位与显式几何关系则带来了进一步的性能提升。

Authors: Xin Zhang, Shiqi Zhang, Siyuan Cao, Juncheng Cai, Yedong Shen, Yuxuan Gao, Dianlong Wen, Kaixue Long, Lu Zhang, Yao Li, Jiajun Deng, Yanyong Zhang

RePlan-VLA: Progress-Aware Replanning for Long-Horizon Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

long-horizon manipulation replanning progress-aware VLA-agnostic execution monitoring

简要说明：RePlan-VLA提出了一种与VLA模型无关的框架，通过监测机器人运动进度并自适应调整未来计划，在不微调底层策略的情况下提升了长时程操作任务的成功率，并在RoboCasa365、CALVIN和真实Franka机器人上得到验证。

TLDR: RePlan-VLA introduces a VLA-agnostic framework that monitors robot motion for progress evaluation and adaptively revises future plans, improving long-horizon manipulation success rates without fine-tuning the underlying policy, demonstrated on RoboCasa365, CALVIN, and a real Franka robot.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a promising paradigm for general-purpose robotic manipulation, yet their performance often degrades on long-horizon tasks that require multiple interdependent manipulations. Instead of burdening the VLA policies with long-horizon reasoning, memory, action generation, progress tracking, and error recovery, we argue for leveraging their short-horizon manipulation capabilities within an execution-aware framework. To this end, we introduce \textnormal{\textbf{RePlan-VLA}}, a VLA-agnostic framework that translates a VLA's short-horizon capabilities into reliable long-horizon execution. RePlan-VLA explicitly monitors the robot's motion for progress evaluation, and adaptively revises the future plan based on observed outcomes. We preserve the underlying VLA policy entirely, requiring no additional fine-tuning. Experiments on RoboCasa365 and CALVIN benchmarks show an improvement of 21.9% and 10.4% in success rate over the next strongest baseline. We also validate our approach for real-world deployment on a Franka Research 3 robot.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-行动（VLA）模型已成为通用机器人操作的一种有前景的范式，然而在需要多次相互依赖操作的长时程任务中，其性能往往会出现退化。我们主张不应让VLA策略承担长时程推理、记忆、动作生成、进度跟踪和错误恢复等繁重任务，而是应在一个具备执行感知能力的框架内，充分利用其短时程操作能力。为此，我们提出了\textnormal{\textbf{RePlan-VLA}}，这是一个与具体VLA模型无关的框架，可将VLA的短时程能力转化为可靠的长时程执行能力。RePlan-VLA显式地监测机器人的运动以评估执行进度，并根据观测到的结果自适应地修订未来计划。我们完全保留底层VLA策略，无需任何额外微调。在RoboCasa365和CALVIN基准上的实验表明，与次强基线相比，成功率分别提升了21.9%和10.4%。我们还在一台Franka Research 3机器人上验证了该方法在真实世界部署中的有效性。

Authors: Apoorva Vashisth, Manav Kulshrestha, Damon Conover, Zachary Kingston, Aniket Bera

CoT-WAM: Collaborative Training of Vision-Language Models and World-Action Models via Plan Latents VLA

vision-language-action model world-action model plan latents robot manipulation long-horizon planning

简要说明：CoT-WAM 提出了一种协作训练框架，通过可学习的计划潜在变量将视觉语言模型与世界动作模型集成，在机器人操作、零样本泛化和长时程规划上取得了最先进性能。

TLDR: CoT-WAM introduces a collaborative training framework that integrates a vision-language model with a world-action model via learnable plan latents, achieving state-of-the-art performance in robot manipulation, zero-shot generalization, and long-horizon planning.

Abstract: General robot manipulation requires both semantic competence and physical foresight. World action models (WAMs) acquire an understanding of and predictive capability over the physical world by jointly modeling visual foresight and action distributions. However, existing WAMs still lack semantic competence: they have limited ability to perform open-world scene understanding, semantic reasoning, and long-horizon planning. Although vision-language models (VLMs) provide these capabilities, effectively integrating their semantic priors into WAM prediction and control remains challenging. To address this challenge, we propose CoT-WAM, a jointly trained WAM-VLM framework. CoT-WAM uses a learnable embedding to exchange information between the VLM and the WAM, which is supervised by textual and goal-image signals during training to encode rich intent information. A tailored two-stage training strategy enables joint optimization and more effective collaboration between the VLM and WAM. We evaluate CoT-WAM on six benchmarks covering control performance, zero-shot generalization, and long-horizon planning. CoT-WAM achieves SOTA performance on LIBERO, CALVIN, and RoboCasa-Kitchen, and demonstrates stronger zero-shot generalization on LIBERO-Plus and LIBERO-Pro without fine-tuning. On RoboCasa365, it further improves long-horizon planning over baselines with and without external planners. Real-world experiments further demonstrate the effectiveness of our method in practical deployments. Code is available at: https://github.com/jhz1192/CoT-WAM.git

摘要（中文）：通用机器人操作既需要语义能力，也需要物理预判能力。世界动作模型（WAMs）通过联合建模视觉预判和动作分布，获得了对物理世界的理解与预测能力。然而，现有WAMs仍缺乏语义能力：它们在开放世界场景理解、语义推理和长时程规划方面能力有限。尽管视觉-语言模型（VLMs）提供了这些能力，但如何有效地将其语义先验融入WAM的预测和控制中仍然是一个挑战。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了CoT-WAM，一个联合训练的WAM-VLM框架。CoT-WAM使用可学习嵌入在VLM和WAM之间交换信息，该嵌入在训练过程中通过文本和目标图像信号进行监督，以编码丰富的意图信息。量身定制的两阶段训练策略实现了VLM与WAM的联合优化和更有效的协作。我们在涵盖控制性能、零样本泛化和长时程规划的六个基准上评估了CoT-WAM。CoT-WAM在LIBERO、CALVIN和RoboCasa-Kitchen上达到了最先进的性能，并在无需微调的情况下在LIBERO-Plus和LIBERO-Pro上展现出更强的零样本泛化能力。在RoboCasa365上，它进一步在有无外部规划器的基线之上提升了长时程规划性能。真实世界实验进一步证明了我们的方法在实际部署中的有效性。代码可在以下网址获取：https://github.com/jhz1192/CoT-WAM.git

Authors: Jinhao Zhang, Yushen Zuo, Ke Rui, Weitao Zhou, Haibao Yu, Honglong Tian, Xiaoheng Ma, Jie Mei, Jiawei Wang, Minglei Li

Improve How You Improve: Recursive Policy Self-Improvement for Zero-Shot Open-Vocabulary Multi-Object Navigation VLN

zero-shot navigation multi-object navigation policy self-improvement open-vocabulary recursive revision

简要说明：RPSI-Nav通过递归改进导航策略及其修正机制，利用诊断视图和有条件继承程序更新与空间记忆，在基准测试和真实机器人上验证了零样本开放词汇多目标导航的有效性。

TLDR: RPSI-Nav recursively improves its own navigation policy and revision mechanism for zero-shot open-vocabulary multi-object navigation, using diagnostic views and conditional inheritance of program updates and spatial memory, validated in benchmarks and real robots.

Abstract: To advance the development of embodied general navigation, zero-shot open-vocabulary multi-object navigation has attracted increasing attention, aiming to enable robots to efficiently search multiple objects in unseen environments without training. For this task, the key lies in improving navigation policies from earlier searches to locate subsequent goals more efficiently. Recent methods automate this process through trajectory reflection and rule revision, enabling policy self-improvement. However, the mechanisms for diagnosing problems and generating revisions are typically designed by humans and remain fixed across iterations. Consequently, the system's capacity for continued self-improvement remains constrained, even as its navigation policy evolves. To this end, we propose RPSI-Nav, a Recursive Policy Self-Improvement framework for zero-shot multi-object navigation that revises both the navigation program and its revision mechanism. RPSI-Nav diagnoses search behavior, requests diagnostic views when existing observations cannot distinguish competing causes, and generates targeted navigation revisions. Feedback from subsequent goal searches is linked to the rules that produced these revisions, guiding changes to diagnosis, observation acquisition, and revision planning. The updated improver governs subsequent navigation improvements, forming a recursive loop in which RPSI-Nav revises its own improvement process. Across goals, the robot conditionally inherits accepted program updates and spatial memory, enabling search experience to improve both future navigation and adaptation. Benchmark experiments and qualitative real-robot evaluations validate RPSI-Nav's effectiveness.

摘要（中文）：为了推动具身通用导航的发展，零样本开放词汇多目标导航任务日益受到关注，其目标是使机器人无需训练即可在未知环境中高效搜索多个目标。对于该任务而言，关键在于通过早期搜索改进导航策略，从而更高效地定位后续目标。近期方法通过轨迹反思与规则修订实现策略的自我改进，然而，问题诊断与修订生成的机制通常由人工设计，并在迭代过程中保持不变。因此，即使导航策略不断演进，系统的持续自我改进能力仍受到限制。为此，我们提出RPSI-Nav，一种面向零样本多目标导航的递归策略自我改进框架，该框架同时修订导航程序及其改进机制。RPSI-Nav能够诊断搜索行为，在现有观测无法区分相互竞争的原因时请求额外的诊断视图，并生成针对性的导航修订。来自后续目标搜索的反馈被关联到生成这些修订的规则上，从而引导诊断、观测获取和修订规划的变化。更新后的改进器随后主导后续的导航改进，形成递归循环，使RPSI-Nav能够对其自身的改进过程进行修订。在多个目标的搜索过程中，机器人有条件地继承已接受的程序更新与空间记忆，使搜索经验既能改善未来导航，也能提升环境适应能力。基准实验与定性实物机器人评估验证了RPSI-Nav的有效性。

Authors: Yang Li, Ziju Han, Aming WU, Zihao Zhang, Sijia Zhang, Yahong Han, Qinghua Hu

RageVLA: Augmentation-Trained Perception and Action for State-of-the-Art Robustness on LIBERO VLA

VLA LIBERO-PRO augmentation frozen features flow-matching diffusion transformer

简要说明：RageVLA 通过增强数据和接地编码（冻结的 DINOv3 特征 + TinyCLIP 嵌入 + 物体列表）解耦 VLA 策略中的感知与动作，在 LIBERO-PRO 和 LIBERO-Object 上取得了最先进的鲁棒性。

TLDR: RageVLA decouples perception from action in VLA policies via augmented data and a grounded encoding (frozen DINOv3 features + TinyCLIP embeddings + object list) to achieve SOTA robustness on LIBERO-PRO and LIBERO-Object.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models look saturated on LIBERO, yet most of them fall apart on LIBERO-PRO as soon as an object moves or the instruction asks for something new. We argue that what is missing is not scale but decoupling. In these policies, what to do is tied to where things were during training, to the scene around them and to the wording of the instruction. We cut these ties in two places. In the data, LIBERO demonstrations are re-arranged by general rules: every object and fixture is moved and rotated, tasks are carried into other environments and onto other surfaces, and every instruction is paraphrased. In the policy, a perception engine on frozen DINOv3 features, trained on this augmented data, hands the action model the scene in decoupled form: a list of objects with their positions, and a compact code of what the gripper is looking at, next to image and instruction embeddings from TinyCLIP. A flow-matching diffusion transformer, trained from scratch, acts on this view. We call this combination of Robust Augmentation and Grounded Encoding RageVLA. With 0.21 billion parameters, RageVLA sets a new state of the art on LIBERO-PRO among VLA policies, scoring 0.72 against 0.53 for the best published model, and a larger variant reaches 0.73. Two further tests on LIBERO-Object show that the policy acts on what it perceives. When the object positions it is given are shuffled while the camera images stay correct, its success falls from 0.965 to 0.215. When the target object is displaced by 28 cm, it still succeeds in 0.865 of the episodes, where $π_{0.5}$, run through the same harness, succeeds in 0.105.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在LIBERO基准上看似已趋饱和，然而一旦物体发生移动或指令提出新要求，其中大多数模型在LIBERO-PRO上便会失效。我们认为，所欠缺的并非规模，而是解耦。 在这些策略中，“做什么”与训练时物体的位置、周围场景以及指令的措辞紧密绑定。我们在两个环节切断这些绑定。在数据层面，LIBERO演示按通用规则重新编排：每个物体和固定装置均被移动和旋转，任务被迁移至其他环境和其他表面，每条指令均被改写。在策略层面，基于冻结的DINOv3特征、并在该增强数据上训练得到的感知引擎，将场景以解耦形式传递给动作模型：一个包含物体及其位置的列表，以及一段描述夹爪所注视目标的紧凑编码，与来自TinyCLIP的图像和指令嵌入并列。一个从零训练的流匹配扩散Transformer基于该视图进行决策。 我们将这种鲁棒增强与接地编码的组合称为RageVLA。凭借2.1亿参数，RageVLA在LIBERO-PRO上创下了VLA策略的新最优成绩，得分为0.72，而此前已发表最佳模型为0.53；更大规模的变体达到0.73。 此外，在LIBERO-Object上的两项进一步测试表明，该策略基于其所感知的信息行事。当提供给它的物体位置被随机打乱而摄像头图像保持正确时，其成功率从0.965降至0.215。当目标物体被移位28厘米时，它仍能在86.5%的回合中成功，而在相同测试条件下运行的\(π_{0.5}\)成功率仅为0.105。

Authors: Amrit Lal Singh, Smarak Kanjilal

BiCAT: Bimanual Coordination Action Tokenization VLA

action tokenization bimanual manipulation vision-language-action models cross-arm attention autoregressive policy

简要说明：BiCAT 提出了一种双手机器人协调动作分词方法，通过共享双臂运动表征并采用对称的跨臂注意力机制，在仿真和真实世界双手操作任务中显著提升了 VLA 策略的成功率。

TLDR: BiCAT proposes a bimanual coordination action tokenization method that shares motion representations across arms while using symmetric cross-arm attention, improving VLA policy success in both simulation and real-world bimanual manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Autoregressive vision-language-action (VLA) models predict discrete action tokens with the next-token objective of their vision-language backbone, so the action tokenizer defines the interface between the policy and the robot. In bimanual manipulation, the two arms share a repertoire of movements yet coordinate through complementary roles, and an action representation should capture both. However, most existing tokenizers encode both arms as a single concatenated action vector, in which motion patterns common to the two arms are not shared and cross-arm dependencies remain entangled within each token. The policy must therefore learn both aspects implicitly. We propose Bimanual Coordination Action Tokenization (BiCAT), which shares one motion representation across arms while conditioning each arm's tokens on its partner through symmetric cross-arm attention and a joint decoder. The policy then predicts all tokens of each arm in parallel, generating the left arm first and the right arm conditioned on it. Across ten RoboTwin 2.0 tasks and six real-world tasks on three embodiments, BiCAT achieves the highest success among the compared tokenizers. In simulation, it improves mean success by 17.6 percentage points over the strongest of eight baselines, with the largest gains on tasks that require close coordination between the arms, while requiring only 40.5 ms per action chunk. These results suggest that the action tokenizer is a natural place to model bimanual coordination.

摘要（中文）：自主回归视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型以其视觉-语言骨干网络的下一词预测目标来预测离散动作词元，因此动作分词器定义了策略与机器人之间的接口。在双臂操作中，两条机械臂共享一套运动模式，却通过互补角色进行协调，而动作表示应同时捕捉这两方面。然而，现有大多数分词器将双臂编码为单一拼接动作向量，其中双臂共有的运动模式未被共享，跨臂依赖关系仍纠缠在各自词元内部。因此，策略必须隐式学习这两个方面。我们提出双臂协调动作分词器（BiCAT），该模型在双臂之间共享一个运动表示，同时通过对称跨臂注意力机制和联合解码器，使每臂的词元以其对侧手臂为条件。随后，策略并行预测每臂的全部词元，先生成左臂词元，再以左臂为条件生成右臂词元。在十个RoboTwin 2.0任务和三种实体上的六个真实世界任务中，BiCAT在所比较的分词器中取得了最高成功率。在仿真中，其平均成功率比八个基线中最强者高出17.6个百分点，在需要双臂紧密协调的任务上提升最为显著，且每个动作块仅需40.5毫秒。这些结果表明，动作分词器是建模双臂协调的自然切入点。

Authors: Xuanwei Liu, Guipu Cao, Zhongyi Luo, Jiafei Duan

ShoWorld: Shape-Faithful Multi-Hypothesis Occupancy World Model WorldModel

occupancy prediction world model motion forecasting shape representation autonomous driving

简要说明：ShoWorld 提出了一种新颖的占用世界模型，通过分离运动和形状表示，预测概率轨迹和亚体素点，以减少运动下的形状失真，并改进自动驾驶场景中动态物体的预测。

TLDR: ShoWorld introduces a novel occupancy world model that separates motion and shape representations, predicting probabilistic trajectories and sub-voxel points to reduce shape distortion under motion and improve forecasting of dynamic objects in autonomous driving scenes.

Abstract: Occupancy world models struggle to forecast moving objects due to motion uncertainty and shape distortion. A single trajectory can average plausible futures into an implausible path, and repeated re-voxelization can erode or inflate object shape even under correct motion. We introduce ShoWorld to address these challenges through separate motion and shape representations. The motion forecaster predicts probabilistic trajectories conditioned on scene layout, nearby agents and the future ego trajectory. Each hypothesis is rendered into occupancy and fused according to its probability to retain alternative futures. The shape component predicts sub-voxel points with occupancy probabilities and offsets from local geometry. These points move rigidly with the object, and voxel occupancy follows the probability that at least one occupied point falls within it. This representation reduces shape distortion under motion. ShoWorld achieves state-of-the-art results on Occ3D-nuScenes. With ground-truth occupancy and ego trajectory, it improves mIoU and IoU by 6.56 and 9.16 points overall and by 6.06 and 5.53 points on dynamic classes.

摘要（中文）：占用世界模型由于运动不确定性和形状形变，难以准确预测移动物体。单一轨迹可能将多种看似合理的未来平均为一条不切实际的路径，而即使在运动正确的情况下，反复的体素化也可能侵蚀或膨胀物体形状。我们提出了ShoWorld，通过分离运动与形状表征来应对这些挑战。运动预测器根据场景布局、周围智能体及未来自车轨迹，预测概率化的轨迹。每个假设均被渲染为占用状态，并依据其概率进行融合，以保留多种可能的未来。形状组件预测亚体素点，包含占用概率及相对于局部几何的偏移量。这些点随物体刚性运动，体素占用状态由至少一个占用点落入该体素的概率决定。这种表征方式减少了运动中的形状形变。ShoWorld在Occ3D-nuScenes基准上取得了最先进的结果。在给定真实占用状态和自车轨迹的条件下，其mIoU和IoU整体分别提升了6.56和9.16个百分点，在动态类别上分别提升了6.06和5.53个百分点。

Authors: Zhiqiang Yan, Guangfa Wang, Yuan Wu, Jian Yang, Gim Hee Lee

CausalDrive: Causal Decomposition for Data-Efficient End-to-End Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

causal decomposition data-efficient nominal intention diffusion-based policy end-to-end autonomous driving

简要说明：CausalDrive 通过反事实轨迹和基于扩散的风格策略，将专家演示分解为确定性名义意图和概率性驾驶风格，从而提高了NAVSIM基准上端到端自动驾驶的数据效率。

TLDR: CausalDrive decomposes expert demonstrations into deterministic nominal intention and probabilistic driving style via counterfactual trajectories and a diffusion-based style policy, improving data efficiency for end-to-end autonomous driving on NAVSIM benchmarks.

Abstract: Efficient use of expert demonstrations is essential for end-to-end autonomous driving. However, directly imitating expert trajectories couples nominal intention, which specifies where the vehicle should go, with multimodal driving styles, which determine how that intention is executed. Different combinations of these factors can yield similar expert trajectories, obscuring their respective causal contributions and forcing the policy to learn both from a single entangled target. This ambiguity limits how effectively the policy can exploit expert demonstrations. We propose CausalDrive, a causal decomposition framework for data-efficient driving policy learning that separates deterministic nominal intention prediction from probabilistic driving style modeling. Specifically, we construct counterfactual nominal trajectories from navigation command, map topology, and ego state by removing style dependent effects, providing a Nominal Intention Planner with supervision independent of expert trajectories. Conditioned on the predicted nominal intention and surrounding agents, a diffusion-based Style Execution Policy models diverse driving styles as a multimodal distribution over residuals between nominal and expert trajectories. This causally structured supervision reduces redundant learning of shared nominal behavior in routine scenarios, directing expert supervision toward informative execution variations and improving data utilization. CausalDrive achieves 91.2 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 and 89.5 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2, matching or surpassing state-of-the-art performance. Further experiments demonstrate strong performance with limited expert data and clear advantages in challenging interactive scenarios.

摘要（中文）：高效利用专家示范对于端到端自动驾驶至关重要。然而，直接模仿专家轨迹将名义意图（即车辆应驶向何处）与多模态驾驶风格（即该意图如何被执行）耦合在一起。这些因素的不同组合可能产生相似的专家轨迹，掩盖了它们各自的因果贡献，迫使策略从单一纠缠的目标中同时学习两者。这种模糊性限制了策略有效利用专家示范的能力。我们提出CausalDrive，一种用于数据高效驾驶策略学习的因果分解框架，将确定性的名义意图预测与概率性驾驶风格建模相分离。具体而言，我们通过去除风格依赖效应，从导航指令、地图拓扑和自车状态构建反事实名义轨迹，为名义意图规划器提供独立于专家轨迹的监督信号。基于预测的名义意图和周围智能体，基于扩散的风格执行策略将多种驾驶风格建模为名义轨迹与专家轨迹之间残差的多模态分布。这种因果结构的监督减少了常规场景中对共享名义行为的冗余学习，将专家监督引导至信息量丰富的执行变化，从而提高数据利用率。CausalDrive在NAVSIM v1上达到91.2 PDMS，在NAVSIM v2上达到89.5 EPDMS，匹配或超越了当前最先进的性能。进一步实验表明，在有限专家数据条件下其性能依然强劲，并在具有挑战性的交互式场景中展现出明显优势。

Authors: Xiaobao Wei, Jingxian Wu, Lirong Yang, Qing Han, Yuan Gao, Ziwei Yang, Shuai Yang, Weiwei Liu, Chang Huang

SWIFT: Slow World, Instant Freshness, and Timely Action for Asynchronous Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

asynchronous world-action system Video DiT Action DiT real-time control closed-loop driving

简要说明：SWIFT 提出了一种用于自动驾驶的异步世界-动作系统，利用后台 Video DiT 进行世界更新，前台 Action DiT 实现实时控制，在多个基准上实现了精度-延迟的良好平衡。

TLDR: SWIFT presents an asynchronous world-action system for autonomous driving, leveraging a background Video DiT for world updates and a foreground Action DiT for real-time control, achieving strong accuracy-latency trade-offs across multiple benchmarks.

Abstract: Driving scenes keep changing during model computation, making both observation freshness and action-delivery time central to world-action planning. To retain rich generative world priors in autonomous driving without stalling real-time control, we present SWIFT (Slow World, Instant Freshness, and Timely action), a deployment-oriented asynchronous world-action system that moves world updates off the observation-to-action critical path. On a background GPU, a slow Video DiT streams surround-view history into read-only predictive world context, trained with a predictive span that covers both the update interval and background world computation. On a foreground GPU, a lightweight freshness carrier encodes current surround-view images into a gated key/value bank at every step, letting a fast Action DiT combine live visual feedback with the latest completed world context without waiting. On open-loop NAVSIM, SWIFT reaches 94.2 PDMS at 198.4 ms per decision with a trajectory scorer; on closed-loop Bench2Drive, it achieves an 80.30 Driving Score at 109.9 ms foreground latency. SWIFT further transfers to the Waymo E2E hidden test (8.0050 Rater Feedback Score) and nuScenes (0.54 m mean endpoint error, 0.03% mean collision rate). Across all four benchmarks, SWIFT achieves the best results among compared world-action methods, establishing a favorable accuracy-latency trade-off.

摘要（中文）：摘要：在模型计算过程中，驾驶场景持续变化，因此观测信息的新鲜度与动作下达时间成为世界-动作规划的核心要素。为了在自动驾驶中保留丰富的生成式世界先验知识，同时不阻碍实时控制，我们提出了SWIFT（慢速世界、即时新鲜度、及时动作）系统，这是一种面向部署的异步世界-动作系统，将世界更新从“观测到动作”的关键路径中分离出来。在后台GPU上，一个慢速视频扩散变换器（Video DiT）将环绕视图历史数据流式处理为只读的预测性世界上下文，其训练所使用的预测跨度同时覆盖更新间隔和后台世界计算时间。在前台GPU上，一个轻量级新鲜度载体在每个时间步将当前环绕视图图像编码为门控键值库，使快速动作扩散变换器（Action DiT）无需等待即可将实时视觉反馈与最新完成的世界上下文相结合。在开环NAVSIM基准上，SWIFT结合轨迹评分器实现了94.2的PDMS（每决策198.4毫秒）；在闭环Bench2Drive基准上，SWIFT达到了80.30的驾驶评分（前台延迟109.9毫秒）。SWIFT还进一步迁移至Waymo E2E隐藏测试集（评分为8.0050）和nuScenes数据集（平均端点误差0.54米，平均碰撞率0.03%）。在全部四个基准测试中，SWIFT相较于所对比的世界-动作方法均取得了最优结果，建立了良好的精度-延迟权衡。

Authors: Jiazhe Wang, Tianyi Yang, Ruihang Li, Fan Lu, Xianming Zeng, Jianyun Xu, Xingliang Liu, Lei Yang

RoboMorpher: Scaling Robot Morphology Representations for Cross-Embodiment Action Prediction VLA

morphology-conditioned action tokenizer cross-embodiment manipulation vision-language-action policy link-pose supervision EmbodiBench benchmark

简要说明：RoboMorpher 提出了一种形态条件动作分词器，通过联合重建关节角度和连杆位姿来改进跨本体动作预测，在 RoboTwin 2.0 和新基准 EmbodiBench 上取得了显著的性能提升。

TLDR: RoboMorpher introduces a morphology-conditioned action tokenizer that jointly reconstructs joint angles and link poses to improve cross-embodiment action prediction in VLA policies, achieving significant success gains on RoboTwin 2.0 and the new EmbodiBench benchmark.

Abstract: Learning shared action representations is central to cross-embodiment manipulation. However, identical joint values can produce different spatial configurations across robots, limiting representations learned from joint values alone. We introduce RoboMorpher, a morphology-conditioned action tokenizer that jointly reconstructs joint angles and link poses to associate control coordinates with their kinematic effects. MorphGen supplies scalable kinematic supervision by generating serial-arm descriptions from survey-derived geometric priors. We pretrain RoboMorpher on 40 million morphology-state pairs and integrate the frozen tokenizer into a vision-language-action policy for discrete prediction and continuous refinement. We also introduce EmbodiBench, a ten-task benchmark with 30 generated URDFs per task. With downstream URDFs excluded from tokenizer pretraining, the policy achieves 56.40% success on RoboTwin 2.0 and 23.27% on EmbodiBench, exceeding continuous joint-space control by 9.73 and 15.34 percentage points. Removing link-pose supervision reduces EmbodiBench success by 17.94 percentage points, supporting morphology-aware geometric supervision for joint-action representation learning.

摘要（中文）：学习共享的动作表征是跨实体操控的核心问题。然而，相同的关节值在不同机器人上可能产生不同的空间构型，这限制了仅从关节值中学习到的表征的泛化能力。我们提出了RoboMorpher，一种基于形态条件的动作分词器，通过联合重建关节角度和连杆位姿，将控制坐标与其运动学效应相关联。MorphGen通过从基于调查得到的几何先验中生成串联臂描述，提供可扩展的运动学监督。我们在4000万个形态-状态对上预训练了RoboMorpher，并将冻结的分词器集成到视觉-语言-动作策略中，用于离散预测和连续精化。我们还引入了EmbodiBench，一个包含十个任务、每个任务生成30个URDF模型的基准测试。在将下游URDF排除在分词器预训练之外的情况下，该策略在RoboTwin 2.0上取得了56.40%的成功率，在EmbodiBench上取得了23.27%的成功率，分别比连续关节空间控制高出9.73和15.34个百分点。去除连杆位姿监督后，EmbodiBench的成功率下降了17.94个百分点，这支持了形态感知的几何监督用于关节动作表征学习的有效性。

Authors: Wenwei Lin, Yan Qin, Weiliang Deng, Zixuan Li, Kaixuan Wang, Zanxin Chen, Yue Chen, Tianshuo Yang, Junting Chen, Zhixuan Liang, Yao Mu, Ximin Lyu, Renjing Xu, Ping Luo, Tianxing Chen

Counterfactual World Models: JEPAs That Reason About "What If" WorldModel

counterfactual world models JEPA world models what-if reasoning hindsight planning

简要说明：本文提出了一种在世界模型中进行反事实推理的方法，证明了仅凭事实数据的局限性，并利用“自然不做跳跃”的一阶修正来估计反事实结果，无需额外数据或重新训练，在像素仿真器上取得了显著效果。

TLDR: This paper introduces a method for counterfactual reasoning in world models, proving that factual data alone is insufficient and proposing a first-order correction (natura non facit saltus) to estimate counterfactual outcomes without extra data or retraining, with strong empirical results on pixel-based simulators.

Abstract: World models operate in a world they cannot fully observe. When a hidden disturbance, such as a current pushing a boat, changes the outcome of an action, a counterfactual question follows: what would have happened under a different action, subject to the same disturbance? Its answer separates bad decisions from bad luck. We prove that world models trained on factual transitions cannot answer it on their own, whatever their data or capacity. For many physical systems, the observed outcome and a simple property of the dynamics suffice: natura non facit saltus, nature makes no leaps. When actions and disturbances act as separate forces, their interaction is second-order in time, so the counterfactual outcome is, to first order, the observed outcome plus the difference between the world model's predictions under the alternative and factual actions. This yields a counterfactual world model with no counterfactual data, extra parameters, or retraining. For transitions of duration $h$, we prove an $O(h^2)$ bound on the counterfactual error relative to the disturbance variance, establish a matching minimax lower bound from unpaired factual data, and characterize failures at discontinuities, coordinate folds, and disturbances that scale the command. We validate these predictions from pixels with JEPA world models on frozen DINOv2 and masked autoencoder (MAE) encoders. On four rendered simulators, our approach improves counterfactual $R^2$ from $38$--$46\%$ to $86$--$96\%$ with the same world models; on a fifth, an underwater vehicle, it reaches $90$--$94\%$ with sixteen times more factual data. Four further frozen encoders, DINOv3, SigLIP~2, CLIP and EVA-02, give $81$--$95\%$ on the same simulators. In hindsight planning, it finds the action that would have reached the goal in $35$--$69\%$ of events, against $14$--$23\%$ for an oracle planner that knows the simulator but not the outcome.

摘要（中文）：世界模型在一个无法完全观测的世界中运行。当隐藏扰动（如水流的推力）改变动作结果时，一个反事实问题随之而来：在同样的扰动下，若采取不同的动作，会发生什么？对这一问题的回答，将糟糕的决策与糟糕的运气区分开来。我们证明，仅基于事实性转移训练的世界模型无法独立回答该问题，无论其数据量或容量如何。对许多物理系统而言，观测到的结果以及动力学的一个简单性质便已足够：自然无跳跃（natura non facit saltus）。当动作与扰动作为相互独立的力起作用时，其相互作用在时间上是二阶的，因此反事实结果在一阶近似下等于观测结果加上世界模型在替代动作与事实动作下预测之差。由此可得一个无需反事实数据、额外参数或重新训练的反事实世界模型。对于持续时间为 \( h \) 的转移，我们证明反事实误差相对于扰动方差的界限为 \( O(h^2) \)，建立了来自未配对事实数据的匹配极小极大下界，并刻画了在间断、坐标折叠以及扰动缩放指令等情形下的失效模式。我们在冻结的 DINOv2 和掩码自编码器（MAE）编码器上，结合 JEPA 世界模型，从像素层面验证了上述预测。在四个渲染模拟器上，我们的方法在相同世界模型下将反事实 \( R^2 \) 从 \( 38\)--\( 46\% \) 提升至 \( 86\)--\( 96\% \)；在第五个模拟器（水下航行器）上，借助十六倍的事实数据达到 \( 90\)--\( 94\% \)。另外四个冻结编码器，DINOv3、SigLIP~2、CLIP 和 EVA-02，在相同模拟器上给出 \( 81\)--\( 95\% \) 的结果。在后见规划中，该方法在 \( 35\)--\( 69\% \) 的事件中找到了本可到达目标的动作，而一个知晓模拟器但不知晓结果的神谕规划器仅为 \( 14\)--\( 23\% \)。

Authors: Randall Balestriero, Yann LeCun, Kerda Varaku

SHAPE: Discrete Supervision and Parallel Continuous Streams for Learning Dexterous Manipulation from Egocentric Human Data VLA

vision-language-action model dexterous manipulation human-to-robot transfer flow-matching egocentric human data

简要说明：SHAPE 是一种视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，利用离散动作标记和平行的末端执行器/关节输出流，从第一视角人类数据中学习灵巧操作，并在双臂22自由度机器人上展示了有效的人到机器人迁移。

TLDR: SHAPE is a VLA model that learns dexterous manipulation from egocentric human data using discrete action tokens and parallel end-effector/joint output streams, demonstrating effective human-to-robot transfer on a bimanual robot with 22-DoF hands.

Abstract: Egocentric human recordings are far cheaper than dexterous robot demonstrations, promising stronger pretraining and direct skill learning without task-specific robot data. Yet humans and robots differ in morphology and kinematics, so human recordings lack the joint positions and actuator commands that supervise robot policies, providing only retargeted end-effector (EEF) actions. This raises two questions: how human data should supervise the policy, and how a dexterous robot should read out actions at deployment. We address both in SHAPE (Supervision from Human Action tokens with Parallel Executable streams), a vision-language-action (VLA) model whose backbone predicts discrete action tokens of EEF chunks as an auxiliary task, while a shared flow-matching expert outputs two executable streams, EEF and joint. On a bimanual robot with 22-DoF hands, a matched study shows that discrete supervision helps learn from human data, driving backbone gradients and shaping action-informative representations across domains. Under standard control pipelines at deployment, direct joint readout excels at fine-grained control with robot demonstrations, scoring 0.80 across six tasks against 0.63 for π0.5, whereas IK-based EEF readout excels at human-to-robot transfer. Pretrained with human data and discrete tokens, SHAPE learns new tasks from human demonstrations without task-specific robot data.

摘要（中文）：以自我为中心的人类录像远比灵巧机器人的演示数据廉价，这有望实现更强的预训练和直接技能学习，而无需依赖特定任务的机器人数据。然而，人类与机器人在形态学和运动学上存在差异，因此人类录像缺乏用于监督机器人策略的关节位置和执行器指令，仅能提供重新定向后的末端执行器动作。这引出了两个问题：人类数据应如何监督策略，以及灵巧机器人在部署时应如何读取动作。我们在SHAPE（基于并行可执行流的类人动作标记监督）中解决了这两个问题。SHAPE是一种视觉-语言-动作模型，其主干网络将末端执行器分块动作的离散动作标记预测作为辅助任务，而共享的流匹配专家输出两个可执行流：末端执行器和关节。在一台拥有22自由度双手的双手机器人上，一项匹配研究表明，离散监督有助于从人类数据中学习，驱动主干网络梯度，并在跨领域中塑造携带动作信息的表示。在部署时的标准控制流程下，直接关节读取在基于机器人演示数据的细粒度控制中表现优异，在六项任务上得分为0.80，而π0.5为0.63；相比之下，基于逆运动学的末端执行器读取则擅长于人类到机器人的迁移。通过人类数据和离散标记的预训练，SHAPE能够仅凭人类演示学习新任务，而无需依赖特定任务的机器人数据。

Authors: Yaping Li, Zhihong Liu, Jiacheng Li, Yi Yang, Wenchao Yue, Mingzhe Ye, Xiangcheng Liu, Yiyang Chen, Haotian He, Qi Zhang, Haonan Wang, Dahua Lin, Zhijie Deng

RECLAIM: Robot-Vision-Informed Adversarial Patch Defense via Embodied Attention Feedback VLA

adversarial patch defense vision-language-action policies embodied manipulation attention feedback training-free inference-time purification

简要说明：RECLAIM 是一种针对冻结的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的免训练推理时防御方法，利用策略自身的注意力反馈和机器人几何信息在闭环机器人操作过程中净化视觉输入，在对抗补丁攻击下显著提高任务成功率。

TLDR: RECLAIM is a training-free inference-time defense against adversarial patches for frozen vision-language-action (VLA) policies, using the policy's own attention feedback and robot geometry to purify visual inputs during closed-loop robotic manipulation, significantly improving task success under attack.

Abstract: Vision-language-action policies control embodied agents through a perception-action loop grounded in physical interaction, where adversarial patches can corrupt action predictions and thereby alter subsequent observations. To mitigate these threats, many existing defenses rely on policy adaptation or auxiliary models, but require additional training or inference. We introduce RECLAIM, a training-free, inference-time defense that uses a frozen VLA's own attention response to local visual interventions to guide purification during closed-loop embodied manipulation. Our key insight is that attention changes induced by local edits provide feedback for choosing where and how to purify as the robot interacts with its environment. RECLAIM combines this feedback with robot geometry to refine patch localization and select local treatments, then revalidates them as the agent's embodied actions change the observed scene. We evaluate RECLAIM against patches generated by four adversarial attack methods across multiple manipulation task suites under frozen VLA control. Under adversarial patch attacks, RECLAIM succeeds in at least one rollout on 95% of the evaluated tasks and raises rollout success on LIBERO-Object from 0% without defense to 70.0%. Its mean decision time is only 548.9 ms per control step. These results highlight policy-guided visual purification as an effective approach to defending embodied agents against adversarial patches and recovering closed-loop task execution.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-行动策略通过基于物理交互的感知-行动循环来控制具身智能体，而对抗性补丁可能会破坏行动预测，从而改变后续的观测。为缓解这些威胁，许多现有防御方法依赖于策略自适应或辅助模型，但需要额外训练或推理。我们提出RECLAIM，一种无需训练、推理时的防御方法，利用冻结的VLA自身对局部视觉干预的注意力响应来引导闭环具身操作中的净化过程。我们的关键洞察在于，局部编辑引起的注意力变化为机器人与环境交互时选择净化位置和方式提供了反馈。RECLAIM将该反馈与机器人几何信息相结合，以细化补丁定位并选择局部处理方式，随后在智能体的具身行动改变观测场景时对其进行重新验证。我们在冻结VLA控制下，针对四种对抗攻击方法生成的补丁，在多个操作任务套件上评估了RECLAIM。在对抗性补丁攻击下，RECLAIM在95%的评估任务中至少有一次成功 rollout，并将LIBERO-Object上的rollout成功率从无防御时的0%提升至70.0%。其平均决策时间仅为每控制步548.9毫秒。这些结果凸显了策略引导的视觉净化作为防御具身智能体免受对抗性补丁攻击并恢复闭环任务执行的有效方法。

Authors: Jiayou Zhu, Peng Guo, Litian Zhang, Xinze Shi, Yuting Zhang, Zelong Yu, Yize Tian, Jirong Liu, Zifeng Kang

Homeward: No Place Like the Training View VLA

observation adapter camera canonicalization VLA policy robot kinematics closed-loop evaluation

简要说明：Homeward 是一种无需训练的观察适配器，通过估计相机参数和静态场景深度，并从运动学模型渲染机械臂，将部署相机的视角转换回训练视角，从而提升冻结 VLA 策略在多种相机变化下的成功率。

TLDR: Homeward is a training-free observation adapter that canonicalizes deployment camera views back into the training view for frozen VLA policies by estimating camera parameters and static scene depth, while rendering the robot arm from kinematics, improving success rates across many camera variations.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies implicitly assume that third-person cameras remain fixed at their data-collection poses; once a camera is bumped, remounted, or swapped at deployment, task success degrades precipitously even though the underlying task and robot remain unchanged. We present Homeward, a training-free, plug-and-play observation adapter that canonicalizes observations from an uncalibrated deployment camera back into the training view for frozen VLA policies. Our design stems from a closed-loop diagnostic paradox in simulation: while re-rendering perturbed views into the training camera with oracle geometry recovers much of the lost performance, substituting an off-the-shelf feed-forward 3D foundation model can leave the policy worse off than applying no correction at all. This degradation concentrates on the thin, articulated robot arm, which feed-forward depth prediction tears and scatters - yet the arm's exact 3D state is already known from robot kinematics. Homeward exploits this asymmetry: it estimates what is unknown - camera parameters and static scene depth - from the live RGB frame and a single training-view reference, and renders what is known - the moving robot links - directly from the kinematic model. Evaluated across $\sim$300,000 closed-loop episodes spanning four frozen VLAs, Homeward boosts success across all 1,599 camera variants of LIBERO-Plus from 62.5%, 76.5%, 68.0%, and 3.6% to 77.6%, 95.1%, 91.2%, and 26.4% for OpenVLA-OFT, $π_{0.5}$, $π_0$, and OpenVLA, respectively. Without any scene fine-tuning or deployment camera calibration, Homeward extends to 6-DoF random placements, focal-length changes, and, with per-step pose estimation, continuous intra-episode camera drift, while matching or surpassing a calibrated, scene-trained view-synthesis baseline on three of four policies on LIBERO-Plus.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略隐式地假设第三人称摄像头在数据采集阶段保持固定姿态；一旦部署时摄像头被碰撞、重新安装或更换，即使底层任务和机器人保持不变，任务成功率也会急剧下降。我们提出Homeward——一种无需训练、即插即用的观测适配器，能够将来自未标定部署摄像头的观测归一化回训练视角，以适配冻结的VLA策略。我们的设计源于仿真中的闭环诊断悖论：虽然利用理想几何将扰动视角重新渲染到训练摄像头可以恢复大部分性能损失，但替换为现成的前馈3D基础模型反而可能使策略表现比完全不进行校正更差。这种性能下降集中在细长的关节式机械臂上——前馈深度预测会将其撕裂并散落——然而机械臂的精确3D状态已可从机器人运动学中获知。Homeward利用了这一不对称性：它从实时RGB帧和单一训练视角参考图像中估计未知量——即摄像头参数和静态场景深度，并直接从运动学模型渲染已知量——即运动的机器人连杆。在涵盖四个冻结VLA策略的约30万次闭环交互评估中，Homeward在LIBERO-Plus全部1,599种摄像头变体上将OpenVLA-OFT、$π_{0.5}$、$π_0$和OpenVLA的成功率分别从62.5%、76.5%、68.0%和3.6%提升至77.6%、95.1%、91.2%和26.4%。在无需任何场景微调或部署摄像头标定的情况下，Homeward可扩展至6自由度随机放置、焦距变化，并通过逐帧姿态估计应对片段内连续摄像头漂移，同时在LIBERO-Plus上对四个策略中的三个达到或超越了经过标定和场景训练的视图合成基线。

Authors: Mingyang Lyu, Yinqian Sun, Gongce Cao, Guobin Shen, Yuhao Zhang, Lu Jia, Chenfei Yan, Qian Zhang, Pin Lyu, Chen Gao, Bo Wang

Teaching VLMs What to Say, Not How to Reason: Rethinking Counterfactual Reasoning in Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

counterfactual reasoning vision-language models autonomous driving shortcut learning causal understanding

简要说明：本文研究了基于VLM的自动驾驶中反事实推理是否真正引发因果理解，还是仅仅作为语言捷径。实验表明，反事实推理将行动分布转向保守行为，而未改善视觉基础或因果推理，揭示了语言推理与因果理解之间的差距。

TLDR: This paper investigates whether counterfactual reasoning in VLM-based autonomous driving induces genuine causal understanding or merely acts as a linguistic shortcut. Experiments show that CF reasoning shifts action distributions toward conservative behaviors without improving visual grounding or causal reasoning, highlighting a gap between language-based reasoning and causal understanding.

Abstract: End-to-end autonomous driving systems have been shown to suffer from shortcut learning and causal confusion, limiting their ability to generalize robustly under distribution shift. To mitigate these limitations, recent works based on Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have explored incorporating linguistic reasoning capabilities into driving decision-making, reporting improvements in driving performance. In particular, counterfactual (CF) reasoning has been proposed to enable self-reflective, high-level causal understanding. However, it remains unclear whether the language-based reasoning mitigates shortcut learning or merely shifts it from visual representations to linguistic patterns, creating an illusion of causal understanding. Moreover, existing approaches often conflate intervention-based reasoning with CF reasoning, leaving the effects of genuine CF reasoning unexplored. In this work, we examine what CF reasoning actually induces in VLM-based autonomous driving and observe that it shifts the action distribution toward more conservative behaviors while increasing uncertainty in reasoning and decision-making. This effect persists under reinforcement fine-tuning, suggesting that it is not merely a transient artifact. Furthermore, visual attention analysis shows that CF reasoning does not alter visual grounding, while causal intervention experiments reveal that masking causally relevant and non-causal factors in accident scenarios results in comparable decision change rates. Overall, these results suggest that CF reasoning does not induce genuine causal reasoning grounded in visual evidence. Instead, it acts as a linguistic shortcut that reshapes the action distribution, teaching models what to say but not how to reason, highlighting a gap between language-based reasoning and causal understanding in autonomous driving.

摘要（中文）：端到端自动驾驶系统已被证明存在捷径学习与因果混淆问题，限制了其在分布偏移下鲁棒泛化的能力。为缓解这些局限，近年来基于视觉-语言模型（VLM）的研究尝试将语言推理能力融入驾驶决策过程，并报告了驾驶性能的提升。特别是，反事实（CF）推理被提出用于实现自我反思式的高层因果理解。然而，目前尚不清楚基于语言的推理究竟是缓解了捷径学习，还是仅仅将其从视觉表征转移至语言模式，从而制造出因果理解的假象。此外，现有方法往往将基于干预的推理与反事实推理混为一谈，使得真正反事实推理的效果尚未被探索。在本研究中，我们考察了反事实推理在基于VLM的自动驾驶中实际引发的影响，并观察到它使动作分布趋于更保守的行为，同时增加了推理与决策过程中的不确定性。这一效应在强化微调后依然存在，表明其并非短暂的伪影。进一步地，视觉注意力分析显示，反事实推理并未改变视觉 grounding，而因果干预实验则揭示，在事故场景中掩蔽因果相关因素与非因果因素会产生相当的决策变化率。总体而言，这些结果表明反事实推理并未引发基于视觉证据的真实因果推理。相反，它充当了一种语言捷径，重塑了动作分布，教会模型该说什么而非如何推理，凸显了自动驾驶中基于语言的推理与因果理解之间的鸿沟。

Authors: Hayeon Oh, Donghwan Lee

Old Experience, New Lessons: Relabeling Autonomous Robot Rollouts in Interactive Imitation Learning Manipulation

interactive imitation learning set-valued supervision diffusion policy autonomous experience relabeling manipulation

简要说明：SeRA利用后续策略检查点重标注自主机器人经验，并通过集合值监督训练扩散策略，改善了稀疏人工纠正下的模仿学习，在模拟和真实操控任务中提升了性能。

TLDR: SeRA relabels autonomous robot experience with later policy checkpoints and trains a diffusion policy with set-valued supervision, improving imitation learning from sparse human corrections in simulated and real manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Interactive imitation learning enables robots to learn from human interventions during deployment. These interactions naturally produce sparse human corrections and abundant autonomous robot experience without human action labels. Yet existing methods either leave this experience unused for action supervision or imitate historical robot actions, which can reinforce suboptimal behavior. To address this limitation, we propose Set-valued Relabeling of Autonomous experience (SeRA), a framework that learns from autonomous robot experience through set-valued supervision of policy relabels. Later policy checkpoints relabel this experience, and agreement across checkpoints filters the relabels. Since agreement does not guarantee correctness, SeRA constructs desired action sets around accepted relabels. Following Set-Supervised Diffusion Policy (SDP), it trains an action-chunking diffusion policy to increase the probability of actions within these sets. A step-masked denoising loss combines accepted relabels with available human corrections in partially supervised chunks. Experiments across five simulated manipulation tasks in online and offline settings show that SeRA improves policy performance over SDP and outperforms baselines that imitate historical robot actions or exact relabels. On a real-robot tomato-picking task, SeRA achieves 80% success, compared with 40% for SDP, using the same human feedback and training budget. These results demonstrate that relabeled autonomous robot experience can complement human corrections to improve policy performance.

摘要（中文）：交互式模仿学习使机器人能够在部署过程中从人类干预中学习。这些交互自然会产生稀疏的人类纠正信息，以及大量无人类动作标签的自主机器人经验。然而，现有方法要么未将这些经验用于动作监督，要么模仿历史机器人动作，这可能会强化次优行为。为解决这一局限，我们提出了自主经验重标注集合框架（SeRA），该框架通过策略重标注的集合值监督来从自主机器人经验中学习。后续的策略检查点对这些经验进行重标注，检查点之间的一致性用于筛选重标注结果。由于一致性并不能保证正确性，SeRA在可接受的重标注周围构建期望动作集合。遵循集合监督扩散策略（SDP），该方法训练一种动作分块扩散策略，以提高这些集合内动作的概率。逐步掩码去噪损失将可接受的重标注与部分监督分块中可用的人类纠正信息相结合。在在线和离线设置下的五个模拟操作任务实验中，SeRA在策略性能上优于SDP，并且胜过模仿历史机器人动作或精确重标注的基线方法。在真实机器人采摘番茄任务中，SeRA取得了80%的成功率，而SDP在同一人类反馈和训练预算下仅为40%。这些结果表明，重标注的自主机器人经验可以补充人类纠正信息，从而提升策略性能。

Authors: Zhaoting Li, Cosimo Della Santina, Jens Kober

Allocentric Memory, Egocentric Acting: A Dual-Frame VLA for Urban Aerial Navigation VLA

vision-language-action model allocentric spatial memory urban aerial navigation language-goal navigation dual-frame

简要说明：CityNav-VLA 提出了一种用于城市无人机导航的双框架视觉-语言-动作模型，结合了异我中心空间记忆与自我中心执行，在语言目标导航中取得了最先进的结果。

TLDR: CityNav-VLA introduces a dual-frame vision-language-action model for urban UAV navigation, combining allocentric spatial memory with egocentric execution to achieve state-of-the-art results in language-goal navigation.

Abstract: Language-goal aerial navigation requires a UAV to reach a destination specified in natural language using observations collected during flight. A key challenge is linking changing egocentric perception with spatial evidence anchored to stable locations for long-range navigation. We propose CityNav-VLA, a dual-frame vision-language-action model for urban navigation integrating dynamic egocentric context with persistent allocentric spatial memory. The UAV incrementally accumulates visual observations on a fixed north-up map initialized with geographic and landmark priors, preserving evidence across viewpoint changes. A dynamic query conditioned on the instruction, current observations, UAV state, and motion history retrieves relevant memory evidence to predict a map-frame target. A deterministic controller converts this target into body-frame commands using the UAV's current pose, connecting global reasoning with egocentric execution. To reduce target fluctuations over long horizons, early goal commitment (EGC) fixes the execution target to the coordinate-wise median of the first $K$ predictions without extra trainable parameters. On Test Unseen, CityNav-VLA reduces NE by 21.2% and improves SR and SPL by 15.8% and 30.9%, respectively. It also reduces NE by 6.2% and improves SR and SPL by 5.6% and 23.2%, respectively, relative to the former SOTA after dataset refinement. Cumulative ablations show that navigation-map features yield the largest gains, while metric coordinates further improve endpoint accuracy. With a 4B-scale backbone, inference averages 0.68 s per decision with 8.6 GB peak memory on a single A100, presenting remarkable model efficiency.

摘要（中文）：语言目标空中导航要求无人机利用飞行过程中采集的观测信息，以自然语言指定的目的地为目标进行到达。关键挑战在于，如何将动态变化的自我中心感知与锚定于稳定位置的空间证据相连接，以实现长距离导航。我们提出CityNav-VLA，一种面向城市场景导航的双框架视觉-语言-动作模型，将动态自我中心上下文与持久异中心空间记忆相结合。无人机在固定北向朝上的地图上逐步累积视觉观测，该地图以地理与地标先验信息初始化，从而在视角变化过程中保持证据的连续性。基于指令、当前观测、无人机状态及运动历史条件化的动态查询，检索相关记忆证据以预测地图坐标系中的目标位置。确定性控制器利用无人机当前位姿将该目标转换为机体坐标系指令，将全局推理与自我中心执行相连接。为减少长距离任务中的目标波动，早期目标承诺（EGC）机制将执行目标固定为前\( K \)次预测的坐标中位数，无需额外可训练参数。在Test Unseen数据集上，CityNav-VLA将导航误差（NE）降低21.2%，并将成功率（SR）和路径长度加权成功率（SPL）分别提升15.8%和30.9%。在数据集精化后，相较于此前的最先进方法，NE进一步降低6.2%，SR和SPL分别提升5.6%和23.2%。累计消融实验表明，导航地图特征带来的性能提升最为显著，而度量坐标进一步提高了终点精度。基于4B规模的主干网络，在单张A100上每次决策平均推理时间为0.68秒，峰值内存占用8.6 GB，展现出卓越的模型效率。

Authors: Haotian Xu, Yue Hu, Zhengqiu Zhu, Tuo Feng, Wenguan Wang, Quanjun Yin

ProbeShare: Probing a Few, Sharing Across Many for Fast World-Model Planning WorldModel

world-model planning cross-entropy method joint-embedding robotic manipulation efficient planning

简要说明：ProbeShare 通过使用少量代表性探针和几何感知加权来重建候选动作的特征网格，从而加速世界模型规划，在 RoboCasa 任务上实现了大幅加速。

TLDR: ProbeShare accelerates world-model planning by using a few representative probes and geometry-aware weighting to reconstruct feature grids for candidate actions, achieving large speedups on RoboCasa tasks.

Abstract: Visual planning with a frozen joint-embedding world model supports robotic reaching and object manipulation by evaluating candidate action sequences against an image goal before execution. Standard cross-entropy method (CEM) planners roll out every candidate independently through a billion-parameter predictor, even when nearby actions induce similar scene changes. This redundant computation grows with population size and search rounds, slowing closed-loop replanning. We observe that candidates within a planning step share an observation history and thus a common action-to-feature map. Based on this insight, we propose ProbeShare, which measures local responses with a few representative probes and reconstructs each candidate's feature grid through scene-conditioned, geometry-aware weighting. When promising candidates move beyond existing probe coverage, ProbeShare evaluates a new probe to rescore nearby candidates. Across four RoboCasa tasks, ProbeShare accelerates episode planning by 43.8--128.9 times over dense RoboJEPA and at least $14.2\times$ over competitive baselines, with greater mean goal progress in a matched-time comparison.

摘要（中文）：摘要： 基于冻结联合嵌入世界模型的视觉规划，通过在执行前对照图像目标评估候选动作序列，支持机器人抓取与物体操作。标准交叉熵法（CEM）规划器会独立地将每个候选动作输入到拥有十亿参数的预测器中进行展开，即使相邻动作引发的场景变化相似也不例外。这种冗余计算随种群规模和搜索轮次增加而增长，从而拖慢了闭环重规划的速度。我们观察到，同一规划步骤内的候选动作共享观测历史，因而拥有共同的“动作—特征”映射关系。基于这一发现，我们提出了ProbeShare方法，利用少量代表性探针测量局部响应，并通过场景条件化、几何感知的加权方式重建每个候选动作的特征网格。当有前景的候选动作超出当前探针覆盖范围时，ProbeShare会评估新探针，以重新为邻近候选动作打分。在四个RoboCasa任务中，ProbeShare相比稠密版RoboJEPA将情节规划速度提升了43.8至128.9倍，相比竞争基线至少提升了$14.2\times$，并且在同等时间比较中获得了更高的平均目标进度。

Authors: Zejian Kang, Xiantao Lin, Zekai Chen, Boyang Shen, Mingyu Ma, Shengwen Zheng, Chengtai Guo, Xiangru Huang

TrajWAM: Trajectory-Conditioned Future Learning for Vision-Language Driving AutonomousDriving

World Action Model trajectory-conditioned BEV future learning vision-language driving Bench2Drive

简要说明：TrajWAM是一种轨迹条件下的世界动作模型，通过将辅助的鸟瞰图未来预测与执行的自我轨迹相结合，提升了视觉语言驾驶性能，在Bench2Drive上取得了最先进的结果。

TLDR: TrajWAM is a trajectory-conditioned World Action Model that improves vision-language driving by adding auxiliary BEV future prediction tied to the executed ego-trajectory, yielding state-of-the-art scores on Bench2Drive.

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) connect future scene prediction with action planning for autonomous driving. Each driving record pairs an executed ego trajectory with its observed future, providing a factual outcome for learning this connection. We present TrajWAM, a trajectory-conditioned WAM that improves vision-language driving through auxiliary bird's-eye-view (BEV) future learning. An ego-trajectory query conditions DINOv3-aligned BEV predictions from shared planner representations. Training combines factual reconstruction under the executed trajectory with one-sided feature separation under an unlabeled perturbed trajectory. Together, these objectives train the shared planner to generate driving waypoints. Native inference directly generates waypoints and bypasses the auxiliary future-prediction branch. On all 220 Bench2Drive routes, TrajWAM achieves 91.53 Driving Score and 75.45% Success Rate, exceeding a schedule-matched planning-only fine-tuning baseline by 5.31 Driving Score points and eight successful routes.

摘要（中文）：世界行动模型（WAMs）将未来场景预测与自动驾驶中的动作规划相连接。每条驾驶记录都将执行的自我轨迹与其观测到的未来配对，为学习这种连接提供了事实结果。我们提出TrajWAM，一种轨迹条件化的世界行动模型，通过辅助鸟瞰图（BEV）未来学习来增强视觉-语言驾驶。自我轨迹查询对共享规划器表示中DINOv3对齐的BEV预测进行条件化。训练结合了在执行轨迹下的事实重建与在未标注扰动轨迹下的单侧特征分离。这些目标共同训练共享规划器以生成驾驶路径点。原生推理直接生成路径点，绕过了辅助未来预测分支。在所有220条Bench2Drive路线上，TrajWAM实现了91.53的驾驶分数和75.45%的成功率，比计划匹配的仅规划微调基线高出5.31个驾驶分数点和8条成功路线。

Authors: Xuerui Fang, Gulimila Kezierbieke, Chen Wangxing, Hui Li

Adaptive Action Horizon Selection via Flow-Field Uncertainty VLA

Adaptive Action Chunking Flow-Field Uncertainty Vision-Language-Action Predictive Uncertainty Robot Manipulation

简要说明：DUAC 从预训练 VLA 模型的向量场中提取轨迹条件下的预测不确定性，以实现自适应动作分块，在多个操作基准上提升任务成功率并降低推理延迟。

TLDR: DUAC extracts trajectory-conditioned predictive uncertainty from the vector field of a pretrained VLA model to enable adaptive action chunking, improving task success and inference latency across manipulation benchmarks.

Abstract: Reliable uncertainty estimates are important for adaptive execution in vision-language-action (VLA) models. Existing approaches such as Adaptive Action Chunking (AAC) estimate action entropy from multiple sampled action chunks, introducing additional inference cost and capturing both uncertainty within an action trajectory and diversity across alternative strategies. We introduce Divergence-based Uncertainty-aware Adaptive Action Chunking (DUAC), a post-hoc method that extracts trajectory-conditioned predictive uncertainty from the vector field of a pretrained VLA. Building on a closed-form flow-posterior covariance formulation, DUAC derives action-level uncertainty scores from a single generated chunk using Jacobian-vector products, without retraining or multiple endpoint samples. DUAC strongly correlates with AAC, while capturing distinct information: AAC measures global dispersion across sampled chunks, whereas DUAC measures local uncertainty around the trajectory selected for execution. Consequently, DUAC is less sensitive to diversity among distinct but valid action strategies. Across LIBERO, LIBERO-Pro, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboCasa, DUAC-based adaptive horizon selection performs favorably among the evaluated methods, combining strong task success with low uncertainty-estimation latency. These results establish the flow vector field as an efficient, trajectory-conditioned source of predictive uncertainty for robot decision making.

摘要（中文）：可靠的确定性估计对于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型中的自适应执行至关重要。现有的方法，如自适应动作分块（AAC），通过从多个采样动作分块中估计动作熵来工作，这引入了额外的推理成本，并同时捕捉了动作轨迹内部的确定性以及不同备选策略之间的多样性。我们提出了一种基于散度的确定性感知自适应动作分块（DUAC）方法，这是一种事后方法，从预训练VLA的向量场中提取轨迹条件下的预测不确定性。基于闭式流后验协方差公式，DUAC利用雅可比向量积从单个生成分块中推导出动作级别的不确定性得分，无需重新训练或多个端点采样。DUAC与AAC高度相关，同时捕捉了不同信息：AAC衡量多个采样分块之间的全局离散度，而DUAC衡量围绕所选执行轨迹的局部不确定性。因此，DUAC对不同但有效的动作策略之间的多样性不太敏感。在LIBERO、LIBERO-Pro、LIBERO-Plus和RoboCasa上，基于DUAC的自适应视界选择在所评估的方法中表现优异，兼顾了较高的任务成功率与较低的不确定性估计延迟。这些结果确立了流向量场作为机器人决策中一种高效、轨迹条件下的预测不确定性来源。

Efficient World-Model Planning via Physics-Guided Search Distillation AutonomousDriving

world model trajectory planning search distillation execution feedback NAVSIM

简要说明：PGSD 提出了一种用于自动驾驶的单视图规划框架，通过搜索教师生成池外轨迹修正并由学生模型进行蒸馏，提升了道路合规性和 NAVSIM 基准上的性能。

TLDR: PGSD proposes a single-view planning framework for autonomous driving that uses a search teacher to generate beyond-pool trajectory corrections and a student model to distill them, improving road compliance and performance on NAVSIM benchmarks.

Abstract: World models support autonomous driving by evaluating candidate trajectories through predicted future scene evolution. However, accurate future prediction does not ensure road-compliant execution; when all candidates violate road boundaries, re-ranking cannot select a feasible trajectory. We propose Physics-Guided Search Distillation (PGSD), a single-view planning framework that combines future representations and execution feedback for verified beyond-pool repair through three components: (1) Execution-Aware Selection checks ego-vehicle road compliance under simulated execution and selects the highest-scoring feasible trajectory; (2) a Clearance-Aware Search Teacher generates beyond-pool corrections and selects demonstrations with larger minimum road-boundary clearance during execution to buffer imitation errors; and (3) a Future-Conditioned Repair Student predicts one correction from rewarder features and execution feedback for single-rollout verification. The pretrained planner and rewarder remain frozen; no future scenes are generated online. On NAVSIM v1, single-view PGSD achieves 90.97 PDMS, exceeding all compared prior single-view planners and retaining 73.2% of the search teacher's PDMS gain over execution-aware selection. On NAVSIM v2 navhard, it reaches 38.96 EPDMS, improving on WorldDrive by 11.24 points (40.5%). The student replaces up to ten search rollouts with a single verification rollout per repair trigger. HUGSIM Hard examples provide qualitative evidence of zero-shot transfer.

摘要（中文）：世界模型通过预测未来场景演变来评估候选轨迹，从而支持自动驾驶。然而，准确的未来预测并不能确保轨迹符合道路规范；当所有候选轨迹均违反道路边界时，重新排序无法选出可行轨迹。我们提出物理引导搜索蒸馏（PGSD），一种单视角规划框架，结合未来表征与执行反馈，通过三个组件实现经验证的池外修复：(1) 执行感知选择，在模拟执行下检查自车道路合规性，并选择得分最高的可行轨迹；(2) 净空感知搜索教师，生成池外修正并在执行过程中选择具有更大最小道路边界净空的示范，以缓冲模仿误差；(3) 未来条件修复学生，从奖励器特征和执行反馈中预测一个修正，用于单次 rollout 验证。预训练规划器和奖励器保持冻结；在线不生成未来场景。在 NAVSIM v1 上，单视角 PGSD 达到 90.97 PDMS，超越所有对比的先前单视角规划器，并保留搜索教师在执行感知选择基础上 PDMS 增益的 73.2%。在 NAVSIM v2 navhard 上，达到 38.96 EPDMS，比 WorldDrive 提升 11.24 分（40.5%）。学生每次修复触发仅用单次验证 rollout 替代多达十次搜索 rollout。HUGSIM Hard 示例为零样本迁移提供了定性证据。

Authors: Hongyu Zhang, Xiaoshuai Hao, Heye Huang, Qingwen Meng, Wenjun Shi, Jianao Xu, Xin Hu, Xuanru Jin, Jingyi Zhang, Baicang Guo

BEV-Diffusion: Camera-Only Traversability Navigation with BEV Memory and Efficient Cross-Robot Adaptation Locomotion

BEV traversability camera-only navigation diffusion planner cross-robot adaptation uncertainty-aware guidance

简要说明：BEV-Diffusion 是一个仅使用相机的可通行性导航系统，通过单一网络学习 BEV 地图、不确定性和路径。它利用冻结的 DINOv2 骨干网络、贝叶斯融合和基于扩散的规划器，在真实机器人上展示了高效的跨机器人适应和稳健导航。

TLDR: BEV-Diffusion is a camera-only traversability navigation system that learns a BEV map, uncertainty, and path in a single network, using a frozen DINOv2 backbone, Bayesian fusion, and a diffusion-based planner. It demonstrates efficient cross-robot adaptation and robust navigation on real robots, including a wheeled-legged robot in outdoor environments and a small legged robot indoors, with minimal retraining.

Abstract: Robot navigation requires both an understanding of the scene and an efficient adaptation to new robots, yet current methods rely on expensive LiDAR sensors, long mapping and modular pipelines. We present BEV-Diffusion, a camera-only model that learns a bird's-eye view (BEV) traversability map, its uncertainty and the path in a single network. A frozen DINOv2 backbone encodes consecutive RGB frames, which inverse perspective mapping and Bayesian fusion lift into the BEV, and a ranking loss keeps outdoor traversability graded rather than binary, separating asphalt from grass (median 0.94 vs. 0.75). On this map, a transformer denoiser generates polar waypoints in a few DDIM steps, and uncertainty-aware guidance refines the path and ends it where the map is no longer reliable. At deployment, a metric BEV memory keeps obstacles after they leave the camera view and warm starts each sample from the previous, ego-motion compensated path. Because the planner jointly learns the path, the map, and its uncertainty, it selects routes through terrain it can confidently traverse. In an unseen courtyard, a wheeled-legged robot autonomously traveled 120 m, completing 96% of the route without intervention, compared with 75-88% for the baselines. Even under low-light conditions after sunset, the proposed model completed the route without requiring any intervention. Retraining only the BEV head, about 3% of the parameters, adapts the model to a small legged robot in 2.3 min. Indoors, the memory gets this robot out of maze-like traps: it retains 62-66% of the nearby out-of-view obstacles, against at most 3% for the baselines, and the robot achieves 67-100% task progress, compared with 20-40% for the evaluated baselines.

摘要（中文）：机器人导航既需要对场景的理解，也需要对新机器人的高效适应，然而现有方法依赖昂贵的激光雷达传感器、漫长的建图过程和模块化处理流程。我们提出BEV-Diffusion，一种仅使用摄像头的模型，在单一网络中同时学习鸟瞰图（BEV）可通行性地图、其不确定性以及路径规划。冻结的DINOv2骨干网络编码连续的RGB帧，通过逆透视映射和贝叶斯融合将其提升至BEV空间，排序损失函数使室外可通行性保持分级而非二值化，从而区分沥青路面与草地（中位值分别为0.94与0.75）。在此地图上，变换器去噪器在少量DDIM步骤中生成极坐标路径点，不确定性感知引导进一步优化路径，并在地图不再可靠时终止路径。部署时，度量BEV记忆在障碍物离开相机视野后仍对其进行保留，并利用前一帧基于自运动补偿的路径对每个样本进行热启动。由于规划器联合学习路径、地图及其不确定性，它能够选择通过自身可自信通行的地形的路线。在未见的庭院中，一轮腿式机器人自主行驶120米，无需干预即完成96%的路程，而基线方法的完成率为75%-88%。即使在日落后的低光照条件下，该模型也能在无需任何干预的情况下完成全程。仅重新训练BEV头部（约占参数的3%），即可在2.3分钟内将该模型适配至小型腿式机器人。在室内环境中，记忆机制帮助该机器人摆脱迷宫式困境：它保留了62%-66%附近视野外障碍物的信息，而基线方法最多仅保留3%；该机器人的任务完成进度达到67%-100%，而所评估的基线方法仅为20%-40%。

Authors: Iana Zhura, Timofei Kozlov, Dmitrii Plotnikov, Ivan Valuev, Miguel Altamirano Cabrera, Dzmitry Tsetserukou

Meaning Reaches Object Choice but Not Completion: Where Is a VLA Vulnerable to Landmark Synonyms? VLA

VLA robustness landmark synonyms closed-loop evaluation intervention analysis LIBERO-Spatial

简要说明：本文分析了GR00T N1.7 VLA策略在LIBERO-Spatial任务中对地标同义词的脆弱性，表明失败可能发生在物体选择或任务完成阶段，并通过对连接器两侧的干预可以修复鲁棒性。强调需要闭环评估并分别评分选择与完成情况来评估改写鲁棒性。

TLDR: This paper analyzes the vulnerability of the GR00T N1.7 VLA policy to landmark synonyms in LIBERO-Spatial tasks, showing that failures can occur either in object choice or task completion, and that interventions on both sides of the vision-language-action connector can repair robustness. It emphasizes the need for closed-loop evaluation and separate scoring of choice and completion to assess rewording robustness.

Abstract: VLA policies are fragile to rewording. Success rates alone cannot say whether a policy fails to choose the object or to complete the task, nor where in the policy to intervene. We study the released GR00T N1.7 on two LIBERO-Spatial tasks differing only in the landmark word telling which of two bowls to take. Synonyms absent from the training instructions send the policy to the bowl they name, unlike made-up words, yet complete 67.6% of one task's closed-loop episodes, against the original word's 100%. Before the connector between the vision-language model and the action generator, replacing only the landmark tokens' vectors with the other landmark's (pasting) sends nearly every episode to the other bowl. After the connector, pasting at the landmark, the remaining instruction, or the image tokens alone rarely moves the choice, but any two do. Hiding the landmark tokens from the action generator after the connector still lowers completion for the synonyms that fall short. Finetuning on diversified landmark words repairs that one task's completion for synonyms absent from finetuning; finetuning on the original instructions does not. Training only the connector on the diversified words suffices, as does copying the connector of a policy fully finetuned on them into one finetuned on the original instructions. An open-loop score on starting frames misses that weights outside the connector also carry part of the repair. For now, on this evidence, robustness to rewording should be judged in closed loop, with actions executed, intervening on both sides of the connector, scoring choice and completion separately.

摘要（中文）：VLA策略对措辞变化非常敏感。仅凭成功率无法判断策略是未能选择正确的对象，还是未能完成任务，也无法确定应在策略的哪一环节进行干预。我们在两个仅在标志性词语上有所不同的LIBERO-Spatial任务上研究了已发布的GR00T N1.7，这两个任务的区别在于指示从两个碗中取哪一个的提示词。训练指令中未出现的同义词会将策略引向其指定的碗，这与生造词的行为不同，但在这类任务的闭环回合中，同义词的完成率为67.6%，而原始词语的完成率为100%。在视觉语言模型与动作生成器之间的连接器之前，仅将标志性词元的向量替换为另一标志物的向量（粘贴操作），几乎使所有回合都转向另一只碗。在连接器之后，仅在标志性词元、剩余指令或图像词元处进行粘贴很少改变选择，但任意两处同时粘贴则会产生显著影响。在连接器之后隐藏标志性词元不让动作生成器看到，仍然会降低那些表现不佳的同义词的完成率。在多样化标志性词语上进行微调，可以修复该任务中对微调中未见同义词的完成率；而在原始指令上进行微调则无法达到此效果。仅对连接器进行多样化词语的训练就已足够，同样，将从已在多样化词语上完全微调的策略中复制连接器，移植到在原始指令上微调的策略中，也能实现修复。在起始帧上的开环评分无法捕捉到连接器之外的权重也承担了部分修复作用。目前，基于这些证据，对措辞变化的鲁棒性应在闭环环境中进行评估，即在执行动作的同时，对连接器两侧进行干预，并分别对选择能力和完成能力进行评分。

Authors: Ryoichi Kurihara, Kota Sunamoto

SemPhys: Semantic-Physical Co-Learning for Humanoid Motion Generation via Differentiable World Models HumanoidEmbodied

humanoid motion generation differentiable world model semantic feedback tracking controller human-robot collaboration

简要说明：SemPhys 通过可微分世界模型和跟踪控制器，利用模拟执行中的语义反馈训练人形运动生成器，使语义评估与实际执行的运动对齐。

TLDR: SemPhys trains humanoid motion generators with semantic feedback from simulated executions, using a differentiable world model and tracking controller to align semantic evaluation with physically executed motion.

Abstract: In human-robot collaboration, natural language lets people direct a humanoid's whole-body movements without programming joint trajectories. A common approach generates a kinematic reference from an instruction and relies on a tracking controller to execute it. However, as the controller maintains balance under contact constraints, the executed motion can depart from the reference in ways that change the action it conveys. Our central insight is that semantic alignment must be evaluated directly on the complete motion the robot physically executes. Building on this insight, we introduce \textbf{SemPhys}, a framework that trains motion generators using semantic feedback from simulated executions. A differentiable world model and a fixed tracking controller predict a short segment of a recorded execution. SemPhys inserts this prediction at its original position, scores the complete trajectory against the instruction, and backpropagates through the predicted segment. A paired anchoring loss stabilizes adaptation by keeping each generated reference close to its counterpart from the initial generator. On BONES-SEED, SemPhys largely preserves instruction retrieval accuracy from reference to execution and achieves the highest retrieval accuracy on executed motions among the evaluated methods.

摘要（中文）：在人机协作中，自然语言使人们无需编程关节轨迹即可引导人形机器人的全身运动。一种常见的方法是从指令生成运动学参考，并依赖跟踪控制器执行该参考。然而，由于控制器在接触约束下维持平衡，实际执行的运动可能偏离参考，从而导致其所传达的动作发生变化。我们的核心见解是，语义对齐必须直接在机器人实际执行的完整运动上进行评估。基于这一见解，我们提出了\textbf{SemPhys}框架，该框架利用模拟执行中的语义反馈来训练运动生成器。一个可微分的世界模型和一个固定的跟踪控制器预测一段记录执行的短片段。SemPhys将该预测插入到其原始位置，根据指令对完整轨迹进行评分，并通过预测片段进行反向传播。配对锚定损失通过保持每个生成的参考接近初始生成器对应的参考，稳定了适应过程。在BONES-SEED上，SemPhys在很大程度上保持了从参考到执行的指令检索精度，并在所评估的方法中取得了最高的执行运动检索精度。
