Authors: Zejian Kang, Yeqiang Wang, Zekai Chen, Boyang Shen, Mingyu Ma, Bingqian Wu, Fan Zhou, Jianjie Zhang, Chentao Shen, Wentao Yang, Rui Qian, Xiangru Huang

JEPA Dots: Dual-Latent World Model for Language-Guided Robot Control Manipulation

dual-latent world model language-guided control flow-matching policy LIBERO instruction-switching

简要说明：JEPA Dots 提出了一种双潜变量世界模型，将动力学与任务表征分离，用于语言引导的机器人控制，在 LIBERO 基准上以更少的参数实现了更高的成功率，并证明了动力学预测对指令变化的不变性。

TLDR: JEPA Dots introduces a dual-latent world model that separates dynamics and task representations for language-guided robot control, achieving superior success rates on LIBERO benchmarks with fewer parameters and demonstrating invariance of dynamics predictions to instruction changes.

Abstract: Predictive world models for language-guided robot control face a fundamental conditioning challenge: instructions should influence action selection without altering the predicted consequences of fixed actions under identical observations. To address this challenge, we introduce JEPA Dots (Dynamics-Oriented Task Separation), a compact dual-latent framework that jointly learns visual dynamics and language-guided control through separate dynamics and task representations. Language-conditioned task features guide a flow-matching policy, while masked attention restricts world prediction to instruction-independent dynamics history and supplied actions. In closed-loop evaluation on 40 trained LIBERO tasks, JEPA Dots achieves 84.9% overall success with approximately 39.1M parameters, compared with the published 78.7% of NanoVLA-S with 161.0M parameters under a different evaluation protocol. In the reference experiment, JEPA Dots also improves overall success from 76.0% for our task-ID-conditioned adaptation baseline to 84.9%, with LIBERO-Goal success increasing from 67.1% to 88.5%. Instruction-switching experiments further confirm that task representations and policy outputs respond to language changes, while dynamics representations and world predictions remain invariant under fixed observations and supplied actions.

摘要（中文）：用于语言引导的机器人控制的预测性世界模型面临一个基本的条件化挑战：指令应当影响动作选择，但在相同观测下不应改变固定动作的预测结果。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了JEPA Dots（面向动态的任务分离），这是一种紧凑的双潜变量框架，通过分离的动态表示与任务表示，联合学习视觉动态与语言引导控制。语言条件化的任务特征引导流匹配策略，而掩码注意力则将世界预测限制在独立于指令的动态历史及给定动作上。在对40个经过训练的LIBERO任务进行的闭环评估中，JEPA Dots以约3910万参数实现了84.9%的整体成功率，而NanoVLA-S在16100万参数规模下，在不同评估协议下已发表的成果为78.7%。在参考实验中，JEPA Dots还将整体成功率从我们以任务ID为条件适配的基线的76.0%提升至84.9%，其中LIBERO-Goal的成功率从67.1%提升至88.5%。指令切换实验进一步确认，任务表示与策略输出能响应语言变化，而动态表示与世界预测在固定观测和给定动作下保持不变。

Authors: Xianhao Pan, Chi Li, Hanchao Li, Yunxin Liu, Jiankai Sun, Luhui Hu

WAM-Policy: World Action Models with On-Policy Distillation for Quadrupedal Loco-Manipulation Manipulation

world action models loco-manipulation distillation reinforcement learning quadrupedal robot

简要说明：WAM-Policy通过跨形态蒸馏和强化学习将世界动作模型适配到四足机器人的移动操控任务，实现了语言条件策略并加速推理，且已在真实机器人上部署。

TLDR: WAM-Policy adapts a world action model to quadrupedal loco-manipulation via cross-morphology distillation and reinforcement learning, enabling language-conditioned policies with faster inference and real-robot deployment.

Abstract: Arm-free quadrupeds can perform loco-manipulation, walking on three legs while manipulating with a front leg, yet no existing policy for it follows language instructions. World action models (WAMs) have emerged as effective language-conditioned manipulation policies, but are pretrained for robot arms and sample slowly. WAM-Policy turns one WAM into a quadrupedal loco-manipulation policy via two stages. The first, Cross-Morphology Policy Adaptation and Acceleration, adapts the arm-centric WAM to quadrupeds and distills the transferred policy into a student with one video and two action steps by on-policy self-distillation (OPSD). This student, however, is bounded by its teacher, which only imitates demonstrations. The second stage, Task-Specific Improvement and Merging, therefore tunes the teacher by reinforcement learning (RL) and merges the slow specialists into one few-step student by multi-teacher on-policy distillation (M-OPD). On QLM-Bench, ten simulated tasks with 1,000 demonstrations synthesized without teleoperation, the transferred policy reaches 77.0%, and the OPSD student keeps 76.7% while sampling 14 times faster. Task-specific RL and M-OPD lift it to 85.0%. We also deploy the OPSD student on a real Unitree Go2 Air. WAM-Policy thus achieves a stronger quadrupedal policy at a fraction of the inference cost.

摘要（中文）：无臂四足机器人能够进行运动-操作（loco-manipulation），即用三条腿行走，同时用一条前腿进行操作，但现有策略均无法遵循语言指令。世界动作模型（WAMs）已成为高效的语言条件化操作策略，但其预训练面向机械臂，且采样速度较慢。WAM-Policy通过两个阶段将世界动作模型转化为四足运动-操作策略。第一阶段为跨形态策略适配与加速（Cross-Morphology Policy Adaptation and Acceleration），将面向机械臂的世界动作模型适配至四足机器人，并通过在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）将迁移后的策略蒸馏为学生模型，仅需一段视频和两个动作步骤。然而，该学生模型受限于其教师模型，后者仅能模仿示范。第二阶段为任务特定改进与融合（Task-Specific Improvement and Merging），通过强化学习（RL）对教师模型进行调优，并利用多教师在线策略蒸馏（M-OPD）将多个低速专家模型融合为少步学生模型。在QLM-Bench基准测试中，面对十个模拟任务及无需遥操作合成的1,000条示范，迁移策略达到77.0%的成功率，而OPSD学生模型在采样速度提升14倍的同时保持了76.7%的成功率。任务特定的强化学习与M-OPD将其进一步提升至85.0%。我们还在真实的Unitree Go2 Air机器人上部署了OPSD学生模型。由此，WAM-Policy在显著降低推理成本的同时实现了更强的四足策略。

Authors: Junlin Long, Xu Deng, Yiran Wang, Yue Yang, Yang Zhao, Zeyu Zhang

LaST1.0: A Unified Latent World-Action Model with Control-Centric SpatioTemporal Reasoning WorldModel

latent world model action-conditioned prediction robotic manipulation control-centric spatiotemporal attention

简要说明：LaST1.0 是一个统一的潜在世界动作模型，用于机器人操作，通过预测来自未来腕部视图的紧凑、几何感知潜目标，采用无视觉编码器设计和 LaST-Attention，在 RLBench、LIBERO 和 LIBERO-Plus 基准上取得了最先进的成功率。

TLDR: LaST1.0 is a unified latent World-Action Model for robotic manipulation that predicts compact, geometry-aware latent targets from future wrist views, using a vision-encoder-free design and LaST-Attention, achieving state-of-the-art success rates on RLBench, LIBERO, and LIBERO-Plus benchmarks.

Abstract: World-Action Models couple action learning with future prediction, enabling robotic policies to capture environmental dynamics for robust control. However, prevailing methods take a reconstruction-oriented approach to model future videos, allocating substantial capacity to appearance details that are incidental to control. In this work, we reformulate world modeling for manipulation as control-centric future prediction in latent space, and present LaST1.0, a unified latent World-Action Model. Rather than modeling an observation-complete video future, LaST1.0 predicts compact, geometry-aware latent targets derived from future wrist views, focusing the supervision on the evolving robot-object interactions required for fine-grained manipulation. To better support this control-centric paradigm, LaST1.0 revisits the visual input interface and attention mechanism of its unified architecture. It adopts a vision-encoder-free design with a lightweight patch embedder, exposing fine-grained visual cues directly to the backbone, and introduces LaST-Attention for structured spatiotemporal interactions across modalities. Evaluations across two robot embodiments, five challenging manipulation tasks, and three simulation benchmarks---RLBench, LIBERO, and LIBERO-Plus---demonstrate that LaST1.0 achieves state-of-the-art success rates and generalizes to novel scenarios. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of control-centric latent world modeling for robust manipulation.

摘要（中文）：世界-动作模型将动作学习与未来预测相结合，使机器人策略能够捕捉环境动态以实现鲁棒控制。然而，现有方法大多采用重建导向的方式对未来视频进行建模，将大量模型容量分配给了与控制无关的外观细节。在本工作中，我们将操作任务的世界建模重新定义为潜空间中以控制为中心的未来预测，并提出了LaST1.0——一个统一的潜空间世界-动作模型。LaST1.0并非建模完整观测的未来视频，而是预测从未来腕部视角提取的紧凑、几何感知的潜目标，将监督信号聚焦于细粒度操作所需的动态机器人-物体交互上。为更好地支撑这一以控制为中心的范式，LaST1.0重新审视了其统一架构的视觉输入接口和注意力机制。它采用无视觉编码器设计，配备轻量级补丁嵌入器，将细粒度视觉线索直接暴露给骨干网络，并引入LaST-注意力机制以实现跨模态的结构化时空交互。在两个机器人实体、五个具有挑战性的操作任务以及三个仿真基准——RLBench、LIBERO和LIBERO-Plus上的评估表明，LaST1.0达到了最先进的成功率，并能泛化到新颖场景。这些结果验证了以控制为中心的潜空间世界建模对鲁棒操作任务的有效性。

Authors: Hao Chen, Xuheng Zhang, Zhuangzhe Wu, Jiaming Liu, Shaobo Zhang, Jialin Gao, Zhonghao Yan, Di Wu, Sixiang Chen, Peng Jia, Chi-Wing Fu, Shanghang Zhang, Pheng-Ann Heng

GTI: Grounding Task Intent Throughout Long-Horizon VLA Manipulation VLA

Long-horizon manipulation Task intent grounding Phase-dependent visual targets Anomaly recovery VLA robotic policy

简要说明：GTI通过定位当前子任务并生成阶段相关的视觉目标，增强长时程VLA操作的任务意图保持能力，并支持异常监控与局部恢复，在RoboCasa365、VLA-Arena和真实机器人任务上显著提升成功率。

TLDR: GTI improves long-horizon VLA manipulation by localizing active subtasks and generating phase-dependent visual targets, enabling intent-consistent execution, anomaly monitoring, and local recovery, with significant success gains on RoboCasa365, VLA-Arena, and real robot tasks.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models generate local actions from visual observations, language, and robot state, but long-horizon manipulation requires the global task intent to remain grounded in the currently executable context. We propose GTI (Grounding Task Intent), which uses the current observation and execution history to localize the active subtask and its execution phase. For the same local subtask, GTI generates two phase-dependent visual targets: an interaction/contact state and a local completion state. The local language instruction and the corresponding phase-specific visual target jointly condition the VLA, specifying both what to do now and what state should be reached at the current phase. During execution, anomaly monitoring and local recovery re-establish an intent-consistent execution context through rollback, re-observation, and phase re-evaluation after persistent deviation. We evaluate GTI on RoboCasa365, VLA-Arena Horizon-Long, and real-world PiPER tasks. Relative to matched Global-FT baselines, GR00T success on seen composite RoboCasa365 tasks increases from 14.6%/12.1% to 31.8%/20.4% under ID/OOD evaluation. On VLA-Arena, GTI+$π_{0.5}$ reaches 47.6% overall success versus 45.2% for an adapted ForeAct baseline, with gains of 5.2/6.0 percentage points on the harder L1/L2 tasks. In the three real-robot task experiments, mean full-task success increases from 21.7% to 59.2%. The results indicate that persistent semantic intent localization and phase-conditioned visual grounding improve multi-stage execution, while failure-triggered local recovery provides additional deployment-time support.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型从视觉观察、语言指令和机器人状态中生成局部动作，但长时程操作要求全局任务意图持续锚定于当前可执行的上下文中。我们提出GTI（任务意图接地，Grounding Task Intent），该方法利用当前观测和执行历史来定位当前活动子任务及其执行阶段。对于相同的局部子任务，GTI生成两个与阶段相关的视觉目标：一个交互/接触状态和一个局部完成状态。局部语言指令与对应的阶段特定视觉目标共同条件化VLA模型，同时明确“当前应执行什么操作”以及“当前阶段应达到何种状态”。在执行过程中，异常监控和局部恢复通过在持续偏差后执行回滚、重新观测和阶段重评估，重建与意图一致的执行上下文。我们在RoboCasa365、VLA-Arena Horizon-Long以及实际PiPER任务上评估了GTI。与匹配的全局微调（Global-FT）基线相比，在ID/OOD评估下，GR00T在已见复合RoboCasa365任务上的成功率从14.6%/12.1%提升至31.8%/20.4%。在VLA-Arena上，GTI+π₀.₅达到47.6%的总体成功率，而适配的ForeAct基线为45.2%，在更具挑战性的L1/L2任务上分别提升了5.2和6.0个百分点。在三项真实机器人任务实验中，平均完整任务成功率从21.7%提升至59.2%。结果表明，持续的语义意图定位和阶段条件化视觉接地能够改善多阶段执行，而基于失败触发的局部恢复则为部署阶段提供了额外支持。

Authors: Tianqi Gong, Haochen Niu, Yusheng Zhao, Lantao Zhang, Haoyu Liu, Rendong Ying, Peilin Liu

ReLoco: Unified Humanoid Locomotion and Fall Recovery via Behavior-Conditioned Motion Priors HumanoidEmbodied

behavior-conditioned motion priors humanoid locomotion fall recovery proprioceptive policy adversarial motion priors

简要说明：ReLoco 提出了一种基于行为条件对抗运动先验的统一人形机器人运动与跌倒恢复策略，在真实人形机器人上实现了鲁棒的起身和指令恢复，无需控制器切换或微调。

TLDR: ReLoco presents a unified humanoid locomotion and fall recovery policy learned with behavior-conditioned adversarial motion priors, achieving robust get-up and command resumption on a real humanoid robot without controller switching or fine-tuning.

Abstract: Humanoid robots must recover from falls and resume commanded motion to sustain locomotion. Learning these behaviors in one policy requires supervision that accommodates both upright movement and ground-contact recovery. We present ReLoco, a framework that uses behavior-conditioned adversarial motion priors to learn locomotion, get-up from arbitrary fallen postures, and command resumption within one proprioceptive policy. During training, robot posture selects the expert pool and conditions a shared discriminator with two behavior-specific outputs. Task rewards and shared regularization support command tracking and recovery, while temporary assistance facilitates exploration. A simulation-based refinement stage supplies robot-executed motion references for this supervision. Ablations examine conditional supervision, output separation, and reference quality under matched settings. At a common training iteration, the full policy achieves $96.80\%$ independent get-up success and $96.96\%$ push-recovery success, including command resumption. Its torso planar velocity root-mean-square error is $0.1266$~m/s, $14.7\%$ lower than the conditional single-output variant, with similar joint-angle discrepancy measured by dynamic time warping. Deployment on the 64.5-kg Tiangong~3.0 humanoid demonstrates walking, running, get-up, and locomotion resumption after falls using one proprioceptive actor, without controller switching or on-robot policy fine-tuning.

摘要（中文）：类人机器人必须能够从跌倒中恢复并重新执行指令运动，以维持其移动能力。在单一策略中学习这些行为，需要一种既能适应直立运动又能适应地面接触恢复的监督机制。我们提出了ReLoco，一种基于行为条件化对抗运动先验的框架，能够在单一本体感觉策略中实现运动、从任意跌倒姿态起身以及指令恢复。在训练过程中，机器人姿态选择专家库，并通过两个行为特定输出对共享判别器进行条件化设置。任务奖励与共享正则化机制支持指令跟踪与恢复，同时，临时辅助机制促进了探索过程。基于仿真的精炼阶段为该监督机制提供了由机器人执行的运动参考。消融研究在匹配设置下考察了条件化监督、输出分离及参考质量的影响。在相同的训练迭代次数下，完整策略实现了$96.80\%$的独立起身成功率和$96.96\%$的抗推恢复成功率（包含指令恢复）。其躯干平面速度均方根误差为$0.1266$~m/s，比条件化单输出变体低$14.7\%$，且通过动态时间规整测量的关节角度差异相似。在重达64.5千克的“天工3.0”人形机器人上进行了部署，验证了在跌倒后仅使用单一本体感觉执行器即可实现行走、跑步、起身及运动恢复，无需控制器切换或机载策略微调。

Authors: Lequn Fu, Yufeng Hu, Yijun Zhong, Jie Zhang, Xiao Li, Lingxiang Ji, Zhiyuan Xu, Jian Tang, Shiqi Li

Navigating Robots from Unknown and Uncalibrated Exocentric Cameras via Map Estimation RLRobot

exocentric cameras obstacle map estimation cross-view transformer PPO navigation zero-shot sim-to-real

简要说明：ROMUX 使机器人能够使用未标定且未知的外置摄像头，通过训练跨视角变换器预测机器人中心的障碍物地图，在仿真中与机器人搭载摄像头的策略成功率相当，并零样本迁移到真实机器人。

TLDR: ROMUX enables a robot to navigate to point goals using uncalibrated and unknown exocentric cameras by training a cross-view transformer to predict robot-centric obstacle maps, matched success rates with robot-mounted camera policies in simulation and transferred zero-shot to real robots.

Abstract: Exocentric cameras, mounted on walls or ceilings in indoor environments, offer wider vantage points and are less easily occluded than robot-mounted cameras, making them an appealing alternative for perception in robot navigation algorithms. Previous methods that use such cameras, however, require their pose and intrinsics to be known before deployment, demanding calibration that is time-consuming, requires specialized personnel, and must be repeated whenever a camera moves or a new room is navigated. We propose Robot-centric Obstacle Maps from Unknown and uncalibrated eXocentric cameras (ROMUX), an agent that navigates a robot toward point goals while avoiding obstacles using exocentric cameras that are both uncalibrated, meaning the system does not require their pose or intrinsic information as input, and unknown, meaning it is not fit to a specific camera during training and does not require pre-deployment fine-tuning. We train a cross-view transformer on large-scale simulation data to predict metric robot-centric obstacle maps from exocentric images, without conditioning image tokens on camera information. A small policy trained with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) then navigates on the predicted maps toward a goal coordinate relative to the robot. We benchmark our agent in simulation with cameras randomized per episode, and it matches the success rates of a PPO policy that navigates from a robot-mounted camera. Further, ROMUX works with one camera or multiple cameras with partial views and has been transferred zero-shot to a real robot using a camera at varying positions and orientations across various room layouts.

摘要（中文）：摘要：在室内环境中，安装于墙壁或天花板上的外部相机相较于机器人搭载的相机，能够提供更广阔的视角，并且更不易被遮挡，因此成为机器人导航算法中感知任务的一个颇具吸引力的替代方案。然而，先前使用此类相机的方法要求在部署前已知其姿态和内部参数，这需要进行耗时且需专业人员操作的标定，且每当相机移动或导航至新房间时，标定工作都需重新进行。我们提出了基于未知且未标定外部相机的机器人中心障碍物地图生成方法（ROMUX），该方法能够利用未标定且未知的外部相机引导机器人向点目标导航并避开障碍物。其中，“未标定”意味着系统无需输入相机的姿态或内部参数信息，“未知”则指该方法在训练时并不针对特定相机进行适配，也无需部署前的微调。我们在大规模仿真数据上训练了一个跨视角变换器，以从外部视角图像中预测以机器人中心的度量障碍物地图，且无需将图像令牌与相机信息绑定。随后，一个通过近端策略优化（PPO）训练的小型策略基于预测的地图，引导机器人向相对其自身的指定目标坐标移动。我们在仿真环境中对智能体进行了基准测试，每轮测试随机化相机参数，结果显示其成功率与基于机器人搭载相机导航的PPO策略相当。此外，ROMUX支持单相机或多相机部分视野的场景，并已在不同房间布局下，通过位置和朝向各异的相机，零样本迁移至真实机器人上成功运行。

Authors: Raul Steinmetz, Raphael Druon, Yusuke Yoshiyasu, Akihisa Ohya, Ayanori Yorozu

LAGR: Language-Aware Grasp Re-Ranking for Task Oriented Grasping Manipulation

task-oriented grasping grasp re-ranking vision-language 5-DoF grasp robot manipulation

简要说明：本文提出LAGR，一种面向任务抓取的语言感知抓取重排序方法，并构建了一个包含268万个抓取标注的大规模数据集。该方法生成任务无关的抓取提议并用语言条件评分器重新排序，在真实Franka机器人上验证了其优越性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces LAGR, a language-aware grasp re-ranking method for task-oriented grasping, along with a large-scale dataset of 2.68 million scored grasp annotations. The method generates task-independent grasp proposals and re-ranks them using a language-conditioned scorer, achieving superior performance and validating on a real Franka robot.

Abstract: Grasping is a fundamental capability for robotic manipulation, with the appropriate grasp depending on the downstream task. For example, a hammer should be held by its handle for hammering but by its head when it is handed over. Selecting such a grasp requires consideration of two criteria: physical feasibility on the object and suitability for the task. Developing such an approach requires dense grasp labels with both feasibility and task scores on real observations, but existing task-oriented grasping datasets are small, synthetic, or costly to annotate. To address this gap, we construct a dataset of 2.68 million scored 5-DoF grasp annotations over 100,911 image-task pairs from $17$ object categories. Additionally, we introduce LAGR, a task-oriented grasp detection method that explicitly addresses both these challenges. Given vision-language inputs, LAGR first generates task-independent grasp proposals along with a physical feasibility score, and then scores the generated grasps with a language-conditioned re-ranker that reasons over all proposals jointly. Experiments show that LAGR outperforms the next best method by 9.3 percentage points. We further validate LAGR on real objects by executing task-oriented grasps with a Franka Research 3 robot.

摘要（中文）：抓取是机器人操作的基本能力，而合适的抓取方式取决于下游任务。例如，锤子用于敲击时应握其柄，而在递送时则应握其头。选择这样的抓取方式需要考虑两个标准：物体上的物理可行性和对任务的适用性。开发此类方法需要在真实观测上获得同时包含可行性和任务评分的密集抓取标签，但现有的面向任务的抓取数据集规模小、为合成数据或标注成本高昂。为弥补这一空白，我们构建了一个包含268万个带评分的5自由度抓取标注的数据集，覆盖来自17个物体类别的100,911个图像-任务对。此外，我们引入了LAGR，一种面向任务的抓取检测方法，明确应对上述两个挑战。给定视觉-语言输入，LAGR首先生成与任务无关的抓取提议及其物理可行性评分，然后通过一个语言条件重排序器对所有提议进行联合推理，对生成的抓取进行评分。实验表明，LAGR比次优方法高出9.3个百分点。我们进一步通过Franka Research 3机器人执行面向任务的抓取，在真实物体上验证了LAGR的有效性。

Authors: Manav Kulshrestha, Shreyans Jain, Apoorva Vashisth, Ankush Gupta, Damon Conover, Aniket Bera

ZERITH V2.5: From Predictive Power to Policy Learnability VLA

video-action model predictive training policy learning video generation LIBERO

简要说明：本文介绍了ZERITH V2.5，一种视频-动作模型，利用视频生成模型的中间特征进行策略学习，并研究了预测训练的监督方式如何影响后续的动作学习，结果表明在多个噪声级别进行适配可以提高控制性能。该策略在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、Meta-World MT50和真实机器人任务上进行了评估。

TLDR: This paper introduces ZERITH V2.5, a video-action model that uses intermediate features of a video generation model for policy learning, and studies how the supervision of predictive training affects subsequent action learning, showing that adapting at multiple noise levels improves control. The policy is evaluated on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, Meta-World MT50, and real-robot tasks.

Abstract: When humans learn to manipulate an unfamiliar object, they may already be able to anticipate how its state will change while still being unable to control it skillfully. This gap between prediction and control motivates us to study how the priors acquired by video generation models can be used effectively by an action policy. We present ZERITH V2.5, a video-action model (VAM) in which the action policy reads intermediate features of a video generation model, and use it to study, under fixed demonstrations and a fixed total number of updates, what kind of predictive training improves subsequent action learning. We find that the way video predictive training is supervised affects subsequent action learning. In our experiments, adapting at many noise levels yields a large gain, while adapting only at the noise level used at deployment yields none. Weight-transfer experiments further show that the gain stays with the adapted weights when they remain in the video generation model and disappears when they are used only to initialize the action policy. Initial loss and gradient measurements at the start of joint training indicate that target-domain predictive training gives the video model a better starting state, making subsequent joint learning of prediction and action easier. Under matched data and training budgets, predictive adaptation improves control. We evaluate the complete policy on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, Meta-World MT50, and real-robot tasks.

摘要（中文）：摘要：人类在学习操控陌生物体时，可能已经能够预见其状态将如何变化，却仍无法熟练地控制它。预测与控制之间的这种差距，促使我们研究如何将视频生成模型所习得的先验知识有效应用于动作策略中。我们提出了ZERITH V2.5，一种视频-动作模型（VAM），在该模型中，动作策略读取视频生成模型的中间特征，并利用该模型在固定演示和固定更新次数的条件下，研究何种预测性训练能够促进后续的动作学习。 我们发现，视频预测训练的方式会影响后续的动作学习效果。在我们的实验中，在多个噪声级别下进行适配能带来显著提升，而仅在部署时使用的噪声级别下进行适配则毫无收益。权重迁移实验进一步表明，当适配后的权重保留在视频生成模型中时，其提升效果得以保持；而当这些权重仅用于初始化动作策略时，提升效果则消失。联合训练初始阶段的损失和梯度测量结果表明，目标域预测训练为视频模型提供了更好的初始状态，使后续预测与动作的联合学习更加容易。在数据和训练预算匹配的条件下，预测性适配改善了对控制的表现。我们在LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、Meta-World MT50以及真实机器人任务上评估了完整策略的性能。

Authors: Chenxi Han, Ruby, Epoch, Orion, Luke, Bin, Dusk, Lyra, Cal, Alvin, Hubert, Alex, Jiahe Han, Tao Zhang, Hang Liu, Shoujie Li, Yizhe Li, Bokui Chen, Houde Liu, Guoping Pan, Yi Cheng

RecallFlow: Episodic Memory as the Source Distribution of Generative Robot Policies Manipulation

flow-matching policy episodic memory memory-dependent manipulation imitation learning visuomotor policy

简要说明：RecallFlow 从情景记忆槽构建流匹配策略的源分布，使生成从记忆目标附近开始，从而改进依赖记忆的操作任务。在 MIKASA-Robo 基准和真实机器人任务上取得了最先进的成功率。

TLDR: RecallFlow constructs the source distribution of a flow-matching policy from episodic memory slots, improving memory-dependent manipulation by starting generation near remembered targets. It achieves state-of-the-art success on the MIKASA-Robo benchmark and real-robot tasks.

Abstract: Diffusion and flow-matching policies have become a standard choice for visuomotor imitation learning, owing to their ability to model multimodal action distributions. In memory-dependent manipulation, the robot must act on information that is no longer visible. Existing methods feed the observation history to the policy as an additional condition, while action generation still starts from Gaussian noise. However, the policy must then pick out the relevant target from a long and redundant history, leading to spurious correlations and unreliable decisions as the memory load grows. Additionally, the initial noise carries no information about what the robot has seen, leaving generation without guidance toward the remembered target. To address these issues, we propose RecallFlow, a flow-policy framework that builds the source distribution from episodic memory. Recall-Relocalization relates the memory to the current view through a few recall slots, so that the source reflects where the remembered targets are now. Recall Anchors then turns each slot into a Gaussian component of the source, enabling generation to start close to the intended action instead of from noise. The transport network then completes the action from the current observation alone, keeping inference nearly as cheap as a memoryless policy. We further build a suite of memory-dependent tasks grouped by memory load and compare all policies under a matched protocol. Extensive experiments show that RecallFlow achieves a state-of-the-art average success rate of 80.4% on the public MIKASA-Robo memory benchmark, and outperforms the strongest baseline by 20.3 points on our suite and by 18.8 points on four real-robot tasks.

摘要（中文）：扩散与流匹配策略已成为视觉运动模仿学习的标准选择，这得益于其能够对多模态动作分布进行建模。在依赖记忆的操作任务中，机器人必须基于不再可见的信息采取行动。现有方法将观测历史作为附加条件输入策略，而动作生成仍从高斯噪声开始。然而，随着记忆负载增加，策略必须从冗长且冗余的历史中挑选出相关目标，这导致了虚假相关性以及不可靠的决策。此外，初始噪声不包含机器人所见信息的任何线索，使得生成过程缺乏对记忆中目标的引导。为解决这些问题，我们提出了RecallFlow——一种从情景记忆构建源分布的流策略框架。回忆-重定位机制通过少量回忆槽将记忆与当前视图关联起来，使源分布能够反映记忆目标当前所在的位置。随后，回忆锚点将每个槽转化为源分布的一个高斯分量，使生成能够从接近预期动作的位置开始，而非从噪声出发。传输网络则仅凭当前观测完成动作生成，使得推理开销几乎与无记忆策略相当低廉。我们进一步构建了一组按记忆负载分类的记忆依赖任务，并在匹配的实验协议下对所有策略进行了比较。大量实验表明，RecallFlow在公开的MIKASA-Robo记忆基准上达到了80.4%的平均成功率，达到了最先进水平，并且在我们构建的任务集上以20.3个百分点的优势超过最强基线，在四组真实机器人任务上则以18.8个百分点的优势胜出。

Authors: Xuji Zhang, Qilin Zhong, Zichen Zhang, Wei Zhai, Jian Di, Kun Li, Yang Cao, Wenjun Lv

Improving While Deployed: Learning Proactive End-to-End Driving from Imperfect Human Takeover Data AutonomousDriving

end-to-end driving human takeover offline post-training trajectory scoring 4D Gaussian splatting

简要说明：本文提出了一种离线后训练框架，将不完美的人类接管数据转化为主动监督，通过轨迹增强和学习评分器提升端到端驾驶模型的闭环性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces an offline post-training framework that converts imperfect human takeover data into proactive supervision for end-to-end driving models, using trajectory augmentation and a learned scorer to improve closed-loop performance.

Abstract: Once deployed on vehicles, end-to-end driving models continuously encounter challenging scenarios, generating valuable human takeover data that capture both model outputs and human behaviors. However, human interventions are often imperfect, as drivers may intervene too late or unnecessarily. Consequently, direct imitation can reinforce late responses or discourage otherwise appropriate maneuvers. To address this challenge, we propose an offline post-training framework that transforms imperfect takeover data into proactive supervision. We first construct diverse trajectory candidates by augmenting the plans of the deployed model and shifting recorded human corrective maneuvers earlier in time. We then train a scene-conditioned trajectory scorer to rank these candidates using expert demonstrations and unpaired preference signals from takeover logs. Using this scorer, we selectively replace pre-takeover training targets with higher-scoring candidates while retaining the original targets in normal driving scenarios. Finally, we distill the resulting targets into the driving model without changing its inference architecture. In closed-loop evaluations using real-world scenarios reconstructed with 4D Gaussian splatting, our method achieves the highest overall success rate, outperforming the deployed model, direct imitation learning and trajectory post-optimization. These results highlight a practical path toward efficient updates of deployed driving models using existing fleet logs.

摘要（中文）：一旦部署到车辆上，端到端驾驶模型会持续遭遇具有挑战性的场景，产生宝贵的人类接管数据，这些数据同时捕捉了模型输出与人类行为。然而，人工干预往往并不完美，驾驶员可能介入过迟或并无必要。因此，直接模仿可能强化延迟反应，或抑制本应合理的操作动作。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了一种离线后训练框架，将不完美的接管数据转化为主动监督信号。我们首先通过增广已部署模型的规划轨迹，并将记录的人类纠正性操作在时间上提前，构建出多样化的轨迹候选集。随后，我们训练一个场景条件化的轨迹评分器，利用专家示范轨迹及来自接管日志的无配对偏好信号对候选轨迹进行排序。借助该评分器，我们选择性地将接管前的训练目标替换为得分更高的候选轨迹，同时在正常驾驶场景中保留原有目标。最后，我们将处理后的目标蒸馏进驾驶模型，且不改变其推理架构。在使用4D高斯泼溅重建的真实世界场景进行的闭环评估中，我们的方法取得了最高的整体成功率，优于已部署模型、直接模仿学习以及轨迹后优化方法。这些结果凸显了一条利用现有车队日志对已部署驾驶模型进行高效更新的实用路径。

Authors: Yangang Ren, Di Zeng, Jun Li, Zirui Li, Chengjiang Zhang, Xiaoqing Ye, Ji Tao, Chen Lv

ExecGap: Exploiting Command-Execution Gap for Patch Attacks on Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

adversarial patch attack VLA models command-execution gap robotic manipulation embodiment-specific vulnerabilities

简要说明：本文提出ExecGap，一种针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的对抗补丁攻击框架，利用预测命令与物理执行之间的差距，通过运动学和动力学弱点降低任务性能，并在仿真和真实机器人上验证。

TLDR: This paper introduces ExecGap, an adversarial patch attack framework for Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models that exploits the gap between predicted commands and their physical execution, degrading task performance through kinematic and dynamic vulnerabilities, with validation in simulation and real robots.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have become a powerful paradigm for robotic manipulation and show strong promise for real-world deployment, making adversarial robustness critical for reliable robot operation. Existing adversarial attacks on VLA-controlled robots mainly optimize prediction-level discrepancies or rollout-level deviations to disrupt manipulation. However, they rarely account for the fact that VLA-predicted commands are not executed directly, but must be realized through downstream control and robot embodiment. In this paper, we propose ExecGap, an adversarial patch attack framework that exploits this command-execution gap to expose embodiment-specific execution vulnerabilities. Specifically, ExecGap biases VLA-predicted task-space commands toward low-executability directions, which are estimated from kinematic inefficiency and dynamic weak actuation. This induces execution degradation, where the predicted command becomes difficult to realize effectively, thereby impairing task completion. Extensive simulation experiments across multiple VLA policies show that ExecGap induces larger command-execution mismatch and weaker realized execution than existing patch attacks. Real-robot experiments further validate that the deployed patch can induce execution degradation on physical platforms.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型已成为机器人操作领域的强大范式，并展现出在真实世界中部署的巨大潜力，这使得对抗鲁棒性对于可靠的机器人运行至关重要。现有针对VLA控制机器人的对抗攻击主要优化预测层面的差异或轨迹层面的偏差以干扰操作任务。然而，这些方法很少考虑到VLA预测的命令并非直接执行，而是必须通过下游控制与机器人本体实现这一事实。本文提出ExecGap——一种利用这种命令-执行间隙来揭示本体特定执行漏洞的对抗补丁攻击框架。具体而言，ExecGap将VLA预测的任务空间命令偏向低可执行性方向，该方向通过运动学低效性和动力学弱驱动能力进行估计。这会导致执行退化，使预测命令难以被有效实现，从而损害任务完成度。跨多种VLA策略的大量仿真实验表明，与现有补丁攻击相比，ExecGap能引发更大的命令-执行失配和更弱的实际执行效果。真实机器人实验进一步验证了部署的补丁能够在物理平台上引发执行退化。

Authors: Keke Tang, Guolin Qiu, Tianyu Hao, Daizong Liu, Yikai Zhang, Peican Zhu, Zhihong Tian

Finetuning VLAs for Dexterous Manipulation: The Right Checkpoint Is All You Need VLA

Vision-Language-Action Dexterous Manipulation Diffusion-Steering RL Supervised Fine-Tuning LEAP Hand

简要说明：本文研究了将监督微调（SFT）与扩散引导强化学习（DSRL）相结合，以仅用少量演示将视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型适配到多指灵巧手上的微调方案。发现冻结视觉-语言模型并完全训练动作专家可获得最易引导的策略，而SFT成功率和DSRL后成功率相关性差。

TLDR: This paper investigates fine-tuning recipes—combining supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with diffusion-steering reinforcement learning (DSRL)—to adapt Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for dexterous multi-finger hands, using only a few demonstrations. It finds that freezing the vision-language model and fully training the action expert yields the most steerable policy, while SFT rollout success is a poor predictor of post-DSRL success.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action models have demonstrated strong manipulation capabilities. A limitation of VLA models is that most manipulation datasets focus on parallel-jaw gripper systems, making transfer to multi-finger hands challenging, particularly as teleoperation datasets are harder to collect with multi-fingered robots. In this work, we study how to best adapt VLAs to dexterous hands by pairing supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with diffusion-steering reinforcement learning (DSRL). Using $π_{0.5}$ and a LEAP hand, we evaluate five fine-tuning recipes across two simulation tasks using only a handful of demonstrations. Our empirical analysis yields three key insights: (1) SFT success is poorly correlated with post-DSRL success, meaning the best SFT checkpoint is rarely the most effective to steer; (2) freezing the vision-language model (VLM) and tuning only the action expert produces the most steerable policy for both training and out-of-distribution placements; and (3) low-rank adaptation (LoRA) is the least steerable approach. Consequently, we recommend an adaptation recipe that freezes the VLM, fully trains the action expert, and eschews SFT rollout success as a checkpoint selection metric.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作模型展现出了强大的操作能力。然而，VLA模型的一个局限性在于，大多数操作数据集主要针对平行夹爪系统，这使得向多指手的迁移充满挑战，尤其是因为多指机器人的遥操作数据集更难收集。在本研究中，我们通过将监督微调与扩散引导强化学习相结合，探讨如何最佳地将VLA模型适配至灵巧手。利用$π_{0.5}$模型和LEAP手，我们在仅使用少量演示的条件下，针对两个模拟任务评估了五种微调方案。我们的实证分析得出了三点关键见解：（1）监督微调的成功率与后续扩散引导强化学习的成功率相关性较弱，这意味着最佳监督微调检查点很少是引导效果最优的选择；（2）冻结视觉-语言模型，仅调整动作专家，能够在训练场景和分布外场景中产生最具可引导性的策略；（3）低秩适配是最不可引导的方法。因此，我们推荐一种适配方案：冻结视觉-语言模型，完全训练动作专家，并放弃以监督微调部署成功率作为检查点选择的指标。

Authors: Artur Kuramshin, Charlotte Cloutier, Michael Przystupa, Kirsty Ellis, Mohammad S. Akhter, Glen Berseth

Radar-Native Control Barrier Functions: Doppler Range Rate as a Measured Barrier Derivative Locomotion

control barrier functions FMCW radar Doppler range rate quadruped robot safe control

简要说明：本文提出了一种新颖的安全控制框架，直接利用FMCW雷达的多普勒测量作为以自我为中心的距离控制障碍函数的导数，消除了对距离变化率重构的需求，并在Unitree Go1四足机器人上展示了更少的安全违规和改进的停止性能。

TLDR: This paper proposes a novel control barrier function framework for safe robot navigation that directly uses FMCW radar Doppler measurements as the derivative of an ego-centered range CBF, eliminating the need for range-rate reconstruction and demonstrating fewer safety violations and improved stopping performance on a Unitree Go1 quadruped.

Abstract: Safe control around dynamic obstacles requires information about both distance and relative motion. Range-based filters commonly reconstruct the required range rate from successive range measurements or from obstacle-state estimators, which can introduce estimator delay or sensitivity to range noise when obstacle motion changes. A frequency-modulated continuous-wave (FMCW) radar measures radial relative velocity directly through Doppler. We use this measurement as the derivative of an ego-centered range control barrier function (CBF) and obtain a closed-form filter on the robot's forward velocity. A measurement margin constructed from sensor error bounds accounts for errors in range, Doppler, ego velocity, and bearing. In 508 paired encounters within the platform's retreat capability, direct Doppler produces two buffer incursions, compared with 15 for a constant-acceleration and 25 for a constant-velocity Kalman filter. On a Unitree Go1, the controller stops at $0.777 \pm 0.015$ m against the predicted $0.758$ m and reacts to a farther approaching object while a nearer static return remains. The guarantee covers the longitudinal range channel under bounded measurement errors and continuously available detections. Direct Doppler removes the need to reconstruct range rate in the safety loop, reducing the delay between a change in obstacle motion and its effect on the safety command.

摘要（中文）：动态障碍物周围的安全控制需要同时获取距离和相对运动信息。基于距离的滤波器通常通过连续的距离测量或障碍物状态估计器来重建所需的距离变化率，这在障碍物运动发生变化时可能引入估计器延迟或对距离噪声的敏感性。调频连续波（FMCW）雷达通过多普勒效应直接测量径向相对速度。我们利用该测量值作为以自我为中心的测距控制障碍函数（CBF）的导数，并获得机器人前向速度的闭式滤波器。由传感器误差界构建的测量裕度用于补偿距离、多普勒、自我速度和方位角中的误差。在平台后退能力范围内的508次配对遭遇中，直接多普勒方法仅产生两次缓冲区侵入，而恒定加速度卡尔曼滤波器和恒定速度卡尔曼滤波器分别产生15次和25次。在Unitree Go1上，控制器在预测停止距离为0.758米的情况下，实际停止距离为0.777±0.015米，并且在存在较近静态回波的同时，能够对更远的接近物体做出反应。该保证在有界测量误差和连续可用检测条件下覆盖纵向距离通道。直接多普勒方法消除了在安全回路中重建距离变化率的必要性，从而减少了障碍物运动变化与其对安全指令产生影响之间的延迟。

Authors: Johannes Mootz, Hesam Mojtahedi, Reza Akhavian

LoRN: Low-Rank Noise Steering for Generative Robot Policies WorldModel

noise steering world-action models low-rank projection reinforcement learning bimanual manipulation

简要说明：本文提出LoRN，一种通过低秩随机投影和范数控制噪声构造将噪声引导扩展到世界动作模型的强化学习方法，在十个模型-任务对上平均成功率提升26.2个百分点，并迁移到物理双臂操作任务。

TLDR: This paper introduces LoRN, a reinforcement learning method that scales noise steering to world-action models via a low-rank random projection and norm-controlled noise construction, improving average success by 26.2 percentage points across ten model-task pairs and transferring to physical bimanual manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Noise steering improves pretrained generative robot policies by learning to select their initial noise without updating model weights. We find that actions in the evaluated world-action models are more sensitive to video noise than action noise, making video noise an expressive input for steering. However, the noise-steering methods we evaluate, in their published forms, struggle to scale to the high-dimensional noise inputs of large policy classes such as world-action models. We introduce Low-Rank Noise Steering (LoRN), a reinforcement learning method that scales noise steering to world-action models. A small steering actor selects a direction through a fixed low-rank random projection, while our norm-controlled construction keeps the resulting noise near the typical scale of a Gaussian sample. This separates the actor's control dimension from the full noise dimension, enabling steering of both video and action inputs. Across three world-action models and ten model-task pairs, video steering improves average success by 26.2 percentage points over the base policy, compared with 7.1 points for DSRL action steering. For smaller action policies, the same construction achieves comparable final success while generally improving early-training success. Steering actors trained in simulation also transfer to three physical bimanual manipulation tasks across two base policies, without additional real-world training.

摘要（中文）：摘要：噪声引导（Noise Steering）通过学习如何选择初始噪声，在不更新模型权重的前提下，提升预训练生成式机器人策略的性能。我们发现，在所评估的世界-动作模型（world-action models）中，动作对视频噪声的敏感性高于对动作噪声的敏感性，这使得视频噪声成为引导中一种具有高表达力的输入。然而，我们所评估的噪声引导方法在其已发表的形式下，难以扩展到高维噪声输入的大规模策略类别，例如世界-动作模型。为此，我们提出了低秩噪声引导（Low-Rank Noise Steering, LoRN），一种将噪声引导扩展至世界-动作模型的强化学习方法。一个轻量级引导智能体通过固定的低秩随机投影选择方向，而我们基于范数控制的构造方式使得最终噪声保持在典型高斯样本的尺度附近。该方法将引导智能体的控制维度与完整噪声维度分离，从而能够同时引导视频输入和动作输入。在三个世界-动作模型及十个模型-任务组合中，视频引导将平均成功率相对于基础策略提升了26.2个百分点，而DSRL动作引导仅提升了7.1个百分点。对于规模较小的动作策略，相同的构造方式可达到相近的最终成功率，同时通常能提升早期训练阶段的成功率。在仿真环境中训练的引导智能体，也能在两个基础策略下迁移至三项物理双臂操作任务，且无需额外的真实世界训练。

Authors: Wei Liu, Abrar Anwar, Huihua Zhao, Soha Pouya, Yan Chang

How Uncertain Is My Action? Self-Correcting Visual Planning with Frozen World Models WorldModel

frozen world model model predictive control shift score self-correction visual planning

简要说明：本文提出一种利用冻结潜世界模型进行自校正视觉规划的方法。通过反向运行模型，对比预测和实际观测来估计执行偏移，并使用偏移分数检测、估计和补偿行动不确定性，提高操作任务和真实机器人实验中的成功率。

TLDR: This paper proposes a self-correcting visual planning method using a frozen latent world model. The model runs in reverse to estimate actuation shift by comparing predicted and actual observations, using a shift score to detect, estimate, and compensate for action uncertainty, improving success rates in manipulation tasks and real robot experiments.

Abstract: A frozen latent world model combined with sampling-based model predictive control is a visual planner. At deployment, the executed action can depart from the commanded one, and the frozen model has no way to notice. We show that the model can be run in reverse: for any hypothesized actuation shift, it predicts what it should have observed under that shift, and comparing this prediction with what was actually observed quantifies the shift and lets the planner correct itself. Unlike the residual energy, which mixes the shift with the model's own error, the score keeps only the part of the residual that a shift can produce. This shift score detects the shift with a locally optimal test, estimates it with Cramer-Rao error bars, names the dominant generator, and compensates the planner once an alarm fires. On PushT, TwoRoom and OGBench-Cube with a frozen latent world model, measured detection follows the prediction to within 0.05 AUROC. Self-correction raises success from 0.650 to 0.862 on PushT and from 0.378 to 0.432 on the harder Cube task, levels with an oracle that is told the true shift at the same block, better than five common test-time adaptation methods. On a real robotic arm, the score identifies a base-joint offset that no joint encoder registers and reduces the reach error from 36 mm to 3-5 mm, and under shifts drawn at random and sealed before the session, estimates recover 92-94% of the error reduction achieved with the true shift. The broader implication is that a frozen world model can act as a filter by predicting the future, testing action-interface uncertainty and validity, and finally correcting failures.

摘要（中文）：一个冻结的潜在世界模型结合基于采样的模型预测控制构成了一种视觉规划器。在部署时，实际执行的动作可能偏离指令动作，而冻结模型对此无法察觉。我们证明该模型可以反向运行：对于任意假设的执行偏移，它预测在该偏移下本应观测到的内容，并将预测结果与实际观测进行对比，从而量化该偏移并使规划器自我修正。与残余能量（将偏移与模型自身误差混在一起）不同，得分仅保留偏移能够产生的残余部分。该偏移得分通过局部最优检验检测偏移，使用Cramér-Rao误差条进行估计，识别主导生成源，并在报警触发后对规划器进行补偿。在PushT、TwoRoom和OGBench-Cube任务中，使用冻结潜在世界模型时，实测检测与预测结果的AUROC差异在0.05以内。自我修正将PushT的成功率从0.650提升至0.862，将更具挑战性的Cube任务成功率从0.378提升至0.432，与在同一数据块上获知真实偏移的预言机水平相当，且优于五种常见的测试时自适应方法。在真实机械臂实验中，该得分识别出关节编码器无法检测的基座关节偏移，并将到达误差从36毫米降至3至5毫米；在会话前随机抽取并封存的偏移条件下，估计恢复量达到真实偏移所实现误差缩减的92%至94%。更广泛的意义在于，冻结世界模型可以通过预测未来、检验动作接口的不确定性和有效性，并最终纠正故障，从而充当一种滤波器。

Authors: Siqing Li, Luming Yang, Yijia Jiao, Junze Deng, Alper Yilmaz

Recoverability, Not Invariance: Certified Safety for Robots at the Limits of Performance AutonomousDriving

recoverability contraction theory safety certification autonomous racecar switching-time program

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于收缩理论的安全概念“可恢复性”，它不要求前向不变性，而是认证机器人重新接入可信恢复模式的能力，从而为激进和习得行为提供正式的安全保证，并在仿真四旋翼飞行和全尺寸自动驾驶赛车极限操控中进行了验证。

TLDR: This paper introduces a contraction-theoretic safety concept called 'recoverability' that certifies a robot's ability to reengage a trusted recovery mode instead of requiring forward invariance, enabling formal safety guarantees for aggressive and learned behaviors. It validates the approach in simulated quadrotor flight and on a full-scale autonomous racecar at the limits of handling in rain.

Abstract: Safety certification in robotics typically rests on forward invariance of the deployed controller, a property that demands high-fidelity models at the edge of the operating envelope, exactly where models are least reliable and robots perform best. As a result, many of the behaviors we most want robots to run, from learned policies to aggressive maneuvers at the limits of traction, cannot be certified at all. We introduce recoverability, a contraction-theoretic safety concept that resolves this tension by certifying a robot's ability to reengage a trusted recovery mode rather than the invariance of a deployed behavior. We prove that switching to the recovery mode from anywhere inside a certified tube guarantees exponential convergence, even under disturbances and model error. To decide when to switch, we derive the contraction insertion gradient, the first-order effect of a recovery insertion on the certificate, and embed it in a switching-time program in which feasibility alone guarantees safety and optimality only shapes performance. To supply the certificates, we develop sequential convex synthesis that monotonically grows the certified tube toward the exact viability kernel. We validate our approach in simulated quadrotor flight through uncertain obstacles, where it outperforms invariance-based safety filters, and in hardware deployments aboard a full-scale IndyNXT autonomous racecar, where it repeatedly recovers the car from an aggressive raceline at the limits of handling in the rain. Recoverability provides a certified exit strategy, extending formal safety guarantees to aggressive, learned, and experimental behaviors without requiring their invariance.

摘要（中文）：安全认证在机器人领域中，通常依赖于所部署控制器的前向不变性，这一性质要求系统在运行包络边缘具备高保真模型，然而恰恰是在这些边缘区域，模型可靠性最低，而机器人的性能表现却最为出色。因此，许多我们最希望机器人执行的行为，从学习策略到在牵引力极限下的激烈机动，根本无法获得认证。我们引入了“可恢复性”这一基于收缩理论的安全概念，通过认证机器人在出现偏离时重新接入可信恢复模式的能力，而非所部署行为的不变性，从而化解了这一矛盾。我们证明，在认证管道的任意位置切换至恢复模式，即使在扰动和模型误差存在的情况下，也能保证指数收敛。为确定切换时机，我们推导了“收缩插入梯度”，即恢复插入对安全证书的一阶影响，并将其嵌入切换时间规划程序中，在该程序中，仅可行性即可保障安全性，而最优性仅用于优化性能。为了提供安全证书，我们开发了序贯凸合成方法，使认证管道单调扩展，直至精确逼近可行核。我们在模拟的四旋翼飞行中，于不确定障碍物环境中验证了该方法，其表现优于基于不变性的安全滤波器；同时，我们在一辆全尺寸IndyNXT自动驾驶赛车的硬件部署中进行了验证，该系统在雨天操控极限下，反复将赛车从激进的赛道路线中成功恢复。可恢复性提供了一种经认证的退出策略，将形式化安全保障扩展至激进型、学习型及实验性行为，而无需要求其具备不变性。

Authors: Thomas A. Berrueta, Joshua D. Ibrahim, Gilchrist X. Johnson, John Lathrop, Soon-Jo Chung

SPICE: Stochastic Policy for Interaction in Cluttered Environments Manipulation

tactile-conditioned diffusion policy contact-rich manipulation cluttered environments visual occlusion agricultural robotics

简要说明：SPICE提出了一种触觉条件扩散策略，使机器人能够在茂密植物冠层中达到目标，展现出95%的树枝操纵成功率及对未见植物的零样本迁移能力。

TLDR: SPICE presents a tactile-conditioned diffusion policy enabling robots to reach targets through dense plant canopies, demonstrating robust performance with 95% branch-manoeuvring success and zero-shot transfer to unseen plants.

Abstract: Agricultural tasks such as harvesting and pruning require robots to reach through dense foliage, where contact is often unavoidable and vision is obstructed. Intermittent contact creates an imbalance between free-space and contact-rich observations, complicating the learning of contact-responsive behaviours. We present SPICE, a tactileconditioned diffusion policy for reaching targets in dense plant canopies using tactile sensing as the sole environmental feedback. SPICE exhibits three behaviours: moving through compliant foliage, manoeuvring around partially obstructing stems, and manipulating branches that block the target path. To the best of our knowledge, SPICE is the first tactile-conditioned diffusion policy for target reaching through physically cluttered plant canopies. Across over 180 real-robot trials, SPICE was evaluated against tactile-conditioned, image-conditioned, and reactive-control baselines. Spatial tactile information and explicit contact conditioning proved important, with SPICE achieving 95% branch-manoeuvring success versus 45% for the strongest tactile baseline. SPICE also achieved branch manipulation beyond the reactive controller and remained effective under visual occlusion, where the image-conditioned DP failed. Zero-shot transfer across 40 trials on unseen tomato and lime plants achieved 87.5% success rate. These results demonstrate the potential of tactile-conditioned generative policies for interaction in visually occluded plant environments.

摘要（中文）：农业任务如采摘和修剪要求机器人在茂密的植物冠层中穿行，这一过程中接触往往不可避免，且视觉会受到遮挡。间歇性的接触导致自由空间与富含接触的观测之间不平衡，增加了学习接触响应对策的复杂性。我们提出了SPICE，一种基于触觉条件的扩散策略，利用触觉感知作为唯一的环境反馈，在密集的植物冠层中实现目标到达。SPICE展现出三种行为：穿过柔顺的叶片、绕过部分阻碍的茎干，以及操控阻挡目标路径的枝条。据我们所知，SPICE是首个针对在物理杂乱的植物冠层中实现目标到达的触觉条件扩散策略。在超过180次真实机器人试验中，SPICE与基于触觉条件、图像条件及反应控制的基线方法进行了对比评估。空间触觉信息和显式的接触条件化被证明至关重要，SPICE在枝条操控上的成功率达95%，而最强触觉基线仅为45%。此外，SPICE还实现了超出反应控制器能力的枝条操控，并在视觉遮挡下保持有效性，而基于图像的扩散策略（DP）在此情境下失效。在未见过番茄和柠檬植株上进行的40次零样本迁移试验中，SPICE达到了87.5%的成功率。这些结果展示了触觉条件生成策略在与视觉遮挡植物环境交互中的潜力。

Authors: Nidhi Parayil, Benjamin Greenland, Thierry Peynot, Chris Lehnert

Learning the Dynamics of Deformable Linear Objects Through Coupled Oscillators for Bimanual Robotic Manipulation Manipulation

coupled oscillator networks deformable linear objects bimanual manipulation model-based control Lagrangian dynamics

简要说明：本文提出 Φ-CON，结合耦合振荡器网络与学习到的微分同胚来建模可变形线性物体的力驱动动力学，并据此设计基于模型的PD控制器，在减少参数的同时提升双臂操控精度并保证闭环稳定性。

TLDR: This paper introduces Φ-CON, a coupled oscillator network with a learned diffeomorphism for modeling force-driven dynamics of deformable linear objects, and uses it to design a model-based PD controller that improves bimanual manipulation accuracy while reducing parameters and enabling closed-loop stability guarantees.

Abstract: Many learning-based approaches for deformable linear objects (DLOs) rely on simplified deformation models that neglect dynamic effects and the mechanical response of the objects, limiting their applicability to lightweight, compliant objects and slow motions. Inspired by recent advances in learning physically structured dynamics with coupled oscillator networks (CONs), we propose $Φ$-CON for learning force-driven DLO dynamics. The model combines a floating-base coupled oscillator network (FBCON), whose latent potential energy depends only on the DLO's shape, with a learned affine diffeomorphism $Φ$ between observed positions along the DLO and latent coordinates. Its shape dynamics are stable by construction, and its Lagrangian structure yields explicit expressions for kinetic and potential energy. We exploit this structure to design a model-based proportional-derivative (PD) controller that compensates for the learned potential forces, thereby establishing closed-loop stability guarantees and ensuring convergence. We evaluate the approach on four simulated DLOs and a real bimanual robot setup. In simulation, $Φ$-CON achieves prediction accuracy comparable to neural ordinary differential equation (NODE) models and Lagrangian neural networks (LNNs), with $97.2\%$ and $90.2\%$ fewer parameters, respectively. Relative to a model-free PD baseline, the proposed controller reduces mean endpoint regulation error by $97.5$-$99.7\%$ in simulation and achieves a mean per-target reduction of $27.9\%$ across both endpoints in real-world experiments, demonstrating the importance of explicitly accounting for the mechanical response of stiff and heavy objects.

摘要（中文）：许多基于学习的方法在处理可变形线性物体（DLOs）时，往往依赖忽略动态效应及物体力学响应的简化形变模型，这限制了其在轻质、柔顺物体及缓慢运动场景中的适用性。受近期利用耦合振荡器网络（CONs）学习物理结构化动力学进展的启发，我们提出了$Φ$-CON方法，用于学习力驱动的DLO动力学。该模型将浮基耦合振荡器网络（FBCON）——其潜在势能仅依赖于DLO的形状——与一个学习得到的仿射微分同胚$Φ$相结合，该微分同胚将DLO上的观测位置映射至潜在坐标。其形状动力学在构造上具有稳定性，且其拉格朗日结构为动能和势能提供了显式表达式。我们利用这一结构设计了一个基于模型的比例-微分（PD）控制器，该控制器可补偿学习所得的势能力，从而建立闭环稳定性保证并确保收敛。我们在四个仿真DLO及一个真实双臂机器人平台上评估了该方法。在仿真中，$Φ$-CON达到了与神经常微分方程（NODE）模型及拉格朗日神经网络（LNNs）相当的预测精度，同时参数数量分别减少了$97.2\%$和$90.2\%$。相对于无模型的PD基线，所提出的控制器在仿真中将平均端点调节误差降低了$97.5$-$99.7\%$，在真实实验中则使两个端点的平均每目标误差降低了$27.9\%$，这凸显了显式考虑刚硬及重型物体力学响应的重要性。

Authors: Iván López-Broceño, Maximilian Stölzle, Daniel Feliu-Talegon, Daniela Rus, Cosimo Della Santina

Multimodal Masked Diffusion Autoencoder for Modeling Impaired Driving AutonomousDriving

masked-diffusion autoencoder impairment detection driving simulator gaze and trajectory prediction multimodal self-supervised learning

简要说明：本文提出了ID-MAE，一种多模态掩码扩散自编码器，通过自监督目标改进驾驶中的损伤检测，并引入了新的驾驶模拟器数据集（DIVERT），包含109名参与者在十种认知、视觉和情绪损伤诱导下的103小时数据。该模型重构掩码的注视和轨迹以增强损伤推断，在DIVERT上配对AUC显著提升，并在轨迹和注视预测任务中表现优异。

TLDR: This paper introduces ID-MAE, a multimodal masked-diffusion autoencoder with a self-supervised objective to improve impairment detection in driving, using a new driving-simulator dataset (DIVERT) with 103 hours of data from 109 participants across ten cognitive, visual, and emotional impairment inductions. The model reconstructs masked gaze and trajectory to boost impairment inference, achieving significant improvements in paired AUC for impairment detection on DIVERT and enabling strong results in trajectory and gaze prediction.

Abstract: Human cognitive state (e.g., distraction, stress), gaze, and behavior interact with the driving environment in subtle ways that AI could use to assist drivers, but ground-truth labels for human cognitive state levels are costly to obtain at scale. We propose a multimodal masked-diffusion autoencoder, ID-MAE, that adds a self-supervised objective to impairment prediction: alongside predicting the impairment label as a masked token, it reconstructs masked gaze and trajectory. To probe the effects of different modalities and types of impairments on model inference, we introduce DIVERT, a driving-simulator dataset containing 103 hours of driving data (n = 109) with ten impairment inductions spanning cognitive, visual, and emotional states, recorded with gaze, vehicle state, and scene video. We demonstrate how ID-MAE affords significant improvements in impairment inference results on both the DIVERT dataset and existing datasets, and enables strong results in additional tasks, such as trajectory and gaze prediction. For location-matched pairs, our model achieves a paired AUC of 0.706 for impairment detection on DIVERT, compared to 0.590 without reconstruction loss, improving over existing baselines. We probe the design space in terms of input modalities, masking scheme, positional encoding, attention mechanism, and decoding. We also investigate the interaction between various impairments in training and inference, demonstrating that visually demanding distractions are separable from cognitive distractions. Code and data will be available upon acceptance.

摘要（中文）：人类认知状态（如分心、压力）、注视和行为与驾驶环境以微妙的方式相互作用，人工智能可利用这些信息辅助驾驶员，但在大规模范围内获取人类认知状态水平的真实标签成本高昂。我们提出了一种多模态掩码扩散自编码器ID-MAE，为损伤预测增加了自监督目标：在将损伤标签作为掩码令牌进行预测的同时，它还重建被掩码的注视和轨迹。为探究不同模态和损伤类型对模型推理的影响，我们引入了DIVERT——一个驾驶模拟器数据集，包含103小时驾驶数据（n = 109），涵盖认知、视觉和情绪状态的十种损伤诱导条件，并记录了注视、车辆状态和场景视频。我们展示了ID-MAE如何在DIVERT数据集及现有数据集上显著提升损伤推理结果，并在轨迹预测和注视预测等附加任务中取得优异表现。对于位置匹配的样本对，我们的模型在DIVERT上的损伤检测配对AUC达到0.706，而无不重建损失的基线为0.590，优于现有基线。我们从输入模态、掩码方案、位置编码、注意力机制和解码等方面探析了设计空间。我们还研究了不同损伤在训练和推理中的交互作用，证明视觉高负荷分心与认知分心是可区分的。代码和数据将在论文录用后公开。

Authors: John Gideon, Anshul Gupta, Megan Applegate-Kenton, Kayli Battel, Todd J Rowell, Patricio Reyes Gomez, Laporsha Dees, Emily Sumner, Avinash Balachandran, Guy Rosman

F$^3$: What Makes Good Experience in World-Action Models? WorldModel

World-Action Models experience selection policy learning MolmoSpaces RoboLab

简要说明：本文提出了F3方法，用于世界动作模型(WAMs)更好地利用自身经验，通过形式(Form)、适合度(Fit)和融合(Fusion)三个决策来压缩、预测和注入经验记录，在具身AI基准上取得了最优结果。

TLDR: This paper introduces F3, a method for world-action models (WAMs) to better leverage their own experience by making three decisions about Form (compressing rollouts into verified records), Fit (predicting when a record is helpful), and Fusion (injecting record data as prefix and action prior), achieving state-of-the-art results on embodied AI benchmarks.

Abstract: Deployed world-action models (WAMs) can keep improving only if they make good use of their own experience. Existing methods supply retrieved rollouts or demonstrations to the policy as context, yet such experience often turns previously solved tasks into failures. What, then, makes good experience for a WAM? We show that experience is valuable only in use: its value depends not on whether the source rollout succeeded but on what is stored, when it is used, and where it enters the policy. We therefore propose F$^3$, which makes these three decisions with Form, Fit, and Fusion. Form compresses successful and failed rollouts alike into short, verified operation records; Fit teaches the policy to read a record and to predict when it helps; Fusion injects the record's images, text and actions into the policy as a prefix and an action prior. Trained once on only 200 examples and deployed with a growing experience library, the model achieves state-of-the-art results on MolmoSpaces and RoboLab without any training on RoboLab: over native Cosmos 3 Nano, it raises success by 12.0 pp and 10.8 pp, reduces steps to success by 12.2% and 11.3%, and cuts regressions by 57%.

摘要（中文）：已部署的世界行动模型（WAMs）唯有善用自身经验方能持续改进。现有方法将检索到的轨迹或演示作为上下文提供给策略，然而此类经验常常使原本已解决的任务重新失败。那么，对于WAM而言，何种经验才算优质？我们表明，经验的价值仅体现在使用之中：其价值并不取决于源轨迹是否成功，而取决于存储内容、使用时机以及进入策略的位置。为此，我们提出F$^3$，通过形式（Form）、适配（Fit）与融合（Fusion）三项决策来应对上述问题。形式模块将成功与失败的轨迹同样压缩为简短且经过验证的操作记录；适配模块训练策略阅读记录并预测其何时能提供帮助；融合模块将记录的图像、文本和动作作为前缀及动作先验注入策略。该模型仅基于200个示例训练一次，并随经验库的增长进行部署，在MolmoSpaces和RoboLab上均取得了最先进的成果，且无需在RoboLab上进行任何训练：相较于原生Cosmos 3 Nano，成功率分别提升12.0个百分点和10.8个百分点，达到目标的步数分别减少12.2%和11.3%，性能回退现象减少57%。

Authors: Zihe Huang, Sirui Zhou, Haozhi Han, Ruge Zhang, Teng Ma, Tao Ma, Zheng Liu, Ce Zhang, Ting Cao, Yunxin Liu, Yunquan Zhang, Yifeng Chen, Kun Li

Risk-Triggered Search: Behavior-Preserving Safe Control WorldModel

JEPA world models safe control risk-triggered search cross-entropy method safe arrival rate

简要说明：论文提出了风险触发搜索（RTS），利用冻结的JEPA世界模型和轻量级风险头仅在必要时触发安全控制搜索，在保持名义行为的同时提高安全性并降低计算量。

TLDR: The paper introduces Risk-Triggered Search (RTS), a method that uses frozen JEPA world models and a lightweight risk head to trigger safe control searches only when necessary, preserving nominal behavior and improving safety with lower computation.

Abstract: Pre-trained visual world models generate multi-step action plans from current and goal observations, yet terminal-proximity objectives fail to prevent forbidden-zone traversal or rigid-body collision sliding. Purely visual interfaces may lack analytical dynamics, structured states, or explicit collision geometry, requiring internal prediction of action-conditioned process risk. We propose Risk-Triggered Search (RTS) for frozen Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) world models. Rather than relying on static state features that cannot distinguish candidate plans sharing an observation, RTS unrolls action-conditioned future latent prefixes in the frozen world model and trains a lightweight risk head with process-violation supervision. To intervene selectively while preserving safe nominal behavior, RTS uses the same predicted prefix-risk criterion as both the search trigger gate and hard feasibility gate: safe nominal plans execute directly, whereas alarms trigger local Cross-Entropy Method (CEM) search to minimize nominal deviation within the feasible set. To prevent isotropic Euclidean minimal modification from shrinking obstacle-directed actions into zero-amplitude stalling, we introduce an amplitude-preserving metric $d_{\mathrm{AP}}$ that retains tangential progression while maintaining a unique zero at the nominal plan. Under unified gating and this unique-zero condition, bypassing safe-state search yields closed-loop trajectories strictly identical to every-step same-kernel search. Evaluated under a process-safety benchmark and Safe Arrival Rate (SAR) metric across five tasks, RTS improves SAR over Direct by 12.67--41.67 percentage points on navigation and articulated control and +2.08/+4.17 pp on Cube/PushT boundary cohorts, maintaining 100% action identity with every-step search while cutting controller time by 17.71%--70.41% across 1,968 paired trajectories.

摘要（中文）：预训练视觉世界模型能够根据当前观测与目标观测生成多步动作规划，然而，基于终点邻近度的目标函数无法有效防止禁区穿越或刚体碰撞滑动等问题。纯视觉接口可能缺乏解析动力学、结构化状态或显式碰撞几何信息，因此需要内部预测基于动作的条件化过程风险。我们针对冻结的联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）世界模型提出了风险触发搜索（RTS）方法。不同于依赖无法区分共享同一观测的候选规划的静态状态特征，RTS 在冻结的世界模型中展开基于动作的条件化未来潜在前缀，并通过过程违规监督训练一个轻量级风险头。为了在保持安全标称行为的同时进行选择性干预，RTS 将同一预测前缀风险准则同时用作搜索触发门控和硬可行性门控：安全标称规划直接执行，而报警则触发局部交叉熵方法（CEM）搜索，以在可行集内最小化标称偏差。为了避免各向同性的欧几里得最小修正将避障导向动作压缩为零幅停滞，我们引入了一个保幅度量 $d_{\mathrm{AP}}$，该度量在保持切向进展的同时，在标称规划处维持唯一零点。在统一门控及该唯一零点条件下，绕过安全状态搜索所得的闭环轨迹与逐步同核搜索的轨迹严格一致。在过程安全基准和五项任务的安全到达率（SAR）指标评估下，RTS 在导航与铰接控制任务上相比 Direct 方法将 SAR 提升了 12.67–41.67 个百分点，在 Cube/PushT 边界任务组上分别提升了 +2.08/+4.17 个百分点，同时在与逐步搜索的动作一致性保持 100% 的前提下，在 1,968 条配对轨迹上将控制器耗时减少了 17.71%–70.41%。

Authors: Xinyu Deng, Bohao Lan, Kunpeng Li, Mingkai Yuan, Weihang Pan, Binbin Lin

FedE2E: One-Shot Federated Learning for End-to-End Autonomous Driving with Closed-Loop Evaluation AutonomousDriving

one-shot federated learning end-to-end autonomous driving feature alignment consensus distillation closed-loop evaluation

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于端到端自动驾驶的单次联邦学习方法，通过多客户端校准、基于锚点的特征对齐和标记级共识蒸馏，在Bench2Drive闭环评估中取得了优于现有方法的性能。

TLDR: The paper proposes a one-shot federated learning method for end-to-end autonomous driving that uses multi-client calibration, anchor-based feature alignment, and token-wise consensus distillation, and demonstrates superior performance in closed-loop evaluation on Bench2Drive.

Abstract: Federated learning enables collaborative model training without sharing datasets. However, existing federated learning methods for autonomous driving typically require multi-round communication and lack closed-loop evaluation, while one-shot methods mainly focus on perception tasks. To address these limitations, we propose \method, a one-shot federated learning method for end-to-end autonomous driving. It comprises multi-client calibration, anchor-based feature alignment, and token-wise consensus distillation to distill knowledge from heterogeneous models. Closed-loop evaluation on Bench2Drive demonstrates the effectiveness of \method in both one-shot and multi-round federated learning. In the one-shot setting, it achieves a Driving Score of 55.85, which is 4.07 points higher than prior work. In the multi-round setting, it reaches 60.35 after five communication rounds, the best performance among all compared methods under the same number of communication rounds.

摘要（中文）：联邦学习使得在不共享数据集的情况下进行协作模型训练成为可能。然而，现有的面向自动驾驶的联邦学习方法通常需要多轮通信，且缺乏闭环评估，而单次学习方法主要聚焦于感知任务。为解决这些局限性，我们提出了\method，一种面向端到端自动驾驶的单次联邦学习方法。该方法包括多客户端校准、基于锚点的特征对齐以及逐令牌共识蒸馏，以从异构模型中提取知识。在Bench2Drive上的闭环评估验证了\method在单次和多轮联邦学习中的有效性。在单次设定下，其驾驶评分为55.85，比现有工作高出4.07分。在多轮设定下，经过五轮通信后达到60.35，在相同通信轮次下所有对比方法中表现最佳。

Authors: Tao Lian, Antonio M. López

Freeforward4d: Annotation-free feed-forward 4d reconstruction of driving scenes AutonomousDriving

4D reconstruction driving scenes annotation-free RGB-only metric depth

简要说明：FreeForward4D 通过将预训练视觉模型预测的相机、深度和物体轨迹统一到单一度量坐标系中，实现了无需标注的驾驶场景4D重建，在渲染保真度上达到领先水平。

TLDR: FreeForward4D performs annotation-free 4D reconstruction of driving scenes from RGB videos by reconciling pretrained visual model predictions (cameras, depth, object tracks) into a single metric frame, achieving state-of-the-art rendering fidelity without dataset annotations.

Abstract: Feed-forward 4D reconstruction enables efficient creation of renderable driving scenes for autonomous driving simulation. However, most existing methods rely heavily on dataset-provided cameras, LiDAR depth, or 3D box annotations, limiting their applicability to unannotated driving videos. Pretrained visual models can predict cameras, depth, and object tracks from RGB alone, but their geometry is mutually inconsistent: multi-view predictions come in short windows with independent scales and frames, while monocular depth is metric only per image. Our key insight is that, once reconciled into a single metric frame, these priors can replace dataset annotations for feed-forward 4D reconstruction. We present \textbf{FreeForward4D}, which calibrates overlapping prediction windows against monocular metric depth and registers them into one frame across time. On this geometry, 2D tracks are associated across cameras in 3D, and objects move through hierarchical motion that combines a shared object velocity with local Gaussian corrections, so that both training and inference use only RGB videos. On Waymo, FreeForward4D achieves 27.66 dB PSNR and 0.836 SSIM while recovering metric-scale cameras and depth without scale alignment. It surpasses STORM, SLARM-F, UFO, DGGT, and StreetForward, which rely on dataset annotations, in full-image PSNR and attains the best RGB fidelity on 8-second windows. RGB-only fine-tuning further adapts the framework to nuScenes and Argoverse 2. Code will be released.

摘要（中文）：前馈4D重建技术能够高效生成可渲染的驾驶场景，用于自动驾驶仿真。然而，现有大多数方法严重依赖数据集提供的相机参数、激光雷达深度或3D框标注，限制了其在无标注驾驶视频上的适用性。预训练视觉模型可以仅从RGB图像预测相机参数、深度和物体轨迹，但其几何信息相互不一致：多视角预测以短窗口形式出现，且各窗口尺度独立、坐标系不同，而单目深度仅在单张图像内具有度量意义。我们的关键洞见在于，一旦将这些先验信息统一到同一度量坐标系中，它们即可替代数据集标注用于前馈4D重建。我们提出了\textbf{FreeForward4D}，该方法将重叠的预测窗口与单目度量深度进行校准，并将其配准到统一的时间坐标系中。在此几何框架下，2D轨迹在3D空间中跨相机关联，物体通过结合共享物体速度与局部高斯修正的分层运动模型进行移动，从而使得训练和推理仅需RGB视频输入。在Waymo数据集上，FreeForward4D达到了27.66 dB的PSNR和0.836的SSIM，同时无需尺度对齐即可恢复度量尺度的相机参数和深度。在全图PSNR指标上，它超越了依赖数据集标注的STORM、SLARM-F、UFO、DGGT和StreetForward方法，并在8秒时间窗口上取得了最佳的RGB保真度。仅使用RGB数据的微调进一步使该框架适应于nuScenes和Argoverse 2数据集。代码将开源发布。

Authors: Luosong Guo, Xiang Yang, Chaoyang Li, Ao Gao, Jiangming Shi, Yanyun Qu, Zhizhong Zhang, Jingyu Gong, Yuan Xie

GRID-UAV: Geometry and Ray-depth Integrated Decision-making for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles VLA

Vision-Language-Action models UAV navigation 3D grounding depth lifting multi-view geometry alignment

简要说明：GRID-UAV通过将显式的射线校正3D深度提升与训练期间隐式的多视角几何特征对齐相结合，增强了基于VLA的无人机导航，在TravelUAV基准上提高了任务成功率。

TLDR: GRID-UAV enhances VLA-based UAV navigation by combining explicit ray-corrected 3D depth lifting with implicit multi-view geometry feature alignment during training, improving task success on the TravelUAV benchmark.

Abstract: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) encode images with 2D encoders that capture little 3D structure. A common approach is to feed the policy estimated depth, but a UAV chooses its own altitude, must judge distances tens of meters away, where monocular depth is less reliable, and must relate its forward and downward views. On long aerial routes, adding depth features directly brings no significant gain (42.5% vs. 42.6% success), so we study how 3D information should be given to the policy. Analyzing flight failures, we find that two forms of 3D grounding fail in opposite ways: explicit 3D lifting of depth collides less on the way but more often fails to finish at the target, while implicit alignment with a 3D geometry model finishes more often but collides more. We propose GRID, which combines both: (1) it lifts monocular depth into ray-corrected 3D positions in the UAV's frame for both cameras, and (2) during training only, it aligns its visual features with a frozen multi-view geometry model, at no inference cost. GRID adding explicit lifting to implicit alignment significantly increases how often the policy reaches the target ($61.5\% \rightarrow 69.5\%$, $p<0.001$), and adding implicit alignment to explicit lifting significantly increases how often it completes the task once there ($57.7\% \rightarrow 61.4\%$, $p<0.05$). On TravelUAV (3,005 test episodes), GRID achieves the best success rate on every split, with relative gains over the state of the art of 9.5% (seen), 17.1% (unseen objects) and 25.4% (unseen map).

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）使用二维编码器对图像进行编码，而这类编码器仅能捕获极少的三维结构信息。常见做法是向策略模型输入估计的深度图，但无人机需自行选择飞行高度，必须判断数十米外的距离，而单目深度估计在此距离下可靠性下降，同时还需关联前视与下视两个视角的观测。在长距离空中航线上，直接添加深度特征并未带来显著提升（成功率42.5%对42.6%），因此我们研究了三維信息应如何提供给策略模型。通过分析飞行失败案例，我们发现两种三维信息注入方式以相反方式失效：显式三维提升（将深度提升至三维空间）在飞行途中碰撞较少，但更常无法抵达目标；而隐式对齐三维几何模型则更常完成到达，但碰撞更多。我们提出GRID方法，结合两者优势：（1）将单目深度提升为无人机机体坐标系下经射线校正的三维位置，应用于两个相机；（2）仅在训练阶段，将其视觉特征与冻结的多视角几何模型对齐，推理时零额外开销。GRID在隐式对齐基础上加入显式提升，显著提高了策略到达目标的概率（61.5%提升至69.5%，p<0.001）；在显式提升基础上加入隐式对齐，显著提高了到达后完成任务的成功率（57.7%提升至61.4%，p<0.05）。在TravelUAV基准（3,005个测试回合）上，GRID在所有划分上均取得最佳成功率，相较于现有最优方法的相对提升分别为9.5%（已知场景）、17.1%（未知物体）和25.4%（未知地图）。

Authors: Anas Anwarul Haq Khan, Amrin Kareem, Muhammad Umer Sheikh, Biplab Banerjee, Muhammad Haris Khan

Planner-Controller Interaction for Ackermann Navigation: A Matched Simulation and Hardware Benchmark AutonomousDriving

Ackermann navigation planner-controller interaction sim-to-real gap path tracking benchmark

简要说明：本文在仿真和真实的1/10比例阿克曼转向车辆上对规划器-控制器组合进行了基准测试，发现控制器排名在仿真和硬件间一致，但规划器相关效应不一致，强调了物理验证的重要性。

TLDR: This paper benchmarks planner-controller combinations for Ackermann navigation on both simulated and real 1/10-scale vehicles, finding that controller ranking transfers well but planner-dependent effects do not, emphasizing the need for physical validation.

Abstract: Global planners and path-tracking controllers are often evaluated independently, although their interaction determines how a vehicle follows a planned path. Whether simulation accurately predicts the performance of specific planner-controller combinations on Ackermann-steered hardware remains uncertain. This study evaluated three geometric controllers (Regulated Pure Pursuit, Stanley, and Vector Pursuit) paired with two global planners (Hybrid A* and NavFn) on a 1/10-scale Quanser QCar and in a matched Gazebo simulation. Both environments used shared custom planning and control algorithms, matched route geometry and goals, ground-truth pose references, and a common evaluation pipeline. Five runs per configuration and environment yielded 60 benchmark runs. Controller rankings for tracking accuracy and command smoothness transferred consistently between environments, with Spearman correlations of 0.77-0.94. However, planner-dependent effects showed substantially weaker agreement. In simulation, planner selection changed the root-mean-square (RMS) angular acceleration of the commanded velocities by no more than 0.030 rad/s^2, whereas Hybrid A* increased it by 0.141-0.843 rad/s^2 on hardware, depending on the controller. These differences coincided with planner-dependent achieved speeds that the simulation's idealised longitudinal response did not reproduce. Mean controller computation times remained below 0.5 ms on the Jetson TX2. The findings demonstrate that agreement in controller rankings does not guarantee accurate prediction of planner-dependent performance for specific controller pairings on hardware, highlighting the importance of physical validation.

摘要（中文）：全局规划器与路径跟踪控制器通常是独立评估的，然而二者的交互方式决定了车辆如何沿规划路径行驶。仿真能否准确预测特定规划器-控制器组合在阿克曼转向硬件上的性能，目前尚无定论。本研究在1/10比例的Quanser QCar及其对应的Gazebo仿真环境中，评估了三种几何控制器（Regulated Pure Pursuit、Stanley和Vector Pursuit）与两种全局规划器（Hybrid A*和NavFn）的组合性能。两种环境均使用相同的自定义规划与控制算法、匹配的路线几何与目标点、真值位姿参考以及统一的评估流程。每种配置和环境各执行5次运行，共计60次基准测试。控制器在跟踪精度和指令平滑度方面的排名在两种环境间保持一致性，Spearman相关系数为0.77–0.94。然而，与规划器相关的效应在两种环境间的一致性明显较弱。在仿真中，规划器的选择使指令速度的均方根角加速度变化不超过0.030 rad/s²，而在硬件上，Hybrid A*根据控制器的不同，该指标增加了0.141–0.843 rad/s²。这些差异与依赖规划器的实际行驶速度有关，而仿真中理想化的纵向响应未能复现这一现象。在Jetson TX2上，控制器的平均计算时间均低于0.5 ms。研究结果表明，控制器排名的跨环境一致性并不能保证对特定控制器与硬件上规划器相关性能的准确预测，从而凸显了物理验证的重要性。

Authors: Moaiz Saeed, Marah Saleh, Mounis Shawgi, Mohamed Al Musleh

Hierarchical Admittance-Impedance Control for Mobile Manipulator Load Transfer Manipulation

admittance-impedance control mobile manipulator load transfer human-robot interaction workspace-aware assistance

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于移动机械臂的分层导纳-阻抗控制器，实现了人力引导的负载转移，并通过行李箱转移实验验证了其有效性。

TLDR: This paper presents a hierarchical admittance-impedance controller for mobile manipulators, enabling human-guided load transfer with compliant load support and workspace-aware base assistance, validated on a suitcase transfer task.

Abstract: This paper presents a hierarchical admittance-impedance controller that combines an inner Cartesian impedance controller, an outer 6D admittance supervisor, and workspace-aware mobile-base assistance for guided load transfer. The method is motivated by assistive tasks such as airport baggage handling, where a robot should support a payload while a human worker guides its motion through small physical forces. Following an interaction-role interpretation of admittance and impedance, the torque-controlled Franka Research 3 manipulator behaves as a Cartesian impedance at the robot-object interface, providing compliant load support around a commanded equilibrium pose. At the human-facing interaction level, the outer admittance supervisor converts measured human wrench input into smooth Cartesian reference motion. The workspace-aware assistance layer shares the admittance-generated translational motion between the manipulator and a velocity-controlled base when larger motion is required, while front-side load alignment keeps the carried object near the robot's frontal region for safer and more intuitive guidance. The system was implemented in ROS and validated through a suitcase transfer experiment, showing that the robot can support the load while allowing the human to guide the transfer with relatively little effort.

摘要（中文）：本文提出了一种分层导纳-阻抗控制器，该控制器结合了内环笛卡尔阻抗控制、外环六维导纳监管机制以及具有工作空间感知能力的移动底座辅助功能，用于实现引导式载荷搬运。该方法的提出源于机场行李处理等辅助任务场景，在此类任务中，机器人需承载载荷，同时允许操作人员通过施加较小的物理力来引导其运动。依据导纳与阻抗的交互角色解释，力矩控制的Franka Research 3机械臂在机器人-物体界面处表现为笛卡尔阻抗，在指令平衡位姿周围提供柔顺的载荷支撑。在面向操作人员的交互层面，外环导纳监管器将测得的人机交互力/力矩输入转换为平滑的笛卡尔参考运动。工作空间感知辅助层在需要较大范围运动时，将导纳生成的平移运动在机械臂与速度控制底座之间进行分配，同时通过前侧载荷对中功能使所搬运物体保持在机器人前部区域附近，从而实现更安全、更直观的引导操作。该系统基于ROS实现，并通过行李箱搬运实验进行了验证，实验结果表明，机器人能够在承载载荷的同时，使操作人员以相对较小的力量完成搬运引导。

Authors: Minghao Xu, Thushara Sandakalum, Christina Dao Wen Lee, Marcelo H. Ang

TinyARM-X: A Series of Open-Source, Configurable, and Transparent Torque-Controlled Desktop-Scale Robotic Manipulators Manipulation

torque-controlled desktop-scale manipulators open-source reconfigurable impedance control

简要说明：TinyARM-X 提出了一个低成本、开源的扭矩控制桌面级机械臂框架，具有可重构硬件、动力学补偿和力感知遥操作，并通过真实实验进行了验证。

TLDR: TinyARM-X introduces a low-cost, open-source framework for torque-controlled desktop-scale robotic manipulators, featuring reconfigurable hardware, dynamic compensation, and force-aware teleoperation, demonstrated through real-world experiments.

Abstract: Visuomotor policies have demonstrated that imprecise low-cost robots can autonomously complete complex manipulation tasks. However, most inexpensive manipulators rely on compact and rigidly position-controlled servos for actuation, which complicate simulation, operation, and safety. This work introduces TinyARM-X, a framework for easily manufacturable, configurable, and torque-controllable low-cost (<350 USD) serial manipulators. By using a single hardware/software architecture, a <7 Degree of Freedom (DoF) TinyARM can be manually reconfigured to an operational >3 DoF robot within 10 min. Actuator modeling and dynamic compensation enable torque-controlled applications like mixed-reality impedance control teleoperation and simulator force feedback rendering. Experiments include mechanical benchmarking and real-world force-aware telemanipulation. The TinyARM-7 has a payload of 33.5 g, a max speed of 0.77 m/s, and a reach of 210 mm. Moreover, with dynamic compensation, the robot has a backdrive-breakaway force of 1.4 N and a backdrive-running force of 0.7 N. Additionally, Cartesian-Impedance Control (CIC) attains a translational stiffness of >15 N/m. Lastly, the TinyARM-X stack is open-sourced to disseminate accessible desktop-scale torque-controlled robotic manipulation to the community.

摘要（中文）：视觉运动策略已证明，精度不高的低成本机器人能够自主完成复杂的操作任务。然而，大多数廉价机械臂依赖于紧凑且刚性位置控制的伺服电机进行驱动，这给仿真、操作及安全性带来了复杂性。本工作介绍了TinyARM-X，一个易于制造、可配置且具备力矩控制的低成本（低于350美元）串联机械臂框架。通过采用统一的硬件/软件架构，一个自由度小于7的TinyARM可在10分钟内手动重新配置为可操作的自由度大于3的机器人。执行器建模与动态补偿使得诸如混合现实阻抗控制遥操作和模拟器力反馈渲染等力矩控制应用成为可能。实验包括机械性能基准测试和真实世界中的力感知遥操作。TinyARM-7的有效载荷为33.5克，最大速度为0.77米/秒，工作半径为210毫米。此外，通过动态补偿，该机器人的反向驱动脱离力为1.4牛顿，反向驱动运行力为0.7牛顿。同时，笛卡尔阻抗控制实现了大于15牛顿/米的平移刚度。最后，TinyARM-X技术栈已开源，旨在向社区普及可访问的桌面级力矩控制机器人操作技术。

Authors: Nicolas Kosanovic, Jean Chagas Vaz

Single-Controller Teleoperation and Multimodal Dataset Generation for a Mobile Manipulator Manipulation

teleoperation mobile manipulator multimodal dataset ROS pipeline pick-and-place

简要说明：本文提出一个针对移动机械臂的集成遥操作与数据收集框架，通过统一控制器和自动化ROS流程，输出同步且可直接用于机器学习的演示数据集，并在抓取放置任务中验证。

TLDR: This paper presents an integrated teleoperation and data-collection framework for a mobile manipulator, unifying a single controller and an automated ROS pipeline to output synchronized, machine-learning-ready datasets validated on a pick-and-place task.

Abstract: Robot learning systems require synchronized, high-quality demonstrations that combine visual, proprioceptive, and action data. However, collecting such datasets with mobile manipulators is often slowed down by fragmented teleoperation interfaces and manual post-processing workflows. This paper presents an integrated framework for teleoperated multimodal data collection on a Clearpath Dingo-O mobile base equipped with a Kinova Gen3 Lite manipulator and an Intel RealSense RGB-D camera. The framework combines single-controller operation of the base, arm, and recording process with an automated ROS-based pipeline for data capture, image-quality filtering, temporal synchronization, visualization, and export to machine-learning-ready Zarr datasets. We validate the system on a pick-and-place mobile-manipulation task in which the robot transports a bottle between two surfaces. The results show that the unified controller supports complete task execution and recording without external commands, while the data pipeline produces synchronized datasets for short demonstrations and identifies corrupted visual frames. The proposed framework provides a practical basis for producing structured demonstrations for robot-learning research.

摘要（中文）：机器人学习系统需要同步、高质量的演示数据，这些数据需结合视觉、本体感觉和动作信息。然而，使用移动机械臂采集此类数据集往往因碎片化的遥操作界面和人工后处理流程而效率低下。本文提出了一种集成框架，用于在配备Kinova Gen3 Lite机械臂和Intel RealSense RGB-D相机的Clearpath Dingo-O移动基座上开展遥操作多模态数据采集。该框架将基座、机械臂和记录过程的单控制器操作与基于ROS的自动化数据采集、图像质量过滤、时间同步、可视化及导出为机器学习就绪的Zarr数据集流程相结合。我们在一个移动机械臂抓取放置任务中验证了该系统，该任务要求机器人将瓶子在两个平面之间搬运。结果表明，统一控制器无需外部指令即可支持完整任务执行与记录，同时数据管道可为短时演示生成同步数据集，并识别损坏的视觉帧。所提出的框架为机器人学习研究中结构化演示数据的生成提供了实用基础。

Authors: Fardien Azizi, Sitor Sla, Christiaan Peppelman, Dion van Santen, Andrei-Carlo Papuc, Khaled Mustafa, Diego Martinez-Baselga, Javier Alonso-Mora

When to Refine: Selective Search for Frozen Visual World Models WorldModel

selective search cross-entropy method visual world model planning PushT

简要说明：本文提出选择性CEM细化（SCR），一种学习门控规则，用于决定是否继续或停止使用冻结视觉世界模型的交叉熵方法搜索，在PushT任务上减少了计算量，同时保留了与固定深度搜索相比的大部分成功率。

TLDR: This paper introduces Selective CEM Refinement (SCR), a learned gating rule that decides whether to continue or stop cross-entropy method search with a frozen visual world model, reducing compute while retaining most success rate compared to fixed-depth search on PushT tasks.

Abstract: Planning with a visual world model requires deciding both which actions to execute and how long to search for them. We introduce Selective CEM Refinement (SCR), a learned rule for deciding whether to continue cross-entropy method (CEM) search with a frozen LeWorldModel. After five it- erations, the gate measures how far the mean first action chunk has moved, how much the mean terminal cost of elite plans has fallen, and how widely their first chunks vary. It returns the current plan for execution or continues the same search for ten more iterations. The gate requires no addi- tional world-model rollout. On 16 PushT scenes evaluated with two planning seeds, SCR succeeded in 25 of 32 trials, compared with 28 of 32 for fixed 15-iteration search (Fixed-15). All 25 SCR suc- cesses occurred in trials that Fixed-15 also solved, yield- ing 89.29% paired success retention. Across complete episodes, including replanning, SCR evaluated 23.81% fewer candidate plans and reduced mean controller time per eight-environment batch by 17.22%. Its observed suc- cess rate was 5.36 percentage points above an analytic mix- ture of the two fixed-depth controllers at the same expected candidate workload, although the difference changed sign across planning seeds. Compared with gating only at the initial solve under the same random-draw padding proto- col, gating again at replanning produced nine additional early exits. This reduced total candidate evaluations by 15.79%, while successes fell from 27 to 25.

摘要（中文）：规划与视觉世界模型需要决定执行哪些动作以及搜索多长时间。我们引入了选择性CEM细化（SCR），这是一种学习规则，用于决定是否在冻结的LeWorldModel下继续交叉熵方法（CEM）搜索。经过五次迭代后，门控机制测量平均初始动作块移动了多远、精英计划的平均终端成本下降了多少，以及它们的初始动作块之间的差异有多大。它返回当前计划以供执行，或继续相同的搜索再进行十次迭代。该门控机制不需要额外的世界模型推演。在使用两种规划种子评估的16个PushT场景中，SCR在32次试验中成功25次，而固定15次迭代搜索（Fixed-15）在32次试验中成功28次。SCR的所有25次成功都发生在Fixed-15也能解决的试验中，配对成功率保留为89.29%。在包括重新规划的完整回合中，SCR评估的候选计划减少了23.81%，每个八环境批次的平均控制器时间减少了17.22%。其观察到的成功率比在相同预期候选工作量下两种固定深度控制器的解析混合高出5.36个百分点，尽管该差异在规划种子间符号发生变化。与仅在同一随机抽取填充协议下在初始求解时进行门控相比，在重新规划时再次门控产生了九次额外的提前退出。这使得总候选评估减少了15.79%，而成功次数从27次降至25次。
