Authors: Jingni Huang

SearchDiffusion: Information-Guided Diffusion Planning for Object Search RLRobot

diffusion planning object search utility map quadruped robot partial observability

简要说明：SearchDiffusion 提出了一种基于扩散的规划器，利用学习到的稠密效用图引导未知环境中的物体搜索轨迹生成，在模拟和真实四足机器人试验中实现了高检测率。

TLDR: SearchDiffusion introduces a diffusion-based planner that uses a learned dense utility map to guide trajectory generation for object search in unknown environments, achieving high detection rates in simulated and real quadruped trials.

Abstract: Object search in unknown environments requires robots to gather useful observations while avoiding obstacles and accounting for limited sensor visibility. We present SearchDiffusion, a diffusion-based planner that generates position and heading trajectories using a learned dense utility map. The map represents geometric accessibility, useful visibility, and semantic progress. It conditions trajectory generation and provides an objective for sampling guidance. Sampled map hypotheses provide additional geometric context, while geometric and heading guidance, validity checks, and analytical selection support execution. Across 90 simulated tasks on 24 map layouts, SearchDiffusion achieved 95.6\% target detection at greater computational cost. Ablations show complementary benefits from utility and guidance, with limited additional detection benefit from runtime map hypotheses. In ten physical quadruped trials using OneMap relevance maps, eight were successful under operator assessment, without fine-tuning on real-robot data. These results support combining learned spatial utility with guided trajectory generation for object search under partial observability.

摘要（中文）：在未知环境中进行目标搜索，要求机器人收集有价值的观测信息，同时避开障碍物，并考虑传感器视野的局限性。我们提出SearchDiffusion，一种基于扩散模型的规划器，利用学习得到的稠密效用图生成位置与朝向轨迹。该效用图融合了几何可达性、有效可见性与语义进展信息。它既作为轨迹生成的条件，又为采样引导提供优化目标。采样的地图假设提供了额外的几何上下文，而几何与朝向引导、有效性检查以及解析式筛选则保障了执行过程的可靠性。在24种地图布局上的90项模拟任务中，SearchDiffusion在更高计算成本下实现了95.6%的目标检测率。消融实验表明，效用与引导具有互补收益，而运行时的地图假设在检测性能上的额外提升有限。在使用OneMap相关图的十次实体四足机器人试验中，操作员评估显示八次成功，且无需基于真实机器人数据进行微调。这些结果支持将学习得到的空间效用与引导式轨迹生成相结合，以应对部分可观测条件下的目标搜索问题。

Authors: Sausar Karaf, Dmitrii Plotnikov, Alexey Kotcov, Dzmitry Tsetserukou

Proprioceptive Simultaneous Base and Terrain Elevation Estimation for Legged Robot Locomotion Locomotion

proprioceptive estimation terrain elevation mapping left-invariant extended Kalman filter legged robot locomotion SLAM

简要说明：SBEE 是一个用于腿式机器人的实时框架，通过将左不变扩展卡尔曼滤波器与网格高程图耦合，在视觉退化环境中减少垂直漂移，提高轨迹精度，无需视觉。

TLDR: SBEE is a real-time framework for legged robots that couples a left-invariant extended Kalman filter and a grid-based elevation map to reduce vertical drift in visually degraded environments, improving trajectory accuracy without requiring vision.

Abstract: Legged robots in visually degraded environments must rely exclusively on proprioceptive sensing, under which global position and yaw are unobservable. Vertical drift is particularly detrimental, as it corrupts the height reference required by swing-leg trajectories and can destabilize the robot. We treat the terrain itself as a persistent proprioceptive landmark: every footstep provides a height measurement that anchors the vertical axis. We propose Simultaneous Base and Elevation Estimation (SBEE), a real-time open-source framework in which a Left-Invariant Extended Kalman Filter (LI-EKF) for floating-base estimation and a grid-based elevation map are coupled in a bidirectional loop, mirroring SLAM with terrain elevation in place of landmarks. Stable foot contacts insert uncertainty-aware height samples into the map, and previously mapped cells are fed back as uncertainty-weighted vertical pseudo-measurements that act analogously to loop closures. Unlike contact-aided invariant filters, the LI-EKF consumes a kinematic velocity measurement instead of augmenting the state with a contact model per leg, so its state dimension is independent of the number of legs. We evaluate SBEE in MuJoCo on quadrupedal and bipedal platforms and on the ANYmal-D GrandTour dataset over 296 m of locomotion, reducing the absolute trajectory error by 22.1% relative to the best of three state-of-the-art proprioceptive estimators.

摘要（中文）：在视觉退化环境中，腿式机器人必须完全依赖本体感觉进行感知，此时全局位置与偏航角不可观测。垂直方向的漂移尤为有害，因为它会破坏摆动腿轨迹所需的高度参考，进而可能导致机器人失稳。我们将地形本身视为一种持久性的本体感觉地标：每一次落脚都提供一次高度测量，从而锚定垂直轴。为此，我们提出了同时基座与高程估计（SBEE）框架——一个实时的开源系统，其中用于浮动基座估计的左不变扩展卡尔曼滤波器（LI-EKF）与基于网格的高程图在双向环路中耦合，类似于以地形高程替代地标的SLAM框架。稳定的足部接触将携带不确定性的高度样本插入地图中，而已映射的单元格则作为带不确定性权重的高度伪测量值反馈回来，其作用类似于回环闭合。与接触辅助的不变滤波器不同，LI-EKF采用运动学速度测量值，而非为每条腿增加接触模型来扩展状态，因此其状态维度与腿的数量无关。我们在MuJoCo中对四足和双足平台进行了SBEE评估，并在ANYmal-D GrandTour数据集上进行了296米的行进测试，结果表明，相对于三种最先进的本体感觉估计器中表现最优者，绝对轨迹误差降低了22.1%。

Authors: Michael Maravgakis, Stylianos Piperakis, Panos Trahanias

QDD-MM: A Simple and Compact Open-Source Muscle Module with Quasi-Direct-Drive Motor for Tendon-driven Robots HumanoidEmbodied

tendon-driven robots quasi-direct-drive motor muscle module backdrivability open-source hardware

简要说明：本文提出QDD-MM，一种用于肌腱驱动机器人的紧凑型准直接驱动肌肉模块，简化设计并提高反向驱动性和速度，已在人形等肌腱驱动机器人上验证。

TLDR: This paper introduces QDD-MM, a compact quasi-direct-drive muscle module for tendon-driven robots, simplifying design and improving backdrivability and speed, validated on humanoid and other tendon-driven robots.

Abstract: Tendon-driven robots, which actuate like biological muscles by using motors to wind wires, offer advantages such as variable stiffness and redundant actuation. Despite these advantages, musculoskeletal structures inherently involve a large number of diverse muscles, making it desirable to compactly modularize each muscle unit and flexibly accommodate diverse muscle arrangements. While various small muscle modules have been proposed to date, existing designs tend to be complex, difficult to maintain, and suffer from low backdrivability and limited actuation speed due to their high gear ratios. In this work, we propose QDD-MM, a muscle module that leverages recent advances in quasi-direct-drive motors to achieve a simpler and more compact structure with higher backdrivability and faster actuation than previous modules. By utilizing quasi-direct-drive motors, the module eliminates the need for dedicated force-sensing mechanisms, significantly simplifying the overall design, while also supporting flexible wire routing in multiple directions, various module-to-module connections, and even the use of the module body itself as a structural component. QDD-MM integrates these capabilities into a reusable muscle module, and its design is openly available at https://github.com/haraduka/qddmm. We developed tendon-driven robots with one joint and either two or three muscles, as well as a partial musculoskeletal humanoid, using the proposed QDD-MM and verified their effectiveness. We expect that this muscle module will democratize tendon-driven robotics and further accelerate progress in the field.

摘要（中文）：肌腱驱动机器人通过电机缠绕线缆实现类似生物肌肉的驱动方式，具备可变刚度和冗余驱动等优势。然而，肌肉骨骼结构本质上涉及大量不同类型的肌肉，因此期望能够将每个肌肉单元紧凑模块化，并灵活适应多种肌肉布局。尽管目前已有多种小型肌肉模块被提出，但现有设计往往结构复杂、维护困难，且由于高减速比而存在反向驱动性差、驱动速度受限等问题。在本研究中，我们提出了QDD-MM，一种利用准直驱电机最新进展的肌肉模块，相较于以往模块，其结构更简单紧凑，反向驱动性更优，驱动速度更快。通过采用准直驱电机，该模块无需专用力传感机构，显著简化了整体设计，同时支持多方向灵活布线、多种模块间连接方式，甚至可将模块本体用作结构部件。QDD-MM将这些功能集成于一个可复用的肌肉模块中，其设计已在https://github.com/haraduka/qddmm公开。我们使用所提出的QDD-MM开发了具有单关节及两块或三块肌肉的肌腱驱动机器人，以及一个部分肌肉骨骼人形机器人，并验证了其有效性。我们期望该肌肉模块能够推动肌腱驱动机器人技术的普及，并进一步加速该领域的发展。

Authors: Kento Kawaharazuka, Yoshimoto Ribayashi, Takahiro Hattori, Shunnosuke Yoshimura, Kei Okada

Towards Vacuum-Assisted Robotic Needle Interventions: From Fluid Aspiration to Tissue Biopsy Manipulation

ultrasound-guided needle intervention vacuum-assisted end effector fluid aspiration tissue biopsy Franka Emika Panda

简要说明：本文提出了一种统一的机器人框架，用于超声引导下的液体抽吸和组织活检，采用真空辅助末端执行器，并在Franka Emika Panda机器人上进行了50次试验，成功率较高。

TLDR: This paper presents a unified robotic framework for ultrasound-guided fluid aspiration and tissue biopsy using a vacuum-assisted end effector, evaluated on a Franka Emika Panda robot over 50 phantom trials with high success rates.

Abstract: Robotic ultrasound-guided needle interventions have primarily focused on target localization and accurate needle placement, while the subsequent acquisition of diagnostic material remains comparatively underexplored. Moreover, pleural fluid aspiration and tissue biopsy are typically addressed as separate procedures, despite sharing common requirements for ultrasound guidance, safe access, and sample transport. This work presents a unified robotic framework for ultrasound-guided fluid and tissue extraction using a single vacuum-assisted end effector. The proposed system combines force controlled ultrasound scanning, semantic target identification, automated needle deployment, and procedure specific material acquisition. A coaxial needle assembly and shared pump assisted pathway enable direct pleural fluid aspiration, while controlled cannula actuation provides the additional cutting action required for solid-tissue acquisition. End-to-end evaluation using a Franka Emika Panda robot over 50 phantom trials achieved successful extraction in 23/25 pleural fluid aspiration trials (92\%) and 22/25 tissue acquisition trials (88\%). Following successful tissue-target access, acquisition and transport were completed in all 22 trials.

摘要（中文）：机器人辅助超声引导下的穿刺操作主要集中在目标定位和精确穿刺置针上，而随后获取诊断材料的过程相对研究较少。此外，胸腔积液抽吸和组织活检通常作为两个独立的手术处理，尽管两者在超声引导、安全通路和样本传输方面有着共同的需求。本研究提出了一种统一的机器人框架，利用单一真空辅助末端执行器实现超声引导下的液体和组织提取。该系统结合了力控制超声扫描、语义目标识别、自动穿刺部署及针对特定手术的材料获取功能。同轴穿刺针组件和共享泵辅助通路可实现直接的胸腔积液抽吸，而受控套管驱动则为实体组织获取提供了所需的额外切割动作。使用Franka Emika Panda机器人进行的50次仿体验证试验中，23/25次胸腔积液抽吸试验（92%）和22/25次组织获取试验（88%）成功完成提取。在成功实现组织靶点进入后，22次试验全部完成了获取和运输过程。

Authors: Sheena Shabana, Laxmi Nag Laxminarayan Nagesh, Marta Vallejo, Karen Donaldson, Maria Koskinopoulou

Neural Network-Based In-Contact Task Segmentation of Demonstrated Robot Motions via Hand Guiding Manipulation

neural network segmentation programming by demonstration in-contact tasks hand-guided demonstrations force/torque sensing

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于神经网络的方法，利用末端执行器的扭转和力/力矩数据对手引导机器人示教进行运动类型分割，旨在提高接触任务直观编程的便捷性。

TLDR: This paper proposes a neural network-based method for segmenting hand-guided robot demonstrations into motion types using end-effector twists and wrenches, aiming to improve intuitive programming of in-contact tasks.

Abstract: Intuitive robot programming approaches, such as Programming by Demonstration, enable non-experts to teach robots tasks through hand-guided demonstrations. However, for in-contact tasks requiring force control for parts of the motion, automated segmentation of motion types is crucial for improving usability. Considering the related work, this work proposes a neural network-based segmentation method categorizing motion into three fundamental types using input data of cartesian twists and wrenches at the end effector. We collect demonstration data using a 7-axis robot with a wrist-mounted force torque sensor and generate ground truth labeling by hand. While still in development, our research direction aims to enable non-experts to program in-contact tasks more intuitively.

摘要（中文）：直观的机器人编程方法，如通过示教进行编程，使非专业人士能够通过手动引导的演示来教导机器人执行任务。然而，对于需要在部分运动过程中进行力控制的基础接触任务，自动分割运动类型对于提升易用性至关重要。结合相关工作，本研究提出了一种基于神经网络的分割方法，利用末端执行器处的笛卡尔 twists 和 wrenches 输入数据，将运动分为三种基本类型。我们使用配备腕部力-扭矩传感器的七轴机器人采集演示数据，并手工生成真实标签。尽管目前仍在开发阶段，我们的研究方向旨在使非专业人士能够更直观地编程基础接触任务。

Authors: Johannes Hartwig, Marcello Kögler, Dominik Henrich

TapTacTouch: Shape Completion from Sparse Tactile Contacts with Geometric Priors Manipulation

tactile sensing 3D shape completion Gaussian Process Implicit Surface robotic manipulation geometric prior

简要说明：本文提出一种无视觉、无训练、类别无关的框架，利用多尺度高斯过程隐式曲面（GPIS）和几何先验，从稀疏触觉接触中重建3D物体网格，并在真实机器人平台上验证。

TLDR: This paper presents a vision-free, training-free framework that reconstructs 3D object meshes from sparse tactile contacts using a multi-scale Gaussian Process Implicit Surface (GPIS) with geometric priors, demonstrated on a real robotic platform.

Abstract: 3D object reconstruction is essential for robotic perception and manipulation, yet conventional approaches predominantly rely on visual observations that can be limited by occlusion or unavailable in visually constrained environments. In this work, we propose a vision-free, training-free, and category-agnostic framework for reconstructing 3D object meshes from sparse tactile contacts without relying on pretrained shape models. A 6-DoF robotic arm equipped with a 20-DoF multi-finger robotic hand collects tactile observations using 3x3 pressure sensor arrays mounted on the finger pads. The acquired tactile measurements are transformed into 3D contact constraints through robot kinematics and integrated into a multi-scale Gaussian Process Implicit Surface (GPIS). To address sparse and incomplete surface observations, the proposed method incorporates contact confidence weighting, weak pseudo-surface constraints, and an observation-driven geometric prior to preserve local surface geometry and provide structural guidance in unobserved regions. Real-world experiments on six objects achieve a Chamfer Distance (CD) of 1.610, an Earth Mover's Distance (EMD) of 7.738, and an F-Score of 95.00, with reconstruction completed in an average of 49.99 s per object. These results demonstrate that sparse tactile sensing can provide sufficient geometric information for continuous 3D object reconstruction without visual or semantic information.

摘要（中文）：三维物体重建对于机器人感知与操作至关重要，然而传统方法主要依赖视觉观测，而视觉观测在遮挡环境下可能受限，或在视觉受限场景中不可用。本研究提出一种无视觉、无需训练、类别无关的框架，仅凭稀疏触觉接触即可重建三维物体网格，且不依赖预训练形状模型。该系统采用配备20自由度多指机器人手的六自由度机械臂，利用安装于指垫上的3×3压力传感器阵列采集触觉观测数据。采集到的触觉测量值通过机器人运动学转换为三维接触约束，并集成到多尺度高斯过程隐式曲面中。针对稀疏且不完整的表面观测，所提方法引入接触置信度加权、弱伪表面约束以及基于观测的几何先验，以保留局部表面几何特征，并在未观测区域提供结构引导。在六个物体上的真实世界实验中，实现了倒角距离为1.610，推土机距离为7.738，F分数为95.00，每个物体的平均重建时间为49.99秒。这些结果表明，在不依赖视觉或语义信息的情况下，稀疏触觉传感能够为连续三维物体重建提供足够的几何信息。

Authors: Yoobin Shin, Jaeyoung Lee, Jieun Kang, Hyun Song, Woojin Kim, Andrew Jaeyong Choi

Worth Another Look:Constrained World-Model Planning for Visual Inspection WorldModel

world model receding-horizon beam search observation planning budget-aware inspection neuro-symbolic

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于视觉检测的神经符号观测规划框架，将紧凑的循环世界模型与精确的符号可行性和关税规则相结合，并利用滚动时域波束搜索在计算和传感限制下调度查询、裁剪、增强和终止。

TLDR: This paper presents a neuro-symbolic observation planning framework for visual inspection, combining a compact recurrent world model with exact symbolic feasibility and tariff rules, and using receding-horizon beam search to schedule queries, crops, enhancements, and termination under compute and sensing caps.

Abstract: Visual inspection in field robotics and environmental monitoring must localize multiple targets under strict compute and sensing caps. Exhaustive sweeps waste calls on absent classes, while myopic and search-free policies stumble over heterogeneous tariff cliffs or discard viewport edits whose value emerges only after re-querying. We formulate inspection over frozen detectors as neuro-symbolic observation planning under partial observability, decoupling a compact recurrent world model (WM) from exact symbolic feasibility and tariff rules. Receding-horizon beam search with online replanning jointly schedules class queries, crops, enhancements, and termination (stop), paired with slack-aware shadow pricing and legal fallback at larger budgets. Across eight terrestrial, optical, and sonar benchmarks, multi-step lookahead outperforms static schedules and search-free offline RL under tight budgets -- gaining up to 28.4 AP percentage points over static priority on RUOD and 15.1 on ARIS -- while dynamic pricing lifts large-budget performance on all eight domains at 11 ms planning cost. Ultimately, pairing lightweight learned dynamics with exact symbolic constraints turns frozen detectors into adaptive, budget-aware inspection agents without retraining.

摘要（中文）：现场机器人技术与环境监测中的视觉检测，必须在严格的计算与传感限制下定位多个目标。穷举式扫描在缺失类别上浪费调用，而短视的、无搜索策略在面对异构费率悬崖时则步履蹒跚，或丢弃那些仅在重新查询后才显现价值的视口编辑。我们将冻结检测器上的检测问题形式化为部分可观测条件下的神经符号观测规划，将紧凑的循环世界模型与精确的符号可行性及费率规则解耦。采用滚动时域波束搜索与在线重规划，联合调度类别查询、裁剪、增强及终止（停止），并辅以松弛感知的影子定价及更大预算下的合法回退。在八个地面、光学及声纳基准测试中，多步前瞻在紧预算下优于静态调度和无搜索离线强化学习——在RUOD上相较静态优先级提升高达28.4个AP百分点，在ARIS上提升15.1个百分点——而动态定价在全部八个领域上以11毫秒的规划成本提升了大数据预算下的性能。最终，将轻量级学习动态与精确符号约束相结合，使冻结检测器无需重新训练即可转化为自适应的、预算感知的检测代理。

Authors: Ziyue Kang, Zixi Qi, Yuchen Dai, Nana Lv, Xirong Cheng, Liang Liu, Ying Li, Haoyan Wei, Haiyang Yao

Asymmetric Decomposition for Multi-Agent Path Finding with Unassigned Agents RLRobot

Multi-Agent Path Finding Conflict-Based Search Min-Cost Flow Unassigned Agents Physical Robot Experiments

简要说明：本文提出FOCBS，一种结合冲突搜索与最小成本流预测器的混合算法，用于解决含未分配智能体的多智能体路径规划问题，在证明已分配智能体服务时间最优性的同时最小化未分配智能体的移动。基准测试和物理机器人实验（车队行驶减少40.8%）验证了其可扩展性和有效性。

TLDR: This paper introduces FOCBS, a hybrid algorithm combining conflict-based search with a min-cost flow oracle, to solve Multi-Agent Path Finding with unassigned agents, proving optimality for assigned agents' service time while minimizing unassigned agent movement. It demonstrates scalability in benchmarks and 40.8% fleet travel reduction in physical robot experiments.

Abstract: Robots without assigned tasks may obstruct active robots, while routing them to designated parking locations can cause unnecessary travel. This article proposes flow-oracle conflict-based search (FOCBS) for Multi-Agent Path Finding with unassigned agents (MAPF-UA). FOCBS searches over assigned-agent paths using conflict-based search (CBS) and routes targetless unassigned agents through a min-cost flow oracle. When the selected assigned-agent paths leave unassigned agents no collision-free paths, flow-conflict branching converts min-cut blockers into assigned-agent constraints, which guide the search without excluding optimal solutions. A batched zero-cost warm start accelerates the oracle, and start-avoiding tie-breaking reduces unassigned-agent movement. For feasible instances on finite graphs, we prove termination and global minimization of assigned-agent sum of service time, measured by last-arrival times. Unassigned-agent movement is minimized conditional on the selected assigned-agent paths, without a global lexicographic optimality guarantee. Benchmark experiments show that FOCBS scales well with the number of unassigned agents, and ablation studies show that, compared with discarding non-completable assigned-agent paths, flow-conflict branching solves substantially more instances while retaining optimality. Simulation and physical-robot experiments demonstrate plan executability, with laboratory tests reducing fleet travel by 40.8% relative to the parking-based coordination baseline. The source code and related resources are available at https://github.com/Chin-hsi/focbs

摘要（中文）：未被分配任务的机器人可能会阻碍其他活跃机器人，而将其引导至指定停车位置则可能导致不必要的行驶。本文提出了一种面向未分配智能体的多智能体路径规划（MAPF-UA）的流-冲突冲突搜索算法（FOCBS）。FOCBS利用冲突搜索（CBS）在已分配智能体的路径上进行搜索，并通过最小费用流预言机为无目标智能体规划路径。当所选定的已分配智能体路径使得未分配智能体没有无冲突路径时，流-冲突分支将最小割阻塞者转化为对已分配智能体的约束，从而在不排除最优解的前提下引导搜索。批量零成本热启动加速了预言机的求解，而避免起点的平局打破策略减少了未分配智能体的移动量。对于有限图上的可行实例，我们证明了算法的终止性以及以最后到达时间衡量的已分配智能体服务时间总和的全局最小化。未分配智能体的移动量在所选定的已分配智能体路径条件下被最小化，但不保证全局字典序最优性。基准实验表明，FOCBS在未分配智能体数量增加时具有良好的可扩展性；消融实验表明，与舍弃无法完成的已分配智能体路径相比，流-冲突分支在保持最优性的同时解决了显著更多的实例。仿真和实体机器人实验验证了计划的可执行性，其中实验室测试相较基于停车的协调基线，车队行驶距离减少了40.8%。源代码及相关资源可在https://github.com/Chin-hsi/focbs获取。

Authors: Xi Jin, Chen Qian, Renjun Zhang, Guowei Wu, Xiaobo Li, Jun Jiang, Weiwei Shang

Lost Between Mind, Model Collaboration, and Motion: Understanding and Measuring Cross-Model Action Misalignment in Commercial Robots Other

cross-model action misalignment LLM-based robot control black-box testing security commercial robots

简要说明：本文提出了TARS，一个黑盒框架，用于自动发现和验证商业机器人大语言模型与动作模型之间语义错位导致的意外物理行为，在四个机器人上展示了广泛的跨模型动作错位，动作覆盖率高达94%。

TLDR: This paper introduces TARS, a black-box framework to automatically discover and validate unintended physical behaviors caused by semantic misalignment between LLMs and action models in commercial robots, demonstrating widespread cross-model action misalignment across four robots with up to 94% verified action coverage.

Abstract: Embodied robots increasingly rely on large language models (LLMs) to interpret user intent and coordinate with robot-specific action models for physical interaction. This multi-model pipeline creates a critical semantic boundary across mind, model collaboration, and motion: semantic consistency may break between what the large model understands, how the small action model translates that understanding into executable commands, and what physical actions the robot ultimately performs. As a security consequence, commercial robots may execute unintended physical actions even when user inputs contain no explicit action commands. To measure this problem, we develop TARS, a black-box framework that explores the command-reasoning-action pipeline and automatically discovers and validates unintended physical behaviors. We evaluate TARS on four commercial robots across 44 experimental settings, conducting 133,400 executions. TARS uncovers widespread cross-model action misalignment and achieves up to 94% verified action coverage.

摘要（中文）：具身机器人越来越依赖大型语言模型（LLMs）来解读用户意图，并与机器人特有的动作模型协同，以完成物理交互。这种多模型流水线在思维、模型协作与运动之间形成了一个关键语义边界：大型模型所理解的内容、小型动作模型将这种理解转化为可执行命令的方式，以及机器人最终执行的物理动作之间，语义一致性可能发生断裂。从安全性角度看，即便用户输入中不包含明确的动作指令，商用机器人也可能执行非预期的物理动作。为衡量这一问题，我们开发了TARS——一个黑盒框架，用于探索命令-推理-动作流水线，并自动发现和验证非预期的物理行为。我们在4款商用机器人上、涵盖44种实验设置中，对TARS进行了133,400次执行评估。TARS发现了广泛存在的跨模型动作失配问题，并实现了最高94%的已验证动作覆盖率。

Authors: Yuhang Huang, Junchao Li, Boyang Ma, Minghui Xu, Kaidi Xu, Pengfei Hu, Xiuzhen Cheng, Yue Zhang

AeroRSI: Recursive Self-Improvement for Aerial Vision-Language Navigation VLN

recursive self-improvement aerial vision-language navigation failure repair closed-loop flight VLA models

简要说明：AeroRSI 是一种用于空中视觉语言导航的递归自我改进框架，该框架通过让失败策略在继续飞行中评估自身修复来从失败中学习，在 TravelUAV 上将成功率从 46.4% 提高到 67.5%，且无需额外的人工标注或推理成本。

TLDR: AeroRSI is a recursive self-improvement framework for aerial vision-language navigation, where a failing policy learns from its own failures by judging repairs through continued flight, improving success rate from 46.4% to 67.5% on TravelUAV without extra human labels or inference cost.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) to follow natural-language instructions, yet still fail frequently in closed-loop flight. Correcting these failures requires repairs, i.e., actions that avoid them at the states the policy itself reaches, which human pilots cannot label at scale and rule-based planners cannot supply reliably. In this paper, we present AeroRSI, a recursive self-improvement framework in which an aerial navigation policy iteratively learns from its own failures. Our key insight is that a failing policy should judge its own repairs by flying on from them. Judged in this way, its sampled actions and even rule-based proposals that hurt it when imitated directly become reliable supervision. Moreover, an episode terminates at its first failure, concealing subsequent failures until the earlier ones are repaired. AeroRSI thus renews its supervision in every round, anchoring the failures of the current policy, verifying repairs by its continuation, and distilling them while keeping its behavior elsewhere. On TravelUAV, three rounds raise the success rate of a supervised 2B-parameter policy from 46.4% to 67.5% and reduce collisions by half, surpassing the previous state of the art by 10.6 points from the same initialization without extra human labels or inference cost. Code and models are available at https://github.com/starsholic/AeroRSI.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型使无人机（UAV）能够遵循自然语言指令，但在闭环飞行中仍频繁出现失败。修正这些失败需要修复，即在策略自身所到达的状态下采取能够避免失败的动作，而人类飞行员无法大规模标注此类动作，基于规则的规划器也难以可靠提供这些修复。在本文中，我们提出了AeroRSI，一种递归自我改进框架，使空中导航策略能够从自身的失败中迭代学习。我们的关键洞见在于，一个存在失败的策略应当通过在其修复基础上继续飞行来评判自身修复的有效性。以这种方式评判时，该策略采样的动作，甚至那些在直接模仿时对策略有害的基于规则的提议，都能成为可靠的监督信号。此外，一个回合在首次失败时即终止，从而在早期失败被修复之前隐藏了后续失败。因此，AeroRSI在每一轮中更新其监督信号，锚定当前策略的失败，通过策略的延续来验证修复效果，并在保持策略其他行为不变的前提下提炼这些修复。在TravelUAV上，三轮迭代将受监督的2B参数策略的成功率从46.4%提升至67.5%，碰撞率降低一半，在相同初始化条件下超越此前最先进方法10.6个百分点，且无需额外的人工标注或推理开销。代码和模型可在 https://github.com/starsholic/AeroRSI 获取。

Authors: Shiwei Wu, Yuwen Pan, Zhi Li, Yaowen Li, Yan Zhou, Xuemiao Xu, Yu Liu

Attention Is Not Relevance: Challenging the Causality of Attention in Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

attention relevance estimation causal analysis autonomous driving counterfactual

简要说明：本文在超过8万个合成自动驾驶场景中，将基于注意力的相关性估计方法与因果反事实真实值进行比较，表明注意力提供的是相关性而非因果性的物体相关性指示，并在复杂场景中性能下降。

TLDR: This paper evaluates attention-based relevance estimation methods against causal counterfactual ground truth in over 80,000 synthetic autonomous driving scenes, showing that attention provides correlational rather than causal indications of object relevance and degrades in complex scenarios.

Abstract: Attention has become one of the most widely adopted solutions for estimating the relevance of surrounding objects and interpreting an autonomous vehicle's driving decisions. However, its ability to capture the causal impact of individual input elements on an AI model's output has long been discussed in the literature, particularly in the Natural Language Processing (NLP) domain. This work brings this discussion into the autonomous driving domain by analyzing the accuracy of attention in estimating the impact of an input object on an autonomous vehicle's driving, i.e., its relevance. To this end, we compare different attention-based relevance estimation methods against a causal reference of object relevance obtained through counterfactual analysis. We perform our analysis on more than 80,000 synthetic driving scenes using an autonomous vehicle based on PlanT 2.0, a state-of-the-art Transformer-based model for object-level planning. Results show that attention provides a correlational rather than causal indication of object relevance. Attention-based relevance estimation methods do not consistently identify all relevant objects and tend to incorrectly classify as relevant objects with little or no impact on the vehicle's driving. In particular, results show that attention can effectively identify relevant objects in simple single-lane, straight-road scenarios, but its accuracy degrades in more complex settings, such as multi-lane roads and intersections. These findings highlight the limitations of attention as a proxy for object relevance, calling for novel methods able to accurately capture the causal impact of individual objects on the vehicle's driving and distinguish it from correlational associations.

摘要（中文）：摘要：注意力机制已成为估计周围物体相关性并解释自动驾驶车辆驾驶决策的最广泛采用的解决方案之一。然而，其在捕捉单个输入元素对AI模型输出的因果影响方面的能力，长期以来一直在文献中被讨论，尤其是在自然语言处理（NLP）领域。本研究将该讨论引入自动驾驶领域，通过分析注意力在估计输入物体对自动驾驶车辆驾驶影响（即其相关性）方面的准确性。为此，我们将基于注意力的不同相关性估计方法与通过反事实分析获得的物体相关性因果参照进行比较。我们使用基于PlanT 2.0的自动驾驶车辆（一种最先进的基于Transformer的物体级规划模型）对超过80,000个合成驾驶场景进行了分析。结果表明，注意力提供的是物体相关性的相关性指示，而非因果指示。基于注意力的相关性估计方法不能一致地识别所有相关物体，并且倾向于将那些对车辆驾驶影响很小或没有影响的物体错误地分类为相关物体。特别是，结果表明，注意力可以有效识别简单单车道、直线道路场景中的相关物体，但在更复杂的环境中，如多车道道路和交叉口，其准确性会下降。这些发现突显了注意力作为物体相关性替代指标的局限性，呼吁开发能够准确捕捉单个物体对车辆驾驶的因果影响并将其与相关性关联区分开来的新方法。

Authors: Luca Lusvarghi, Javier Gozalvez

Effects of Locomotion and Viewpoint Control on Immersive Robot Telepresence for Navigation and Inspection Locomotion

robot telepresence quadruped robot locomotion head-guided camera virtual reality

简要说明：本文介绍了一项用户研究，比较了在导航和巡检任务中远程操作四足机器人的不同移动和视角控制方法，发现头部引导的相机控制可提高性能和用户体验。

TLDR: This paper presents a user study comparing different locomotion and viewpoint control methods for teleoperating a quadruped robot in navigation and inspection tasks, finding that head-guided camera control improves performance and user experience.

Abstract: In many robot telepresence interfaces, movement and viewing are managed through handheld inputs. This can divide attention between steering, looking, and inspection. We compared joystick versus omnidirectional treadmill locomotion and joystick-based versus head-guided camera control in a within-subject 2x2 study in which 17 participants used a virtual reality headset to guide a quadruped robot through a physical maze while locating marked wall symbols and capturing them as visual evidence. Mixed-effects analyses showed that head-guided camera control was associated with faster completion, lower wall-contact cost, lower workload, and more favorable presence, usability, technology acceptance, and flow than joystick-based camera control. The strongest overall objective performance was observed in the joystick locomotion plus head-guided camera condition, whereas the omnidirectional treadmill plus head-guided camera condition emerged as the strongest experiential compromise. Exploratory camera analyses showed that head-guided camera control reduced switching, increased reliance on the pan-tilt view, and supported a more stable viewing strategy across the maze. These strategy differences were consistent with the performance advantage, especially for wall-contact duration. Targets captured remained near ceiling and simulator sickness remained low across all conditions. Overall, the results indicate that viewpoint control was the stronger differentiator in this combined navigation and inspection task, while locomotion still shaped the objective and experiential tradeoff.

摘要（中文）：在许多机器人远程呈现界面中，移动和视角通常通过手持输入设备进行管理。这可能导致用户在转向、观察和检查之间分散注意力。我们进行了一项受试者内2x2设计研究，比较了操纵杆与全向跑步机 locomotion（移动方式）以及基于操纵杆与头戴式导向的摄像机控制，17名参与者使用虚拟现实头盔引导四足机器人穿越物理迷宫，同时定位标记的墙壁符号并捕获它们作为视觉证据。混合效应分析显示，与基于操纵杆的摄像机控制相比，头戴式导向的摄像机控制与更快的完成时间、更低的墙壁接触成本、更低的工作负荷以及更优的存在感、可用性、技术接受度和心流体验相关。总体客观表现最强的是操纵杆移动加头戴式导向摄像机条件，而全向跑步机加头戴式导向摄像机条件则成为最强的体验性折中方案。探索性摄像机分析表明，头戴式导向的摄像机控制减少了视角切换，增加了对云台视角的依赖，并在整个迷宫中支持了更稳定的观察策略。这些策略差异与性能优势一致，尤其在墙壁接触持续时间方面。所有条件下，目标捕获率均接近上限，模拟器晕动症保持在较低水平。总体而言，结果表明在此类结合导航与检查的任务中，视角控制是更强的区分因素，而移动方式则塑造了客观表现与体验之间的权衡。

Authors: Ammaar Zaman, Neven ElSayed, Oliver Prentner, Mohamed Ellethy, Mostafa M. Lotfy, Maram Selsabila Mahmoudi, Eduardo Veas

Emo-H2A: Driving a Facial Robot Directly from LLM Hidden States at Token Rate HumanoidEmbodied

facial robot LLM hidden states valence-arousal-dominance token-rate control human-robot interaction

简要说明：Emo-H2A 提出一种无需训练的方法，在解码过程中直接从 LLM 隐藏状态驱动 29 自由度面部机器人，实现与对话同步的连续、上下文相关且低延迟的面部表情。

TLDR: Emo-H2A proposes a training-free method to drive a 29-DoF facial robot directly from LLM hidden states during decoding, enabling continuous, context-sensitive, and low-latency facial expressions synchronized with conversation.

Abstract: Diverse, semantically synchronized, and low-latency facial expressions are essential for human-robot interaction. While large language models (LLMs) have endowed anthropomorphic robots with fluent speech, facial expression still struggles to follow the conversation. Motivated by this gap, we present Emo-H2A (hidden-to-actuation), a paradigm that drives a facial robot directly from LLM hidden states during autoregressive decoding. Without a separate emotion label, expression stays continuous and context-sensitive, and the face moves with the unfolding reply. We instantiate this paradigm as EmoManifold, a training-free method that extracts a valence-arousal-dominance (VAD) coordinate from each hidden state, projects it, and drives the face at token granularity. The readout is checked on six language models, and the same projection drives our 29-degree-of-freedom (DoF) facial robot. When driven by this projection, the face shifts its expression in the matching direction on 87.5% of within-reply valence transitions, whereas holding a single label for the whole reply leaves directional tracking near the 50% chance level, and first moves in 0.96s rather than waiting 10-26s for the reply to finish and a turn-level label to return.

摘要（中文）：多样、语义同步且低延迟的面部表情对于人机交互至关重要。尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）已赋予仿人机器人流畅的语音能力，但其面部表情仍难以与对话内容保持同步。针对这一不足，我们提出了Emo-H2A（隐藏状态到驱动）范式，该范式在自回归解码过程中直接利用LLM的隐藏状态驱动面部机器人。无需独立的情感标签，表情即可保持连续且对语境敏感，面部动作随回复的展开而实时变化。我们将该范式实现为EmoManifold，一种免训练的方法，从每个隐藏状态中提取效价-唤醒-支配（VAD）坐标，进行投影，并以词元粒度驱动面部。该读出机制已在六种语言模型上验证，同一投影也用于驱动我们的29自由度（DoF）面部机器人。在该投影驱动下，面部在87.5%的回复内效价转换中沿匹配方向调整表情，而若为整个回复固定单一标签，则方向跟踪仅接近50%的随机水平；且首次动作在0.96秒内发生，无需等待10-26秒直至回复结束并返回轮次级标签。

Authors: Yige Liu, Jingcheng Huang, Hao Sun, Min Li, Zhouping Yin

A Hierarchical Onboard Vision-Language-Navigation Framework for Aerial Robots in Complex Environments VLN

vision-language-navigation aerial robots hierarchical framework 3D Gaussian Splatting onboard optimization

简要说明：VLN-AR 是一种面向无人机 hierarchical 视觉-语言-导航框架，将多模态推理与底层控制解耦，利用基于 3DGS 的数据管道和渐进式训练实现长时程导航，并通过机载优化实现资源受限平台上的高效部署。

TLDR: VLN-AR is a hierarchical vision-language-navigation framework for UAVs that decouples multimodal reasoning from low-level control, uses a 3DGS-based data pipeline and progressive training to enable long-horizon navigation, and applies onboard optimization for efficient deployment on resource-limited platforms.

Abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) are expected to achieve semantic reasoning, intelligent decision-making, and long-horizon navigation under strict onboard constraints. While recent foundation-model-driven approaches have shown promising progress toward this goal, existing methods remain limited by challenges in 3D data availability, trajectory feasibility, long-horizon reasoning, and computational efficiency in complex environments. To bridge these gaps, we propose VLN-AR, a hierarchical vision-language-navigation (VLN) framework for aerial robots. VLN-AR decouples multimodal reasoning and low-level control, enabling structured prediction of 3D pose commands and navigation intentions that are translated into dynamically feasible actions. To mitigate data scarcity and domain gaps, we introduce a fully automated 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)-based pipeline to generate scalable photorealistic UAV navigation data. A progressive three-stage training strategy further enhances grounding, scene reasoning, and complex navigation. In addition, a lightweight cognitive agent improves long-horizon reasoning via memory-aware task decomposition. Finally, we design onboard optimization techniques, including token sparsification and model lightweighting, achieving 7.1x-9.4x speedup while maintaining high navigation performance on resource-limited UAV platforms. Experiments show great improvements over existing methods in both simulation and real-world UAV navigation. Project website: https://wyz000.github.io/VLN-AR/

摘要（中文）：无人驾驶飞行器（UAV）预计在严格的机载约束下实现语义推理、智能决策和长时程导航。尽管近期基于基础模型的方法在实现这一目标方面展现出可喜进展，但现有方法仍受限于三维数据可用性、轨迹可行性、长时程推理以及复杂环境中计算效率等方面的挑战。为弥合这些差距，我们提出VLN-AR，一种面向空中机器人的层级式视觉-语言-导航（VLN）框架。VLN-AR将多模态推理与底层控制解耦，实现对三维位姿指令和导航意图的结构化预测，并将其转化为动力学上可行的动作。为缓解数据稀缺和领域差异问题，我们引入一种基于三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）的全自动流水线，用于生成可扩展的高保真无人机导航数据。渐进式三阶段训练策略进一步增强了接地感知、场景推理和复杂导航能力。此外，轻量化认知智能体通过记忆感知的任务分解提升长时程推理能力。最后，我们设计了机载优化技术，包括令牌稀疏化和模型轻量化，在资源受限的无人机平台上实现7.1倍至9.4倍的加速，同时保持高水平的导航性能。实验表明，在仿真和真实世界无人机导航中，该方法相较于现有方法均有显著提升。项目网站：https://wyz000.github.io/VLN-AR/

Authors: Yuze Wu, Mo Zhu, Xingxing Li, Yuheng Du, Zhaoqi Wang, Yuxin Fan, Wenjun Li, Kenghou Hoi, Zhichao Han, Xin Zhou, Fei Gao

RoboBuilder: Agentic Robot Co-Design with Real-world Video Feedback in the Loop Other

robot co-design coding agents real-world video feedback sim-to-real benchmark

简要说明：RoboBuilder是一个基准测试，AI智能体协同设计机器人的硬件和程序，并通过真实世界视频反馈来缩小模拟与现实的差距；在数千次模拟和数百个实体机器人上，智能体解决了许多任务，但在更难的任务上表现不佳。

TLDR: RoboBuilder is a benchmark where AI agents co-design robot hardware and programs, with real-world video feedback closing the sim-to-real gap; across thousands of simulations and hundreds of physical robots, agents solve many tasks but struggle at harder levels.

Abstract: Can AI agents design robots that work in the real world? We introduce RoboBuilder, a benchmark in which coding agents co-design a robot's hardware and program from standard parts, motors and a custom 3D-printed part, and every design that passes in simulation is built and tested on a physical course. Simulation alone is not enough: under public part data, none of 15 initial passing designs crossed the real course, so an agent learns the simulator from measurements it requests and videos of real runs. Across four frontier coding agents, ten obstacles at three difficulty levels, 16,427 simulations of 12,774 distinct robots and 135 physical robots built in an estimated 240 hours, agents solve nearly all easy obstacles and invent mechanisms our search baselines do not reach, but falter at harder levels, when one robot must cross every obstacle, and in the real world, where 66% of simulated passes hold across all levels. Closing the loop helps: shown a video of its real failure, an agent redesigns the robot, sometimes correcting its simulator, and removes 72% of level-1 and level-2 failures. RoboBuilder measures progress toward agents that engineer real machines. Project Page: https://ghadinehme.com/robobuilder.github.io/

摘要（中文）：能否让AI代理设计出能在现实世界中工作的机器人？我们引入了RoboBuilder，这是一个基准测试，其中编码代理需从标准零件、电机和定制3D打印部件出发，协同设计机器人的硬件与程序，并且每个在模拟中通过的设计都会被实际制造并在实体赛道上测试。仅靠模拟并不足够：在公开零件数据下，15个初始通过设计无一成功穿越真实赛道，因此代理需通过其请求的测量数据及真实运行视频来学习模拟器。在四个前沿编码代理、十个难度等级的三级障碍、16，427次模拟、12，774个不同机器人的设计以及估计耗时240小时制造的135个实体机器人中，代理几乎解决了所有简单障碍，并创造了我们的搜索基线未能触及的机制，但在更高难度级别、要求单一机器人穿越所有障碍时，以及现实世界中（66%的模拟通过率在各难度级别得以保持）则表现不佳。闭环反馈大有裨益：当代理看到其真实失败的视频后，会重新设计机器人，有时甚至修正模拟器，从而消除了72%的一级和二级故障。RoboBuilder衡量了代理在工程实际机器方面取得的进步。项目页面：https://ghadinehme.com/robobuilder.github.io/

Authors: Ghadi Nehme, Dahyun Nam, Akshay Govind Srinivasan, Faez Ahmed

TacPilot: Does Touch Need to Be Everywhere? Manipulation

tactile residual framework perception gate intervention gate contact-rich manipulation frozen visual policy

简要说明：TacPilot 提出了一种触觉残差框架，在冻结的视觉策略周围分离感知更新与动作修正，通过门控机制选择性刷新触觉特征并施加残差动作，提高了接触丰富操作的效率和成功率。

TLDR: TacPilot introduces a tactile residual framework that separates perception updates from action corrections around a frozen visual policy, using gates to selectively refresh tactile features and intervene with residual actions, improving contact-rich manipulation efficiency and success.

Abstract: Tactile feedback helps visual manipulation policies respond to local contact, but changes in tactile observations do not always require corrective motion, and sustained corrections do not always require new tactile features. We introduce TacPilot, a tactile residual framework that separates representation updates from action intervention around a frozen visual policy. TacPilot uses a perception gate to determine when tactile features need refreshing and updates only affected regions while reusing unchanged features. A separate intervention gate determines whether bounded Cartesian and gripper residuals modify the nominal visual action. This separation allows tactile perception and action correction to follow different spatial and temporal demands during manipulation. In offline expert-trajectory replay, local feature reuse reduces encoded regions by 56.4% relative to periodic full encoding, with essentially unchanged action predictions. In an exploratory simulation evaluation spanning two cylinder sizes, TacPilot succeeds in 26 of 30 trials (86.7%). We further validate TacPilot on OpenArm v2 equipped with Paxini tactile sensors across four contact-rich manipulation tasks.

摘要（中文）：触觉反馈有助于视觉操作策略应对局部接触，但触觉观测的变化并不总是需要修正动作，而持续的修正也不总是需要新的触觉特征。我们提出了TacPilot，一种触觉残差框架，它将表示更新与动作干预分离，并围绕冻结的视觉策略运行。TacPilot使用感知门来确定何时需要刷新触觉特征，仅更新受影响的区域，同时复用未变化的特征。单独的动作干预门决定有界的笛卡尔空间和夹爪残差是否修改名义视觉动作。这种分离使得触觉感知与动作修正能够在操作过程中遵循不同的空间和时间需求。在离线专家轨迹回放中，相较于周期性完整编码，局部特征复用将编码区域减少了56.4%，且动作预测基本不变。在一项涵盖两种圆柱尺寸的探索性仿真评估中，TacPilot在30次试验中成功26次（86.7%）。我们进一步在配备Paxini触觉传感器的OpenArm v2平台上，对四项接触密集操作任务验证了TacPilot的有效性。

Authors: Yunzhen Zhang, Yuxiao Zhu, Jie Yang, Yufeng Miao, Bing Luo

DOCK: Dual-Stream-Inspired Self-Supervised Object-Centric Representations Grounded in Robot Kinematics Manipulation

object-centric representations robot kinematics latent-space planning self-supervised learning manipulation

简要说明：本文提出DOCK，一种利用机器人运动学将潜在特征距离与物理位移对齐的物体中心表示学习方法，提高了模拟操作任务中的目标条件规划性能。

TLDR: The paper introduces DOCK, an object-centric representation learning method that aligns latent feature distances with physical displacements using robot kinematics, improving goal-conditioned planning in simulated manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Latent-space planners select actions by comparing the embedding of a predicted future image with that of a goal image. This assumes that distance in the embedding reflects how far the scene is from the goal. We profile this assumption with simulator-executed futures, which removes prediction error. For six frozen DINO and V-JEPA encoders, feature distance barely tracks the object's distance to its goal: the rank correlation is at most 0.11, against 0.87 for object-mask centroids. It is dominated by background and robot patches, and frozen-feature readouts capture the arm far better than the object. Inspired by the ventral (what) and dorsal (where/how) visual streams, we propose DOCK, which learns an object representation whose changes agree with measured physical motion. A grasped object moves with the gripper, so forward kinematics on the joint angles gives a proxy for the object's displacement without annotation. From 9,951 held-object transport trajectories in 21 simulated kitchen scenes, we mine 404K displacement pairs and train three components: an object token pooled from patch features (what), a spatial ruler that makes differences of readout coordinates equal to measured displacements (where), and a dynamics predictor over object tokens (how). Used as a planning cost, the learned representation places the object in 15 of 21 tasks, as many as an oracle that reads the true object position, while mask geometry reaches 10 and frozen feature distance 9. It still solves the most tasks when the unseen robot arm is visible, and its ranking transfers to held-out layouts with unseen object instances and categories without any adaptation.

摘要（中文）：潜在空间规划器通过比较预测未来图像的嵌入与目标图像的嵌入来选择行动。这假设嵌入空间中的距离反映了场景与目标之间的接近程度。我们通过模拟器执行未来轨迹来剖析这一假设，从而消除了预测误差。对于六个冻结的DINO和V-JEPA编码器，特征距离几乎无法跟踪物体与其目标的距离：秩相关性至多为0.11，而物体掩膜质心的秩相关性为0.87。特征距离主要由背景和机器人补丁主导，且冻结特征的读出对机械臂的捕捉远优于对物体的捕捉。受腹侧（是什么）和背侧（在哪里/如何）视觉通路的启发，我们提出了DOCK，该方法学习一种物体表示，其变化与测量的物理运动一致。被抓取的物体随夹爪移动，因此关节角的正向运动学为物体位移提供了无需标注的代理。从21个模拟厨房场景中的9,951条搬运物体轨迹中，我们挖掘出404K个位移对，并训练了三个组件：一个从补丁特征中汇集的物体标记（是什么）、一个使读出坐标差等于测量位移的空间标尺（在哪里），以及一个基于物体标记的动力学预测器（如何）。作为规划成本使用时，学习到的表示在21个任务中的15个中正确定位了物体，与读取真实物体位置的预言机表现相当，而掩膜几何达到10个，冻结特征距离达到9个。当未见的机器人手臂可见时，该方法仍能解决最多的任务，并且其排名无需任何适应即可迁移到包含未见物体实例和类别的保留布局上。

Authors: Pengju Liu, Caiwen Ding

LuxTac: A Flexible, Scalable, and Open-Source Optical Taxel Array with Distributed Three-Axis Force Sensing for Tactile Robot Learning Manipulation

optical taxel array three-axis force sensing tactile sensing robot learning Action Chunking Transformer

简要说明：LuxTac 提出了一种薄型、柔性、可扩展的光学触觉阵列，通过可更换的凝胶盒实现每个 taxel 的三轴力测量，并将其集成到 Action Chunking Transformer 策略中，显著提升了插销任务的成功率。

TLDR: LuxTac presents a thin, flexible, scalable optical taxel array that measures three-axis force per taxel using interchangeable cartridges, and demonstrates improved peg-in-hole task success when integrated into an Action Chunking Transformer policy.

Abstract: Low-cost tactile arrays have made touch a practical input for robot learning, but piezoresistive designs sense only pressure, while camera-based sensors that also resolve shear are too bulky to tile over a gripper. To solve this problem, we present LuxTac, a flexible, scalable optical taxel array, about 3.5 mm thick and built from off-the-shelf parts. Each taxel is a digital RGBC light-to-digital converter under a translucent white silicone layer capped by an opaque black film, so the back-scattered LED light falls monotonically with local indentation depth. The same board accepts two interchangeable gel cartridges: a plain one for normal sensing, and one with colored walls that encodes the local shear in the color of the returned light, with no camera, magnets, or bump overlay, making LuxTac, to our knowledge, the first optical taxel array to resolve shear at individual taxels. Characterized with an automated CNC indenter and a six-axis force/torque sensor, the normal cartridge responds linearly to force ($R^2$ = 0.999) from 104 mN to at least 5.8 N, with 2.0% repeatability, 5.9% hysteresis, and a taxel-to-taxel variation of 6-10% after normalization. With the shear cartridge, per-taxel models estimate the three-axis force at every taxel; across three indenter shapes and nine held-out sessions, the summed estimates reach $R^2$ = 0.96/0.96/0.92 in x/y/z, each taxel's estimate 0.92/0.93/0.94, and the median shear-direction error is 4.8 degrees. Adding LuxTac pressure readings to an Action Chunking Transformer policy substantially improves peg-in-hole success over a vision-only baseline. Design files, code, and videos are available at https://luxtac.github.io.

摘要（中文）：低成本触觉阵列的应用使得触觉成为机器人学习中的一种实用输入方式，但压阻式设计仅能感知压力，而能够同时解析剪力的基于摄像头的传感器又过于庞大，难以在夹爪上密集铺设。为解决这一问题，我们提出了LuxTac——一种柔性、可扩展的光学触觉单元阵列，厚度约3.5毫米，由现成元件构建而成。每个触觉单元为一个数字RGBC光数字转换器，置于半透明白色硅胶层下方，表面覆盖不透明黑色薄膜，因此背向散射的LED光强度随局部压入深度单调递减。同一电路板可兼容两种可互换的凝胶盒：一种为平面型，用于法向力感知；另一种带有彩色壁结构，通过反射光的颜色编码局部剪力信息，无需摄像头、磁铁或凸起覆盖层。据我们所知，LuxTac是首个能够在单个触觉单元上解析剪力的光学触觉阵列。通过自动化CNC压头和六轴力/力矩传感器进行表征，法向力感知凝胶盒在104 mN至至少5.8 N范围内对力的响应呈线性（$R^2$ = 0.999），重复性为2.0%，迟滞为5.9%，归一化后单元间差异为6–10%。使用剪力感知凝胶盒时，每个触觉单元的模型可估计该点的三轴力；在三种压头形状和九个保留测试会话中，总和估计在x/y/z方向上的$R^2$分别达到0.96/0.96/0.92，各单元估计值为0.92/0.93/0.94，剪切方向误差中位数为4.8度。将LuxTac压力读数加入Action Chunking Transformer策略后，相较于仅依赖视觉的基线方法，插孔任务的成功率显著提升。设计文件、代码和视频可在 https://luxtac.github.io 获取。

Authors: Md Rakibul Islam Prince, John Pelan, Zhiyuan Zhang, Adyaa Khera, Katherine Pesetski, Adeesh Desai, Akimizu Sugiyama, Minwoo Ki, Benjamin Alan Capelle, Temitope Ibrahim Amosa, Zijie Xu, Yihan Huang, Taehun Chung, Long Wang, Wei Li, Shaoting Lin, Yu She

Panini- Feasible Grammar For Robot Designs Locomotion

typed production grammar robot morphologies SE(3) cross-entropy search geometric coordination

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于生成机器人形态和操作技能的带类型产生式文法，并在 SE(3) 中进行几何实现；同时介绍了 PANINI，一种基于文法的表示上的交叉熵搜索方法，可保证设计合法性并提高几何协调性。

TLDR: This paper introduces a typed production grammar for generating robot morphologies and manipulation skills, with geometric realization in SE(3), and presents PANINI, a cross-entropy search method over grammar-based representations that guarantees legal designs by construction and improves geometric coordination.

Abstract: Symbolic methods make robot designs interpretable but often overlook continuous geometry; learned methods handle geometry but offer less transparent structure. We introduce a typed production grammar that uses case-role relations, parameter inheritance, and specificity-based rule arbitration to generate both manipulation skills and robot morphologies. A geometric realization map translates grammar composition into transformations in SE(3), behaving as a monoid homomorphism when inheritance is inactive and exhibiting a measurable defect when inheritance is enabled. The grammar provides a compact representation, and its arbitration decisions can be recovered from geometric containment (agreement 0.905 +/- 0.062 across 10 seeds, versus 0.611 +/- 0.090 for a Euclidean control). We also introduce PANINI, a cross-entropy search method over grammar-based morphology representations. Across 30 methods and 24 seeds, PANINI achieves the best mean rank but is not statistically distinguishable from strong generic optimizers. Its main demonstrated advantage is therefore structural rather than optimization performance: grammar-generated designs are legal by construction, and coordinated limb placement produces 95% jointly feasible edits, compared with 55% for range-constrained resampling and none for flat parameterization in 6,000 draws. These results show how typed grammars can make robot generation more interpretable and geometrically coordinated, without implying that every feasible design will locomote or that grammar-based search universally outperforms generic optimizers.

摘要（中文）：摘要：符号化方法使机器人设计具有可解释性，但往往忽视连续几何信息；学习方法能处理几何信息，但结构透明度较低。我们引入一种带类型的生成文法，利用角色关系、参数继承和基于特异性的规则仲裁来同时生成操作技能和机器人形态。几何实现映射将文法组合转换为SE(3)中的变换，当继承未启用时表现为幺半群同态，而当继承启用时则表现出可测量的缺陷。该文法提供紧凑的表示形式，其仲裁决策可从几何包含关系中恢复（10个种子上的一致性为0.905 ± 0.062，而欧几里得对照为0.611 ± 0.090）。我们还提出PANINI，一种基于文法形态表示的交叉熵搜索方法。在30种方法和24个种子中，PANINI取得最佳平均排名，但在统计上与强通用优化器无显著差异。因此，其主要优势体现在结构性而非优化性能上：文法生成的设计天然合法，且协调的肢体布局可产生95%的联合可行编辑，而范围约束重采样为55%，平坦参数化在6,000次采样中则为0。这些结果表明，带类型文法可使机器人生成更具可解释性和几何协调性，但并不意味着每个可行设计都能运动，也不意味着基于文法的搜索普遍优于通用优化器。

Authors: Mayukh Debnath, Manan Roy Choudhury

RESCUE Jumper: A Centimeter-Scale Rolling and Jumping Robot for Search and Rescue Locomotion

centimeter-scale robot rolling and jumping search and rescue elastic energy jump control

简要说明：本文介绍了RESCUE Jumper，一种结合滚动与跳跃运动的厘米级搜救机器人，并对其随缠绕速度变化的跳跃行为进行了建模。

TLDR: This paper presents the RESCUE Jumper, a centimeter-scale robot combining rolling and jumping locomotion for search and rescue, with a model of its winding-speed-dependent jumping behavior.

Abstract: Centimeter-scale robots are promising for urban search and rescue because they can enter confined spaces that are inaccessible or unsafe for humans. However, their small size limits obstacle traversal after deployment. This paper presents the RESCUE Jumper, a 125 g mobile robot with a 6.2 cm width and 6.2 cm diameter wheels that combines ground rolling with jumping to traverse steps and gaps that exceeds its rolling capability. The RESCUE Jumper uses its two actuators for both rolling mode and jumping by reversing the direction of wheel motion. Forward wheel motion enables rolling, while reverse wheel motion winds a spring steel tail to store elastic potential energy and release it for jumping. The RESCUE Jumper varies tail winding speed to control jump direction, transitioning from backward to forward jumps as winding speed increases from 0.75 rad/s to 8.73 rad/s. The launch angle of the jumps ranges from 45 degree to -11 degree with respect to the vertical axis, reaching a maximum height of 9.2 cm and a maximum lateral displacement of 11.2 cm. We model the winding speed-dependent jumping behavior in three phases: tail release to determine the contact point and robot orientation, tail straightening until liftoff, and ballistic flight to predict jump height and lateral displacement. Finally, qualitative tests highlight the robot's locomotion in cluttered, real-world environments. The model and experiments presented in this work can inform future designs of space-constrained jump mechanisms in centimeter-scale robots for search and rescue and inspection in unstructured environments.

摘要（中文）：厘米级机器人在城市搜索与救援领域具有广阔前景，因为它们能够进入人类无法进入或存在危险的空间。然而，其小巧的尺寸限制了部署后的越障能力。本文介绍了RESCUE Jumper——一款重125克、宽6.2厘米、配备直径6.2厘米车轮的移动机器人，它将地面滚动与跳跃相结合，以跨越超出其滚动能力的台阶和间隙。RESCUE Jumper通过反转车轮运动方向，仅利用两个执行器即可同时实现滚动模式和跳跃模式。正向车轮运动实现滚动，而反向车轮运动则卷绕弹簧钢尾巴以储存弹性势能，并在释放时实现跳跃。RESCUE Jumper通过改变尾巴卷绕速度来控制跳跃方向，当卷绕速度从0.75弧度/秒增加到8.73弧度/秒时，跳跃从向后跳跃转变为向前跳跃。跳跃发射角度相对于垂直轴范围为45°至-11°，最大跳跃高度达9.2厘米，最大横向位移为11.2厘米。我们将随卷绕速度变化的跳跃行为建模为三个阶段：尾巴释放以确定接触点和机器人姿态、尾巴伸展直至离地、以及弹道飞行以预测跳跃高度和横向位移。最后，定性测试展示了机器人在杂乱真实环境中的移动能力。本研究提出的模型和实验可为未来在非结构化环境中用于搜索救援和检测的厘米级机器人中空间受限跳跃机构的设计提供参考。

Authors: Kiran Marques, Shashwat Singh, Ben D'Ambrosia, Zeynep Temel, Melisa Orta Martinez

Learning and Control in Physically Coupled Dynamical Systems RLRobot

physically coupled dynamical systems reinforcement learning robotic platform ball-in-maze inverted pendulum

简要说明：本文介绍了TAG，一个结合迷宫球台和倒立摆的紧凑型机器人平台，用于研究物理耦合动态系统中的学习与控制，采用基于模型和无模型的强化学习独立训练策略以适应耦合。

TLDR: This paper introduces TAG, a compact robotic platform combining a ball-in-maze board with an inverted pendulum to study learning and control in physically coupled dynamical systems, using model-based and model-free RL to train independent policies that adapt to coupling.

Abstract: We introduce TAG (Testbed for Autonomous Games), a compact, low-cost robotic platform for studying learning and control in physically coupled dynamical systems. TAG combines an actively tilted and steered ball-in-maze board with a top-mounted rotary inverted pendulum. The pendulum's reaction torque and vibration disturb the board and marble, while the board's tilt, driven by the maze-solving policy, simultaneously disturbs the pendulum's balance. The main challenge in learning control policies for each subsystem is accounting for the impact of one subsystem's dynamics on the other's learning process. To address this challenge, we present complementary reinforcement learning paradigms, leveraging model-based and model-free approaches to learn the control policies for the maze and pendulum, respectively. Our key finding is that introducing the pendulum causes an immediate, sharp drop in the maze policy's success rate, but the policy adapts online and recovers to its pre-coupling performance within a small number of learning episodes. Experimental results show that both policies, trained independently, successfully control the maze board and the pendulum despite their physical coupling.

摘要（中文）：我们介绍TAG（自主游戏测试平台），这是一个紧凑、低成本的机器人平台，用于研究物理耦合动态系统中的学习与控制。TAG将主动倾斜和转向的球迷宫板与顶部安装的旋转倒立摆相结合。摆的反作用力矩和振动干扰棋盘及滚珠，而由迷宫求解策略驱动的棋盘倾斜同时扰乱摆的平衡。为各子系统学习控制策略的主要挑战在于考虑一个子系统的动力学对另一个子系统学习过程的影响。为应对这一挑战，我们提出了互补强化学习范式，分别利用基于模型和无模型的方法学习迷宫和摆的控制策略。我们的关键发现是，引入摆会导致迷宫策略成功率立即急剧下降，但该策略能在少量学习回合内在线适应并恢复到耦合前性能。实验结果表明，尽管两个策略独立训练，它们仍能在物理耦合条件下成功控制迷宫棋盘和摆。

Authors: Bao Trung Truong, Dat Thanh Nguyen, Thinh T. Doan

Learned versus Kinematic Trajectory Prediction under Reduced Observation Frequency AutonomousDriving

trajectory prediction reduced observation frequency V2X Argoverse 2 LSTM

简要说明：本文评估了在V2X观测频率降低时，学习型轨迹预测模型是否保持对运动学模型的优势，发现除行人外，学习模型在所有频率下仍保持24-30%的误差降低。

TLDR: This paper evaluates whether learned trajectory prediction models maintain an advantage over kinematic models for autonomous driving when V2X observation frequency is reduced, finding that learned models retain 24-30% error reduction over kinematics at all tested frequencies, except for pedestrians where constant velocity is more accurate.

Abstract: Trajectory prediction models for automated driving are usually trained on data with a fixed sampling frequency, while positions received via vehicle-to-everything (V2X) communication arrive at 1-10 Hz. We study whether a learned predictor that uses only the observation history keeps its advantage over constant velocity (CV) and constant acceleration (CA) models when the history frequency drops. On the Argoverse 2 motion forecasting dataset, the 5 s history of the focal agent was downsampled from 10 Hz to 5, 2, and 1 Hz, and the 6 s future was predicted without maps or neighboring agents. An LSTM-based recurrent neural network (RNN) trained for each frequency was compared with the same network trained at 10 Hz and applied to sparse histories after linear interpolation. Hypotheses and thresholds were fixed before training, the main RNNs were trained with ten seeds each, and results on 24,984 test scenarios have bootstrap confidence intervals over scenarios and seeds. The average displacement error of the frequency-specific RNN grew by 3.1% at 5 Hz, 10.1% at 2 Hz, and 20.3% at 1 Hz. Contrary to our hypothesis, its advantage over the better kinematic model did not vanish on straight motion and was 24-30% on both straight motion and turns at every frequency, while for pedestrians CV was more accurate. The 10 Hz model with interpolation was at most 1.3% less accurate than the frequency-specific model down to 2 Hz but 11.5% less accurate at 1 Hz. Each hypothesis was only partly supported.

摘要（中文）：自动驾驶轨迹预测模型通常以固定采样频率的数据进行训练，而通过车联网（V2X）通信获取的位置数据则以1-10 Hz的频率到达。我们研究了当历史数据频率降低时，仅使用观测历史训练的预测模型是否仍能保持其对匀速（CV）和匀加速（CA）模型的优势。在Argoverse 2运动预测数据集上，将焦点智能体的5秒历史数据从10 Hz降采样至5 Hz、2 Hz和1 Hz，并在无地图或邻域智能体的条件下预测未来6秒轨迹。针对每种频率训练的基于LSTM的循环神经网络（RNN）与在10 Hz下训练并在线性插值后应用于稀疏历史数据的同一网络进行了比较。假设和阈值在训练前固定，主RNN分别以十个随机种子进行训练，在24,984个测试场景上的结果包含了场景和种子的自助法置信区间。频率专用RNN的平均位移误差在5 Hz时增加了3.1%，在2 Hz时增加了10.1%，在1 Hz时增加了20.3%。与我们的假设相反，其在直线运动上的优势并未消失，且在直线运动和转弯场景中均保持24-30%的优于较优运动学模型的性能，而在行人场景中CV模型更为准确。采用插值法的10 Hz模型在降至2 Hz时精度损失最多不超过1.3%，但在1 Hz时精度损失达11.5%。每项假设仅得到部分支持。

Authors: Nukhbala Gadzhiev, Alexander Morochko

Embodied Graph: A Relational World Model for Long-Horizon Tasks WorldModel

relational world model graph state abstraction long-horizon imagination embodied agents sparse state dynamics

简要说明：本文提出Embodied Graph，一种在稀疏图状态抽象上进行想象的关系世界模型，用于长时程任务，并在具身环境（Minecraft、Crafter）及网页交互中验证了有效性。

TLDR: The paper proposes Embodied Graph, a relational world model that imagines over sparse graph state abstractions for long-horizon tasks, and demonstrates effectiveness in embodied (Minecraft, Crafter) and web environments.

Abstract: Long-horizon tasks in embodied and web environments involve extended decision sequences and delayed feedback, making accurate planning crucial for success. World models tackle this by learning latent dynamics for imagination-based planning. However, existing approaches merely rely on dense pixel-level observations, which forces the model to absorb redundant information while overlooking relations among task-relevant entities. Consequently, small errors may accumulate over long imagined rollouts and gradually corrupt the predictions. In this paper, we explore world models that imagine over sparse state abstractions, which poses two key challenges: 1) how to remove redundant information and form a compact state abstraction; 2) how to incorporate the relational structure to learn reliable long-horizon dynamics. To address these challenges, we propose Embodied Graph, a relational state abstraction that supports structured dynamics modeling and long-horizon imagination, and the Relational World Model (RWM), which performs imagination directly over graph states. RWM consists of (i) a Task-Aware Embodied Graph Constructor that filters redundant details and maintains graph memory through online updates, and (ii) an Embodied Graph Recurrent State Space Model that learns node-wise latent dynamics while capturing inter-node dependencies. The imagined graph states provide predictions of action consequences to guide decision-making. Experiments on Minecraft and Crafter demonstrate the effectiveness of RWM in embodied environments. Notably, in Minecraft, RWM is the only method that obtains diamonds within the given budget. Experiments on web interaction further illustrate the applicability of relational state prediction to the decision making process of web agents.

摘要（中文）：长程任务在具身及网络环境中涉及延伸的决策序列与延迟的反馈，这使得精确规划成为成功的关键。世界模型通过学习潜在动态以支持基于想象的规划来应对这一挑战。然而，现有方法仅依赖密集的像素级观测，迫使模型吸收冗余信息的同时忽略了任务相关实体间的关系。因此，即便微小的误差也可能在长时间想象展开中累积，逐渐破坏预测准确性。本文探索了在稀疏状态抽象上进行想象的世界模型，这带来了两大核心挑战：1）如何去除冗余信息，构建紧凑的状态抽象；2）如何融入关系结构，学习可靠的长程动态。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了具身图（Embodied Graph），一种支持结构化动态建模与长程想象的关系状态抽象，以及关系世界模型（Relational World Model, RWM），该模型直接在图形状态上进行想象。RWM由两部分组成：（i）任务感知具身图构建器，通过在线更新过滤冗余细节并维持图形记忆；（ii）具身图递归状态空间模型，学习节点级潜在动态并捕获节点间的依赖关系。想象的图形状态提供了行动后果的预测，以指导决策制定。在Minecraft和Crafter上的实验证明了RWM在具身环境中的有效性。值得注意的是，在Minecraft中，RWM是给定预算内唯一获得钻石的方法。针对网络交互的实验也进一步展示了关系状态预测应用于网络代理决策过程的适用性。

Authors: Zongyuan Wu, Xin Wang, Tongtong Feng, Yuan Meng, Zeyang Zhang, Ling Feng, Wenwu Zhu

Vanguard: Knowing When to Trust the Draft in Speculative Vision-Language Agents VLA

speculative decoding vision-language agents decision model latency reduction embodied agents

简要说明：Vanguard 是一种用于视觉语言代理投机解码的免训练判断器，通过截图判断小模型草稿是否可信，在网页、移动和具身任务上提升准确率并降低延迟。

TLDR: Vanguard is a training-free judge for speculative decoding in vision-language agents, using screenshots to decide when a small model's draft is trustworthy, improving accuracy and latency across web, mobile, and embodied tasks.

Abstract: Vision-language agents that browse websites, operate phones and act in homes reason before every action, so every step waits for a large model, a latency and cost that stand in the way of deployment. Step-level speculation lets a small model draft each step and calls the large model only on rejected drafts, but its outcome rests on the judge, and a judge that reads only a step's text cannot tell whether the step fits the screen it acts on. We find that a few samples of a small model can contain a correct step about as often as the large model gets the step right, and not always on the same steps: checked against the screen, small drafts can be not only cheaper but better. We present Vanguard, a training-free judge that leaves the draft and target models unchanged: a general decision model, with the screenshot in view, gives each candidate step a probability of being right in one forward pass; the best candidate is kept if it clears a threshold, and otherwise the large model writes the step. On web, mobile and embodied agents, a 2B draft judged by Vanguard is at least as accurate as its 8B target and significantly more accurate on Mind2Web and EB-ALFRED, while the target writes only a minority of the steps; it completes far more closed-loop episodes, and with a 27B target from another family it is both faster and more accurate. Vanguard is the most accurate judge we compare on the agent tasks; it relies on the screenshot on web and mobile tasks, its calibrated threshold transfers to unseen websites, and across model families its gain over the target grows with the draft's pass@4 relative to the target's accuracy. Vanguard composes with token-level speculative decoding and matches trained process reward models on mathematics, turning speculation from a way to save the large model's work into one that can improve on it.

摘要（中文）：摘要：浏览网站、操作手机以及在现实环境中行动的视觉-语言智能体在每次行动前都需要进行推理，因此每一步都在等待大模型的响应，这种延迟和成本阻碍了其实际部署。步级推测允许小模型起草每一步，仅在草稿被拒绝时才调用大模型，但其效果取决于评判器，而仅读取步骤文本的评判器无法判断该步骤是否适配其所作用的屏幕。我们发现，小模型的少量样本中包含正确步骤的频率与大模型正确生成步骤的频率相当，且并不总是在相同的步骤上正确：结合屏幕进行检查时，小模型的草稿不仅可能更便宜，还可能更优。我们提出Vanguard，一种无需训练的评判器，它保持草稿模型和目标模型不变：一个通用决策模型，在查看截图的情况下，通过一次前向传播为每个候选步骤给出其正确的概率；若最佳候选步骤超过阈值则保留，否则由大模型生成该步骤。在网页、移动端和具身智能体任务中，由Vanguard评判的2B草稿模型的准确率至少与其8B目标模型相当，在Mind2Web和EB-ALFRED上显著更高，同时目标模型仅负责生成少部分步骤；它完成了更多闭环任务，并且在与另一个系列的27B目标模型配合时，既更快又更准确。在智能体任务中，Vanguard是我们比较中最准确的评判器；它依赖网页和移动任务中的截图，其经过校准的阈值可迁移至未见过的网站，并且跨模型系列时，其相对目标模型的增益随草稿模型的pass@4与目标模型准确率的比值增大而提高。Vanguard可与词元级推测解码组合使用，在数学任务上匹配训练过的过程奖励模型，将推测从一种节省大模型工作量的方式转变为一种能够超越大模型的方式。

Authors: Hanqi Mao, Jiajun Fan, Ruihan Guo, Shuaike Shen, Ziwen Wang, Hui Ren, Xianrui Zhong, Ge Liu

HandWorldBench: A Unified Benchmark for Hand-Centric World Models WorldModel

hand-centric world models benchmark hand-object interaction cross-embodiment temporal coherence

简要说明：HandWorldBench 是一个用于评估手部中心世界模型的基准，涵盖人类手、仿真灵巧手和真实灵巧手，发现强手部姿态控制并不保证连贯的物体状态演化或跨实体性能。

TLDR: HandWorldBench is a benchmark for evaluating hand-centric world models across human, simulated, and real dexterous hands, revealing that strong hand-pose control does not ensure coherent object-state evolution or cross-embodiment performance.

Abstract: Recent advances in world models are opening new possibilities for fine-grained embodied tasks, with hand-object interaction offering a particularly demanding setting. Modeling these interactions involves capturing how hand actions change objects and how the resulting states persist over time. Yet systematic evaluation tailored to these hand-centric capabilities remains underdeveloped. To address this gap, we introduce HandWorldBench, a unified benchmark that systematically evaluates hand-centric world models across human hands, simulated dexterous hands, and real dexterous hands along six dimensions: visual quality, hand fidelity, appearance consistency, instruction following, physical consistency, and temporal coherence. To construct the benchmark, we develop a data curation pipeline that extracts hand-object interaction clips and screens them for quality, yielding 20,500 high-quality egocentric clips from over 600 hours of footage. We then manually select 500 clips covering seven task families for evaluation. Benchmarking eleven models under a unified protocol reveals that stronger hand-pose control does not consistently translate into coherent object-state evolution and persistence or robust cross-embodiment performance, with several specialized hand-control models underperforming general-purpose text/image-to-video generators on dexterous-hand tasks.

摘要（中文）：近期世界模型的进展为细粒度具身任务开启了新的可能性，其中手物交互构成了尤为苛刻的挑战场景。对此类交互进行建模，需要捕捉手部动作如何改变物体状态，以及这些状态如何随时间持续演变。然而，针对这些以手为中心的能力的系统性评估仍发展不足。为填补这一空白，我们提出了HandWorldBench，一个统一的基准测试，系统性地评估以手为中心的世界模型，覆盖人类手部、仿真灵巧手和真实灵巧手，并从六个维度进行衡量：视觉质量、手部保真度、外观一致性、指令遵循、物理一致性和时间连贯性。为构建该基准，我们开发了一条数据整理流程，从超过600小时的视频素材中提取手物交互片段并进行质量筛选，最终获得20,500个高质量的自我中心视角片段。随后，我们人工选取了覆盖七个任务类别的500个片段用于评估。在统一协议下对十一个模型进行基准测试的结果表明，更强的手部姿态控制并不总能转化为连贯的物体状态演化和持续性，也不一定能带来稳健的跨具身形态表现；相反，多个专门的手部控制模型在灵巧手任务上甚至不如通用的文本/图像到视频生成模型。

Authors: Zhaolu Wang, Jiacheng Xu, Lihong Wang, Shuqing Wang, Jianjie Fang, Ziyou Wang, Xvyuan Liu, Rongze Tang, Yiding Ma, Xin Zhang, Jiawei Chen, Wei Wu, Chen Gao, Yong Li, Zhibo Chen

Improving Zero-shot 3D Semantic Mapping in Offroad with Geometric Priors Perception3D

semantic 3D mapping zero-shot geometric priors vision foundation models offroad navigation

简要说明：本文通过为每个语义类别拟合几何先验（球度-高度分布），并将其与视觉基础模型的预测融合，提升了越野环境下零样本3D语义地图的准确性。

TLDR: The paper improves zero-shot semantic 3D mapping in offroad environments by fitting geometric priors (sphericity-elevation distributions) per semantic class from confident vision model predictions, and fusing them with vision model outputs to boost mapping accuracy.

Abstract: Semantic 3D mapping is a powerful representation that enables platform agnostic mobile robot navigation in challenging offroad conditions. Current vision foundation models can accurately predict semantics zero-shot on structured scenes but performance is compromised in natural environments. On the other hand, 3D point clouds encode valuable information for discriminating semantics in scenarios where vision foundation models fail. In this work, we propose fitting a sphericity-elevation distribution for each semantic class to act as geometric anchor. Only the points with the most confident vision foundation model predictions are considered when fitting to produce high quality geometric prior distributions. The geometric prior is fused with the vision foundation model prediction to produce the final semantic mapping. The proposed prior improves SAM3 baseline by +6.3 in mIoU and +8.9 in accuracy on the RELLIS-3D dataset, and by +1.7 in mIoU and +2.1 in accuracy on the WildScenes dataset. The source code will be made public upon paper acceptance.

摘要（中文）：语义三维建图是一种强大的表示方法，能够在具有挑战性的越野条件下实现与平台无关的移动机器人导航。当前的视觉基础模型可以在结构化场景中零样本准确地预测语义信息，但在自然环境中性能会有所下降。另一方面，三维点云在视觉基础模型失效的场景中，编码了用于区分语义的有价值信息。在本工作中，我们提出为每个语义类别拟合一个球形度-高程分布，作为几何锚点。在拟合时，仅考虑视觉基础模型预测置信度最高的点，以生成高质量的几何先验分布。该几何先验与视觉基础模型的预测结果相融合，产生最终的语义建图。所提出的先验方法在RELLIS-3D数据集上将SAM3基线的mIoU提升了+6.3，准确率提升了+8.9；在WildScenes数据集上将mIoU提升了+1.7，准确率提升了+2.1。源代码将在论文被接收后公开。

Authors: Eerik Alamikkotervo, Risto Ojala

Comparing Each Generation with Independent Siblings Gives Video World Model Post-Training a Proper Objective for Outcome Frequencies WorldModel

video world models post-training inverse-frequency weighting policy optimization outcome frequencies

简要说明：SibPO 提出了一种用于视频世界模型后训练的配对策略优化目标，通过独立同源生成对估计的反频率权重，修正了自由运行模拟中的结果频率偏差，且不损害单视频保真度；在 PisaBench 上，着陆时间分布的 KS 距离最多降低 10.2%，机器人策略成功率估计误差降低 13%。

TLDR: SibPO proposes a sibling-paired policy optimization objective for video world model post-training, which corrects outcome frequencies in free-running simulations without degrading single-video fidelity, as demonstrated on PisaBench with improved landing-time distributions and robot policy success-rate estimation.

Abstract: Video world models are used as simulators, so when a first frame leaves several physical outcomes open, repeated generations should produce each outcome as often as it occurs in the data. Physics post-training scores every generation against the single recorded future of its history, which makes single videos more faithful, but the expected score is linear in the model distribution and is maximized by always producing the most likely outcome. The log-likelihood of the recorded outcome is maximized by the data distribution, and its gradient weights agreement with the record by the inverse of how often the model produces the generated outcome, a frequency that other generations of the same history with independent noise, its siblings, can estimate. To train with this weight from a finite group, we propose SibPO, which performs Sibling-paired Policy Optimization: siblings estimate a truncated inverse-frequency weight for agreement with the record, and a second term subtracts the same weight times the agreement with the siblings, which makes the expected objective a strictly proper divergence over outcome cells at every group size. On PisaBench, SibPO lowers the KS distance to simulated landing times by 9.1-10.2% relative to the strongest method outside its reward family on three of four video models without degrading single videos, and it lowers the error of estimated robot policy success rates by 13%.

摘要（中文）：视频世界模型被用作模拟器，因此当首帧留下多种可能的物理结果时，重复生成应按照各结果在数据中出现的频率产生每种结果。物理后训练依据每条生成结果与其历史中唯一记录的未来之间的匹配程度进行评分，这使得单个视频更加忠实，但期望得分是模型分布的线性函数，且总是生成最可能的结果才能使其最大化。记录结果的 log 似然由数据分布最大化，其梯度通过模型生成该生成结果的频率的倒数来加权与记录的一致性，该频率可由同一历史中具有独立噪声的其他生成结果（即其同辈）估算。为了在有限分组中利用该权重进行训练，我们提出 SibPO，即同辈配对策略优化（Sibling-paired Policy Optimization）：同辈估算一个截断的逆频率权重，用于衡量与记录的一致性；第二项则减去相同权重乘以与同辈的一致性，这使得期望目标在任意分组大小下都成为结果单元上的严格真散度。在 PisaBench 上，SibPO 在四个视频模型中的三个上，将模拟着陆时间的 KS 距离相对于其奖励族之外的最强方法降低了 9.1%-10.2%，且不损害单个视频质量，并将估计的机器人策略成功率的误差降低了 13%。

Authors: Xin Li, Yiwen Chen

StrideWorld: Benchmarking Scene Rigidity and Action Consistency in Interactive Video World Model WorldModel

interactive video world model benchmark scene rigidity action consistency camera motion

简要说明：StrideWorld 是一个针对交互式视频世界模型的基准，通过地面真实几何和步幅动作一致性评估场景刚性和动作一致性，揭示了现有开放模型中的普遍场景变形和动作不一致问题。

TLDR: StrideWorld is a benchmark for interactive video world models that evaluates scene rigidity against ground-truth geometry and action consistency against stride-based camera motion, revealing widespread scene deformation and action inconsistency in current open models.

Abstract: Interactive video world models turn user commands into the exploration of a generated scene, which requires the scene to keep its 3D structure as the camera moves and each action to keep a stable effect. Existing benchmarks mostly evaluate these properties against references fitted to the video under test, either a scene reconstructed from its own frames or a camera trajectory aligned to the command path with a free scale. Such references can absorb gradual scene deformation and changes in pace and route length, so these errors can pass undetected. We therefore introduce StrideWorld, a benchmark whose references are fixed before the motion they judge. It evaluates scene rigidity against the ground-truth geometry of the start view, and action consistency against the stride of each action, the camera motion of one command. The stride is measured on the model's first steps and then used to test the steps that follow, so each model is judged only against its own steps. Its measurements are validated on rendered videos with known camera motion, and its scores agree with human judgments. Across \nvideos{} videos generated by \nmodels{} open models from $140$ start views, all models but one deform their scenes as the camera moves, with offsets up to $7.3$ times those of a rigid rendering along the same camera path. Most models keep a steady pace when a single action is held. Along composed routes, several models often stall, and most completed routes end away from the positions predicted by each model's own strides. Only the two models that scale commands by the estimated scene depth bring most routes close to these positions. Fine-tuning two models on a few rendered clips removes most of their mid-route stalls. Code, data, and a leaderboard are publicly available at https://github.com/chuangwang123/strideworld.

摘要（中文）：交互式视频世界模型将用户指令转化为对生成场景的探索，这要求场景在相机移动时保持其三维结构，并且每个动作保持稳定的效果。现有基准大多根据与测试视频拟合的参考来评估这些性质，这些参考要么是从视频自身帧重建的场景，要么是与指令路径对齐且尺度自由的相机轨迹。此类参考可吸收场景的逐渐形变以及步幅和路径长度变化，导致这些误差无法被检测。为此，我们引入StrideWorld，一个在其评测的运动发生前便固定参考的基准。它依据起始视角的真实几何结构评估场景刚性，并依据每个动作的步幅（单条指令对应的相机运动）评估动作一致性。步幅在模型的前几步中测得，随后用于检验后续步骤，因此每个模型仅与其自身步骤进行比较。该测量在已知相机运动的渲染视频上得到验证，其评分与人工判断一致。在由\nmodels{}个开放模型从140个起始视角生成的\nvideos{}段视频中，除一个模型外，所有模型在相机移动时均使场景发生形变，偏移量最高达沿相同相机路径刚性渲染偏移量的7.3倍。大多数模型在持续执行单一动作时能保持稳定步幅。在组合路径中，多个模型经常出现停滞，且大多数完成路径的终点偏离各模型自身步幅预测的位置。仅有两个通过估计场景深度缩放指令的模型使多数路径接近预测终点。对两个模型在少量渲染片段上进行微调可消除其大部分路径中途停滞问题。代码、数据及排行榜公开于https://github.com/chuangwang123/strideworld。

Authors: Chuang Wang, Rui Nie, Jie Song, Junyuan Gao, Jiahe Song, Haitao Zhou, Boyu Zhu, Xing Li, Jiang Wu, Conghui He, Qian Yu, Weijia Li

Pixel2Perspective: A Benchmark for Multi-Modal and Multi-View Generalization in Vision-Language Models Other

open-vocabulary semantic segmentation multi-modal benchmark uncertainty quantification outdoor perception embodied AI

简要说明：Pixel2Perspective提出了一个面向室外环境多角度、多模态开放词汇分割的基准，以及一种跨RGB和红外数据量化不确定性的方法，旨在提升具身AI的鲁棒感知。

TLDR: Pixel2Perspective introduces a benchmark for multi-angle, multi-modal open-vocabulary segmentation in outdoor settings, plus a method to quantify uncertainty across RGB and infrared data, aiming to improve robust perception for embodied AI.

Abstract: Embodied AI systems, such as drones and autonomous vehicles, improve navigation by enhancing perception in environments containing unseen objects. While Visual Language Models (VLMs) offer strong image understanding, their real-world application is underexplored. For effective deployment, open-vocabulary semantic segmentation (OVSS) models, leveraging models like CLIP to assign pixel-level labels from text, must be robust to outdoor conditions, adverse weather, and varying viewpoints. Despite their potential, these models encounter significant challenges in cross-domain generalization, hindering their practical use in embodied AI applications. In this work, we present Pixel2Perspective, a benchmark for multi-angle object localization and open-vocabulary segmentation across both aerial and ground perspectives. This benchmark supports thorough evaluation across different viewpoints and sensor modalities. We assess foundational models like CLIP and advanced OVSS models using a curated dataset that spans varied outdoor conditions, sim-to-real scenarios, and multiple sensors, including infrared, to support the development of robust and generalizable perception systems. We also present a novel framework, Multi-Source RGB-IR Uncertainty Quantification (MSRIQ), which jointly models aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties across RGB and infrared imagery. This approach supports robust evaluation of open-vocabulary segmentation models across diverse environmental conditions. Our work sets a robustness-driven benchmark, providing key insights and laying the foundation for future research in open-world embodied AI perception. The benchmark and project page are available at https://aniruddhsikdar1.github.io/publications/pixel2perspective/

摘要（中文）：具身人工智能系统（如无人机和自动驾驶车辆）通过增强对包含未知物体环境的感知来提升导航能力。尽管视觉语言模型（VLM）具有强大的图像理解能力，但其在现实世界中的应用尚未得到充分探索。为实现有效部署，利用CLIP等模型通过文本分配像素级标签的开放词汇语义分割（OVSS）模型，必须能够稳健应对户外条件、恶劣天气及不同视角的挑战。尽管这些模型潜力巨大，但它们在跨域泛化方面面临显著挑战，阻碍了其在具身人工智能应用中的实际使用。在本研究中，我们提出了Pixel2Perspective，一个用于多角度物体定位和开放词汇分割的综合基准，覆盖空中与地面双视角。该基准支持跨不同视角和传感器模态的全面评估。我们利用一个涵盖多种户外条件、仿真到真实场景以及包括红外在内的多传感器数据集，评估了CLIP等基础模型和先进的OVSS模型，以支持鲁棒且可泛化的感知系统的发展。我们还提出了一种新颖的框架——多源RGB-红外不确定性量化（MSRIQ），该框架联合建模了RGB和红外图像中的偶然不确定性与认知不确定性。该方法支持在多样化环境条件下对开放词汇分割模型进行鲁棒评估。我们的工作建立了一个以鲁棒性为导向的基准，为开放世界具身人工智能感知的未来研究提供了关键见解并奠定了坚实基础。该基准及项目页面可访问：https://aniruddhsikdar1.github.io/publications/pixel2perspective/

Authors: Aditya Gandhamal, Aniruddh Sikdar, Arya Kishor, Suresh Sundaram

Target-Consistent Action Guidance via Semi-Unbalanced Optimal Transport for Drifting World Models WorldModel

action-conditioned world models drifting models semi-unbalanced optimal transport classifier-free guidance robotic manipulation

简要说明：本文提出了质量共享增强（MSA）方法，通过在半松弛最优传输问题中将当前帧视为反事实目的地，消除了漂移动作条件世界模型中的目标偏差，并在Push-T、Robomimic和BridgeV2上改善了动作排序和响应斜率。

TLDR: The paper introduces Mass-Share Accentuation (MSA), a method that removes target bias in drifting action-conditioned world models by treating the current frame as a counterfactual destination in a semi-relaxed optimal transport problem, improving action ranking and response slope on Push-T, Robomimic, and BridgeV2.

Abstract: Action-conditioned world models let robots imagine the outcomes of their actions for planning and offline policy evaluation, but these uses need many rollouts, which multi-step diffusion makes expensive. Drifting models move the iteration from inference to training and generate samples in one network pass. DriftWorld brought this paradigm to action-conditioned world models; to strengthen action following, it repels predictions from the current frame, a construction borrowed from classifier-free guidance. We show that this accentuation has a target bias: the push persists even when a prediction matches the recorded future, in kernel, balanced, and unbalanced Wasserstein drifting fields alike. We introduce Mass-Share Accentuation (MSA) to remove this bias. MSA treats the current frame as a counterfactual destination competing with the recorded future in a semi-relaxed optimal transport problem; subtracting the closed-form share of the correct future makes the guidance vanish at the target, and the remainder is shared by all predictions. We prove that the recorded future is the unique fixed point along the motion direction for collapsed predictions, and that the guidance fades with prediction error. On Push-T, Robomimic, and BridgeV2, where trained models under-react rather than overshoot, MSA improves action ranking, response slope, and moving-region error over latent-space baselines at no inference cost, though these benchmarks do not isolate bias removal as the cause.

摘要（中文）：基于动作条件的世界模型使机器人能够想象其动作的后果，从而用于规划和离线策略评估，但这些用途需要大量 rollout，而多步扩散使得这一过程代价高昂。漂移模型将迭代从推理阶段转移到训练阶段，并能在单次网络前向传播中生成样本。DriftWorld 将这一范式引入基于动作条件的世界模型；为强化动作跟随能力，它使预测远离当前帧，这一构造借鉴自无分类器引导。我们表明，这种强调机制存在目标偏差：即使预测与记录的未来一致，该推动力仍然存在，且这一现象在核、均衡和非均衡 Wasserstein 漂移场中均成立。我们引入质量共享强调（MSA）以消除该偏差。MSA 将当前帧视为一个反事实目的地，在半松弛最优传输问题中与记录的未来竞争；通过减去正确未来的闭式份额，引导在目标处消失，其余部分由所有预测共享。我们证明，对于坍缩预测，记录的未来是运动方向上的唯一不动点，且引导随预测误差增大而衰减。在 Push-T、Robomimic 和 BridgeV2 上，由于训练模型倾向于反应不足而非过度反应，MSA 在动作排序、响应斜率和运动区域误差方面优于潜在空间基线，且不增加推理成本，尽管这些基准并未将偏差消除单独隔离为原因。
