Authors: Md Abtahi Majeed Chowdhury, Md Rifat Ur Rahman, Md Sakib Hossain Shovon, Jaesik Choi, Minhyuk Sung

WM^MLLM: Turning MLLMs into World Models WorldModel

interactive world model multimodal large language models editable world generation panorama state environment recovery

简要说明：本文提出了WM^MLLM，一种基于多模态大语言模型的交互式世界模型，通过将世界状态保持在生成器之外并利用MLLM进行状态操作，实现了从单张图片进行持久、可编辑的世界生成，并在多个基准上达到最优性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces WM^MLLM, an interactive world model built on multimodal large language models that maintains an explicit panorama state with revision history, enabling persistent and precisely editable world generation from a single image, with state-of-the-art performance on environment-recovery and editing benchmarks.

Abstract: Video world models keep the world in the context of a generator, so a revisit is synthesized again and earlier edits can drift or disappear. We present WM^MLLM, the first interactive world model built on multimodal large language models (MLLMs), for persistent, editable world generation from a single image. WM^MLLM keeps the world state outside every generator, as a panorama with a revision history, and lets the MLLMs write it: they turn each request into operations on this state, select where a local edit is written, and check every candidate before it becomes the next state. Image generators only propose views, and video only presents them. Users can walk to new places and return, edit objects through text or a box, place subjects, and change lighting, weather or season. By construction, a revisit at the same revision reproduces the earlier view exactly, a local edit leaves every panorama pixel outside its region unchanged, and each request starts from the result of the previous one. Against six world model baselines on MBench-A, WM^MLLM has the highest mean on all four environment-recovery metrics (Epipolar 91.5 versus 0.1 to 74.0) and completes the most camera round trips (85.3% versus at most 50.9%). It has the best value in all 15 CompBench columns against 15 baselines. On 112 local edits judged blind, selecting the region to write after generation raises completion from 34.8% to 83.0%. On 258 WBench and MBench-A items, all 46 revisits recover their earlier views, and all 97 local edits that pass the check leave panorama pixels outside their region unchanged.

摘要（中文）：视频世界模型将世界保持在生成器的上下文中，因此重访会被重新合成，早期编辑可能发生漂移或消失。我们提出WM^MLLM，这是首个基于多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）构建的交互式世界模型，能够从单张图像实现持久、可编辑的世界生成。WM^MLLM将世界状态保存在每个生成器之外，作为一种带有修订历史的全景图，并让MLLMs负责写入：它们将每个请求转化为对该状态的操作，选择局部编辑写入的位置，并在每个候选状态成为下一个状态之前进行校验。图像生成器仅提出视图，视频仅负责呈现。用户可以走到新地点并返回，通过文本或框选编辑对象，放置主体，以及改变光照、天气或季节。通过设计，在同一修订版本下进行重访可精确复现早先的视图；局部编辑不会改变其区域外的任何全景像素；每个请求都从上一个请求的结果开始。在MBench-A上，与六种世界模型基线相比，WM^MLLM在所有四项环境恢复指标上均获得最高均值（对极几何分数为91.5，基线范围0.1至74.0），并完成了最多的相机往返行程（85.3%，基线最多为50.9%）。在与15个基线的比较中，WM^MLLM在CompBench的全部15个指标列中取得最佳值。在112项盲评局部编辑中，在生成后选择写入区域将完成率从34.8%提升至83.0%。在258项WBench和MBench-A项目中，所有46次重访均成功恢复早先视图，所有97项通过校验的局部编辑均保持其区域外的全景像素不变。

Authors: Baiang Li, Enze Xie, Jincheng Yu, Jin Wang, Haozhe Liu, Yitong Li, Juanxi Tian, Felix Heide

PGU-Decoder: Prior-Guided Unified Decoding for Industrial Road-Network Map Updating AutonomousDriving

unified decoding prior query module relational graph attention network road-network map updating drivable-area detection

简要说明：PGU-Decoder是一个生产级统一解码框架，利用先验查询模块和关系图注意力网络完成三类路网地图更新任务（交叉口内部生成、分合流检测、可行驶区域检测），在规模化部署中实现了高质量和显著的成本降低。

TLDR: PGU-Decoder is a production-grade unified decoding framework that leverages prior query modules and relational graph attention to perform three road-network map updating tasks (intra-intersection generation, merging/diverging detection, and drivable-area detection), achieving high quality and significant cost reductions in large-scale deployment.

Abstract: Timely road-network map updates are essential to navigation and autonomous driving. Three key tasks are intra-intersection road network generation, merging/diverging detection, and drivable-area detection, covering topology, geometry, and attributes, respectively. Separate pipelines duplicate rule maintenance, quality assurance, and manual verification, increasing operational costs. We propose PGU-Decoder, a production-grade unified decoding framework for semantic prediction across these tasks. A Prior Query Module (PQM) constructs point-level prior queries from sampled locations on road-network geometries. Fixed reference points preserve positional priors throughout decoding, allowing the model to focus on surrounding context. Point-level representations are aggregated into instance-level representations, and a Relational Graph Attention Network (RGAT) captures inter-instance dependencies. Task-specific heads then generate predictions. We validate PGU-Decoder in large-scale automated road-network map updating across more than 360 cities in China, where it consistently outperforms seven baselines. Following deployment at AutoNavi Map, it achieves quality scores above 98% on all three tasks, reduces manual verification costs by 95%, and increases update frequency from weekly to hourly. These results demonstrate a practical and cost-effective industrial solution for road-network map updating.

摘要（中文）：及时的道路网络地图更新对于导航和自动驾驶至关重要。三大关键任务分别为交叉口内部路网生成、分合流检测及可行驶区域检测，分别覆盖拓扑、几何与属性信息。独立流水线会导致规则维护、质量保证和人工验证的重复工作，增加运营成本。为此，我们提出PGU-Decoder，一种面向上述任务语义预测的生产级统一解码框架。 Prior Query Module (PQM) 基于路网几何上的采样位置构建点级先验查询。固定参考点在解码过程中保留位置先验，使模型能够专注于周围上下文。点级表征聚合为实例级表征，并通过关系图注意力网络（RGAT）捕捉实例间依赖关系。随后，任务专属头生成预测结果。我们在中国超过360个城市的大规模自动化路网更新任务中验证了PGU-Decoder，其性能一致优于七个基线方法。自部署至高德地图以来，该系统在全部三项任务上的质量评分均超过98%，人工验证成本降低95%，更新频率从每周提升至每小时。上述结果表明，PGU-Decoder为路网更新提供了一种实用且经济高效的工业级解决方案。

Authors: Yuguang Ning, Bingbing Kang, Nan Zhao, Zhixuan Li, Ze Zhao, Dongdong Liu, Wenjian Zhu, Zekai Liu, Junhui Wang

ALIVE: Bring Foundation Features to Life with Events Perception3D

event-based vision foundation model features DINOv3 feature update synthetic training

简要说明：ALIVE提出一种基于事件的方法，在图像帧之间增量更新冻结的DINOv3编码器特征，仅使用合成数据训练，实现在真实事件流上以更低计算成本提升下游感知任务性能。

TLDR: ALIVE proposes an event-based updater that incrementally refreshes features from a frozen DINOv3 encoder between image frames, using only synthetic training data, to improve downstream perception tasks on real-world event streams with lower compute than full re-encoding.

Abstract: Visual foundation models provide powerful representations for diverse tasks, but their features become stale as visual content changes between image observations. Refreshing them requires new frames and repeated runs of a computationally expensive image encoder. We introduce ALIVE, an event-based method that incrementally updates native foundation model features between image observations. Given an anchor image, ALIVE uses subsequent events to transport and correct existing multi-layer features extracted by a frozen DINOv3 encoder. Its lightweight updater is trained end-to-end using only synthetic data, without downstream task supervision, and transfers directly to real-world event streams without any adaptation. Across three real-world datasets and five task-dataset settings spanning object detection, semantic segmentation, and depth estimation, ALIVE outperforms all evaluated event-based methods in every metric. On DSEC, when the anchor frame is 200,ms old, ALIVE improves over anchor-image predictions by 30.9,mAP in detection, 11.6,mIoU in segmentation, and 15.9% in depth AbsRel. Compared with image re-encoding, ALIVE reduces FLOPs by 82.4% and latency by a factor of 2.5.

摘要（中文）：视觉基础模型为多种任务提供了强大的表示能力，但其特征会随着图像观测之间视觉内容的变化而逐渐过时。刷新这些特征需要新的帧，并重复运行计算成本高昂的图像编码器。我们提出了ALIVE，一种基于事件的方法，能够在图像观测之间增量更新原生基础模型特征。给定一幅锚定图像，ALIVE利用后续事件来迁移并修正由冻结的DINOv3编码器提取的多层特征。其轻量级更新器仅使用合成数据以端到端方式训练，无需下游任务监督，并能直接迁移到真实世界的事件流，无需任何适配。在三个真实世界数据集和五个涵盖目标检测、语义分割及深度估计的任务-数据集设置中，ALIVE在所有评估指标上均优于所有被评估的基于事件的方法。在DSEC上，当锚定帧老化200毫秒时，ALIVE相较于锚定图像预测在检测上提升了30.9 mAP，在分割上提升了11.6 mIoU，在深度绝对相对误差上改善了15.9%。与图像重新编码相比，ALIVE将计算量减少了82.4%，延迟降低了2.5倍。

Authors: Rong Zou, Haiqing Hao, Davide Scaramuzza

OmniFish: A Bioinspired, Modular, Reconfigurable Soft Robotic Fish Enabling Multi-Modal Swimming Locomotion

bioinspired soft robotics reconfigurable stiffness swimming modes tendon-driven

简要说明：OmniFish是一种仿生模块化软体机器鱼，通过可重构刚度的肌腱驱动脊柱实现多种BCF游泳模式，并通过实验验证了不同模式的性能和效率。

TLDR: OmniFish is a bioinspired modular soft robotic fish with a stiffness-reconfigurable tendon-driven spine that emulates multiple BCF swimming modes, demonstrated through experiments with distinct performance and efficiency.

Abstract: In this work, we introduce OmniFish, a bioinspired modular soft robotic fish designed to emulate the full spectrum of body and/or caudal fin (BCF) locomotion modes within a single robotic platform. The design combines morphology averaging across representative fish species with a tendon-driven compliant segmented spine whose effective stiffness can be reconfigured through progressive mechanical jamming. By selectively constraining body segments, OmniFish shifts deformation from whole-body undulation to posterior body bending and localized tail oscillation, enabling bioinspired Anguilliform, Subcarangiform, Carangiform, Thunniform, and Ostraciiform swimming using a single tendon-driven actuator. The design was guided by morphometric analysis and evaluated through caudal-fin thrust characterization, numerical body-drag simulations, kinematic analysis, and swimming performance experiments. Kinematic analysis confirmed the intended robot transition from distributed body undulation to localized tail oscillation. Swimming experiments demonstrated distinct mode-dependent performance, with the Ostraciiform configuration achieving the highest straight-line velocity of 8.14 cm/s and the lowest cost of transport of 2.42 at 1.5 tail beats/s. These proof-of-concept results show that a mechanically simple stiffness-reconfigurable architecture can generate distinct BCF swimming modes and provide a versatile strategy for developing multimodal soft robotic fish.

摘要（中文）：在本研究中，我们介绍了OmniFish——一种仿生模块化软体机器鱼，旨在通过单一机器人平台模拟全部身体和/或尾鳍（BCF）运动模式。该设计将代表性鱼类物种的形态特征平均化与肌腱驱动的顺应性分段脊柱相结合，后者可通过渐进式机械锁紧实现有效刚度的重构。通过选择性约束身体段，OmniFish能够将变形从全身波动转变为后体弯曲和局部尾鳍摆动，从而利用单一肌腱驱动执行器实现仿鳗鲡模式、亚鲹科模式、鲹科模式、金枪鱼模式和箱鲀科模式的游动。该设计以形态计量学分析为指导，并通过尾鳍推力表征、数值身体阻力模拟、运动学分析和游动性能实验进行评估。运动学分析证实了机器人按预期从分布式身体波动向局部尾鳍摆动的转变。游动实验展示了显著的模态依赖性性能差异，其中箱鲀科构型在1.5尾拍/秒时实现了最高直线游速8.14 cm/s和最低运输成本2.42。这些概念验证结果表明，机械简单的刚度可重构架构能够产生不同的BCF游动模式，为开发多模态软体机器鱼提供了一种通用策略。

Authors: Mathias Jensen, Saravana Prashanth Murali Babu

Constructive Infinitely Differentiable Guidance Vector Fields for Robotic Control Other

guidance vector fields infinitely differentiable path-following smoothing parameter cascaded controller

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于机器人控制的无限可微构造性引导向量场，该场推广了现有GVF，并在离散化下保持平滑性，提高了路径跟踪精度和计算效率。

TLDR: This paper proposes a novel infinitely differentiable constructive guidance vector field for robotic control, which generalizes existing GVFs and maintains smoothness under discretization, improving path-following accuracy and computation efficiency.

Abstract: Guidance vector fields (GVFs) are a popular framework for tasks such as robotic path-following and multi-robot motion coordination, but existing approaches may be non-differentiable or have large derivatives, limiting their use in controllers that require derivatives of the guidance signal, which is common when the GVF is used as an input in a cascaded controller. This paper proposes an infinitely differentiable constructive GVF. The resulting vector field depends on a smoothing parameter and is a generalization of [1], recovering the original GVF in the limit as this parameter approaches zero. It also admits a simple and efficient implementation that preserves smoothness under discretization and can reduce computation time by using substantially fewer curve samples while maintaining small path-following errors. We establish the main theoretical properties and demonstrate its practical advantages through numerical and real-world experiments.

摘要（中文）：引导向量场（GVFs）是用于机器人路径跟踪和多机器人运动协调等任务的一种常用框架，但现有方法可能存在不可微或具有较大导数的问题，这限制了它们在需要引导信号导数的控制器中的应用，而引导信号通常作为级联控制器的输入。本文提出了一种无限可微的构造性引导向量场。所得向量场依赖于一个平滑参数，并且是文献[1]的推广，在该参数趋近于零时恢复原始GVF。它还提供了一种简单高效的实现方式，在离散化情况下保持平滑性，并通过使用大幅减少的曲线样点来降低计算时间，同时保持较小的路径跟踪误差。我们建立了主要理论性质，并通过数值实验和实际实验展示了其实用优势。

Authors: Vinicius Mariano Goncalves, Peilin Wu, Adriano Rezende, Weijia Yao

CommDreamer: Radio-Geometric World Models for Mapless Cellular-Connected UAV Trajectory Planning WorldModel

world model UAV trajectory planning LiDAR categorical recurrent state-space model SINR

简要说明：CommDreamer提出了一种无地图的无线电-几何世界模型，用于无人机轨迹规划，通过循环状态空间模型融合LiDAR和蜂窝测量，在未知城市环境中实现无碰撞且保持连接的飞行。

TLDR: CommDreamer introduces a mapless radio-geometric world model for UAV trajectory planning, fusing LiDAR and cellular measurements via a recurrent state-space model to enable collision-free, connectivity-aware flight in unseen urban environments.

Abstract: Reliable cellular connectivity and collision-free flight are essential for unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) operations in low-altitude urban canyons, where dense 3D buildings obstruct flight clearance, shadow serving base stations, and create strong co-channel interference at street intersections. Existing planners either require prior 3D city meshes and channel knowledge maps unavailable onboard, or rely on model-free reinforcement learning with low sample efficiency and poor cross-city generalization. We propose CommDreamer, a mapless radio-geometric world model that fuses raw onboard 3D LiDAR scans, multicell cellular reports, and shift-invariant relative kinematics to jointly infer local obstacle clearance and directional signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR) dynamics. Using a categorical recurrent state-space model, CommDreamer compresses multimodal measurement histories into a coordinate-invariant latent belief, enabling the UAV to foresee deep shadow zones and train a lightweight online policy purely via multi-step latent imagination without prior maps or antenna patterns. Zero-shot evaluations across unseen urban morphologies in our open-source ray-tracing simulator, AeroCity-RT, show that CommDreamer converges within 150 episodes where model-free reinforcement learning fails to complete flights, achieving 100.0% mission success with zero collisions while lifting median route SINR to 8.02 dB and cutting effective SINR outage by over 50% relative to radio-blind world-model and reactive LiDAR baselines.

摘要（中文）：可靠的蜂窝连接和无碰撞飞行对于无人机在低空城市峡谷中的作业至关重要，在这种环境中，密集的三维建筑会阻碍飞行净空、遮挡服务基站，并在街道交叉口产生强烈的同信道干扰。现有的规划方法要么需要事先获取机载无法获得的三维城市网格和信道知识地图，要么依赖无模型强化学习，但其样本效率低且跨城市泛化能力差。我们提出了CommDreamer，一种无地图的无线电—几何世界模型，融合原始机载三维LiDAR扫描、多小区蜂窝测量报告以及平移不变相对运动学，联合推断局部障碍物净空和方向性信干噪比动态。利用分类循环状态空间模型，CommDreamer将多模态测量历史压缩为坐标不变的潜在信念，使无人机能够预见深度阴影区，并仅通过多步潜在想象训练轻量级在线策略，无需事先地图或天线方向图。在我们开源的射线追踪仿真器AeroCity-RT中对未见城市形态的零样本评估表明，CommDreamer在150个回合内收敛，而无模型强化学习无法完成飞行任务，实现了100.0%的任务成功率和零碰撞，同时将中位航线信干噪比提升至8.02 dB，并将有效信干噪比中断相对于无线电盲世界模型和反应式LiDAR基线降低超过50%。

Authors: Yuqi Ping, Tianhao Liang, Tingting Zhang

High-Precision Docking of Differential-Drive Mobile Robots Through LiDAR and Vision Collaboration Other

differential-drive robot LiDAR-vision collaboration AprilTag docking control predictive stopping

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于LiDAR与视觉协同的差速驱动机器人高精度对接方法，通过多传感器融合与预测停止实现高精度对接，实际任务中联合接受率达96.4%。

TLDR: This paper presents a LiDAR-vision cooperative docking system for differential-drive mobile robots, achieving high precision via fused sensing and predictive stopping, with 96.4% joint acceptance in real-world tasks.

Abstract: Precise docking requires a differential-drive robot to correct lateral offset through coupled rotation and translation within a short approach distance. We combine global navigation with terminal control using complementary LiDAR and visual observations. A line fitted to the cabinet front gives normal distance and heading. An AprilTag identifies the workstation; intersecting its center ray with the LiDAR plane determines tangential position. Taught observations define the docking reference and can cancel repeatable fixed biases under unchanged mounting and geometry. Lateral pre-alignment and continuous visual servoing coordinate the approach, with predictive stopping to account for low-speed actuation lag. Across two sessions using the same navigation and docking code at five workstations on Robot 2, all 111 tasks completed, including 101 on the first attempt. Relative to the taught observations, onboard longitudinal, lateral and heading residual root-mean-square values were 1.51 mm, 5.93 mm and 0.238 degrees, respectively. Joint acceptance within plus or minus 10 mm per position axis and plus or minus 1 degree heading was 96.4% (107/111), or 95.5% (106/111) with a plus or minus 0.5 degree heading limit.

摘要（中文）：精准对接要求差速驱动机器人在较短的接近距离内，通过旋转与平移的耦合运动修正横向偏差。我们将全局导航与终端控制相结合，利用互补的激光雷达和视觉观测。对柜体前表面拟合直线，可获得法向距离与航向角。AprilTag用于识别工作站；将其中心射线与激光雷达平面相交，确定切向位置。示教观测值定义了对接参考，并在安装与几何条件不变的情况下，可消除可复现的固定偏差。横向预对准与连续视觉伺服协调接近过程，并采用预测性停车以补偿低速执行延迟。在两次实验中，使用相同的导航与对接代码，于机器人2上的五个工作站执行任务，共完成111项任务，其中101项首次尝试即成功。相对于示教观测值，车载纵向、横向及航向残差的均方根值分别为1.51 mm、5.93 mm和0.238°。按每个位置轴±10 mm及航向±1°的联合验收标准，通过率为96.4%（107/111）；若将航向限值收紧至±0.5°，通过率则为95.5%（106/111）。

Authors: Zaide Zhang, Zheyuan Zhang

Assessing Vision-Language Models for Early Prediction of Unsafe Situations in Robotics Other

Vision-Language Models robot failure prediction safety monitoring uncertainty quantification early warning

简要说明：本文实证评估了通用视觉语言模型（Qwen、InternVL、LLaVA-OneVision）在三个机器人案例中早期预测不安全情况的能力，结合视频和里程计数据对安全状态进行分类并量化不确定性。结果表明Qwen整体性能最佳，而InternVL在提前预警方面表现更强，表明VLM可支持机器人安全监控。

TLDR: This paper empirically evaluates general-purpose VLMs (Qwen, InternVL, LLaVA-OneVision) for early prediction of unsafe situations in three robotic case studies, analyzing video and odometry data to classify safety states and quantify uncertainty. Results show Qwen performs best overall, while InternVL offers stronger early-warning capability, suggesting VLMs can support robot-safety monitoring.

Abstract: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) process visual information and textual instructions and, by using their ability to understand and reason about context, are well-suited for predicting robot failures before they occur. However, evidence supporting this remains limited. To address this, we present an empirical evaluation of VLMs for predicting robot failures. In particular, we experiment with Qwen, InternVL, and LLaVA-OneVision across three robotic case studies (HuRoN, Pal Robotics, and CrowdBot), analyzing both video and odometry data for early failure warning (i.e., before an unsafe situation occurs). Specifically, we evaluate their performance in classifying situations as safe, potentially unsafe, and unsafe, together with uncertainty quantified using various metrics, and study the relationship between uncertainty and performance. Our results showed that Qwen provides the strongest overall classification and prediction-reliability performance, while InternVL shows stronger early-warning capability in several configurations. The results further show that the effect of robot-state information and temporal history depends on the model and evaluation objective. Overall, our findings indicate that general-purpose VLMs can support early robot-safety monitoring, but the most suitable configuration depends on whether the priority is accurate assessment of safety-state, reliable confidence and uncertainty, or timely warning before unsafe events.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言模型（VLMs）能够处理视觉信息与文本指令，并凭借其在理解与推理上下文方面的能力，非常适合用于在机器人故障发生之前进行预测。然而，支持这一观点的证据仍十分有限。为弥补这一不足，我们针对VLMs在预测机器人故障方面的表现开展了实证评估。具体而言，我们在三个机器人案例研究（HuRoN、Pal Robotics 和 CrowdBot）中，使用 Qwen、InternVL 和 LLaVA-OneVision 三种模型，对视频与里程计数据进行分析，以实现早期故障预警（即在不安全情况发生之前发出警报）。我们评估了模型将情境分类为安全、潜在不安全与不安全三类时的表现，并利用多种指标量化不确定性，进而研究不确定性与其性能之间的关系。结果表明，Qwen 在整体分类与预测可靠性方面表现最优，而 InternVL 在若干配置下展现出更强的早期预警能力。结果进一步表明，机器人状态信息与时间历史的作用取决于具体模型及评估目标。总体而言，我们的研究发现表明，通用型 VLMs 能够支持机器人安全状态的早期监测，但最适合的配置取决于优先目标究竟是安全状态的准确评估、可靠的置信度与不确定性度量，还是在不安全事件发生之前的及时预警。

Authors: Muhammad Farooq, Aitor Arrieta, Paolo Arcaini, Shaukat Ali, Thomas Peyrucain

BiPathCPG: A Novel Load-Sharing Design Architecture for Compound Planetary Gearboxes Locomotion

Compound planetary gearbox Quasi-direct drive actuator Legged robots Torsional stiffness Load-sharing

简要说明：本文提出一种新型负载共享复合行星齿轮箱架构(BiPathCPG)，通过优化设计提高腿部机器人准直驱执行器的扭转刚度，并降低背隙、质量和宽度，并通过3D打印样机验证。

TLDR: This paper presents a new load-sharing compound planetary gearbox architecture (BiPathCPG) that improves torsional stiffness, reduces backlash, mass, and width for legged-robot QDD actuators, validated with a 3D-printed proof-of-concept.

Abstract: Quasi-Direct Drive (QDD) actuators are widely used in legged robots due to their low reflected inertia, high backdrivability, and high torque density, commonly employing planetary or cycloidal gearboxes. Single-stage planetary gearboxes offer high efficiency but limited torque density; multi-stage designs improve torque density at the cost of efficiency; and cycloidal gearboxes provide high stiffness but suffer from torque ripple. Compound Planetary Gearboxes (CPG) offer a compromise, but conventional designs result in increased actuator width, mass, and reduced torsional stiffness in 3D-printed actuators. This paper proposes the BiPath Compound Planetary Gearbox (BiPathCPG), a novel architecture that introduces an idle second-stage sun gear and load-sharing second-stage planets within the otherwise unused space of a conventional CPG to simultaneously improve stiffness, reduce actuator width, and reduce mass. An optimization framework computes BiPathCPG parameters for a given motor and target gear ratio. The architecture is validated through a 3D-printed proof-of-concept actuator design, benchmarked against a conventional CPG using custom-built test rigs. The BiPathCPG achieves a torsional stiffness of 1394 Nm/rad, a 1.70x improvement over the conventional CPG, with a 32% reduction in backlash, 25 g lower mass, and approximately 6.4 mm reduction in axial width, while achieving a peak stall torque of 36.49 Nm.

摘要（中文）：准直接驱动（QDD）执行器因其低反射惯量、高反向驱动性和高扭矩密度而被广泛应用于腿式机器人中，通常采用行星齿轮箱或摆线齿轮箱。单级行星齿轮箱效率高但扭矩密度有限；多级设计在提升扭矩密度的同时牺牲了效率；摆线齿轮箱刚度高但存在扭矩波动问题。复合行星齿轮箱（CPG）提供了一种折中方案，但传统设计会导致执行器宽度和质量增加，且在3D打印执行器中降低扭转刚度。本文提出了一种新型架构——双路径复合行星齿轮箱（BiPathCPG），该架构在传统CPG原本未利用的空间中引入惰性二级太阳轮和均载二级行星轮，从而同时提升刚度、减小执行器宽度并降低质量。针对给定电机和目标传动比，优化框架计算BiPathCPG参数。通过3D打印的概念验证执行器设计对该架构进行了验证，并使用自制测试台与传统CPG进行了对比测试。BiPathCPG实现了1394 Nm/rad的扭转刚度，较传统CPG提升了1.70倍，回差降低了32%，质量减轻25克，轴向宽度减少约6.4毫米，同时峰值堵转扭矩达到36.49 Nm。

Authors: Deepak Kapa, Aman Singh, Saketh Vegesna, Suryank Joshi, Mayank Goswami, Shishir Kolathaya

Estimation-Aware Reachability Other

Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability belief-space planning safety filters uncertainty robot

简要说明：本文将Hamilton-Jacobi可达性扩展到考虑机器人信念、估计和不确定性，将意外测量视为对手，生成的安全过滤器在模拟中优于确定性等价HJ和不确定性填充基线。

TLDR: This paper extends Hamilton-Jacobi reachability to account for robot belief, estimate, and uncertainty, treating unexpected measurements as an adversary to generate safety filters that outperform certainty-equivalent HJ and uncertainty-padding baselines in simulation.

Abstract: Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability computes the states from which a system can be kept safe under worst-case disturbances, but it assumes the state is known exactly, whereas real robots act on noisy estimates whose uncertainty evolves with their motion. We extend Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability to the robot's belief, estimate and uncertainty, treating unexpected measurements as a bounded adversary and enlarging the unsafe set by the current uncertainty, so that certified states are safe with a prescribed probability. The formulation is compatible with existing solvers. In simulation, the resulting safety filters nearly eliminate the collisions of certaintyequivalent HJ and are less conservative than equally safe uncertainty-padding baselines. The implementation code is available at https://github.com/HimanshuPaudel/Estimation-Aware-Reachability

摘要（中文）：Hamilton-Jacobi可达性分析计算了系统在最坏情况扰动下能够保持安全的状态集合，但该方法假设状态是精确已知的，而实际机器人依赖于带有噪声的估计，其不确定性随运动演化。我们将Hamilton-Jacobi可达性扩展到机器人的信念、估计和不确定性上，将意外测量视为有界对手，并通过当前不确定性扩大不安全集合，从而使被认证的状态以指定概率保持安全。该公式与现有求解器兼容。在仿真中，所生成的安全滤波器几乎消除了确定性等价HJ方法中的碰撞，并且相比同等安全性的不确定性填充基线方法保守性更低。实现代码可在 https://github.com/HimanshuPaudel/Estimation-Aware-Reachability 获取。

Authors: Himanshu Paudel, Javier Borquez

RoboDx: Repair and Diagnosis of Faults in Robot Software Other

robot software repair fault diagnosis navigation simulation language models

简要说明：RoboDx 提出了一个用于模拟机器人导航软件故障诊断与修复的基准，揭示了语言模型在识别所有注入故障（尤其是配置常量）方面的不足，并且当前模型在隐藏原因诊断上表现不佳。

TLDR: RoboDx introduces a benchmark for diagnosing and repairing faults in simulated robot navigation software, revealing that language models often fail to identify all injected faults, especially configuration constants, and that current models perform poorly on hidden-cause diagnosis.

Abstract: A patch to a robot's navigation software can pass every unit test and still drive the robot off its path. Checking how the repaired robot drives catches such patches. It does not show that the agent found everything that was wrong. We introduce RoboDx, a generator of repair tasks for simulated robot navigation software with known injected faults. A hidden verifier marks a repair as verified only if the robot then drives correctly in hidden scenarios, which the agent never sees. A second track hides the code and asks the agent to pick the cause from a list of hypotheses. A task with two faults can contain a quiet fault, a fault that makes no hidden scenario fail unless the other fault is also present. On our set of 100 tasks, RoboDx-Hard-100, almost every repair by Claude Opus 5.5 with standard coding tools is verified. We analyse 94 of the tasks, 44 with one fault and 50 with two. On the 50 two-fault tasks, only 17 of Opus's 49 verified repairs remove both injected edits. Most faults left behind are configuration constants whose correct value the task's documentation does not state. Opus names both faults on 10/50 of these tasks when it cannot see the code. We then give four current models the same measurements of each faulty robot, picked so that, in the simulator, only the true cause produces all of them. The models name the cause on at most 38 of 94 tasks. They are right on almost all when they also get the simulator's output for every hypothesis. Their own predictions of that output give no detectable gain. On 97 tasks from real bug-fix pull requests, Claude Haiku 5.5, the weakest model on the generated tasks, scores lowest, and the other three models are not ordered.

摘要（中文）：摘要：对机器人导航软件的一个补丁可能通过所有单元测试，却仍会导致机器人偏离路径。检查修复后的机器人实际行驶情况可以捕获此类补丁，但并不能证明代理已发现所有问题。我们提出RoboDx，一个为模拟机器人导航软件生成修复任务的系统，其中包含已知注入的故障。一个隐藏的验证器仅在机器人于隐藏场景中正确行驶时（这些场景代理从未见过）才将修复标记为已验证。另一条赛道隐藏代码，要求代理从假设列表中选择故障原因。一个包含两个故障的任务可能包含一个“静默故障”——即除非另一个故障同时存在，否则该故障不会导致任何隐藏场景失败。在我们的100个任务集RoboDx-Hard-100上，使用标准编码工具的Claude Opus 5.5几乎每一次修复都被验证。我们分析了其中94个任务，44个为单故障，50个为双故障。在50个双故障任务中，Opus的49个已验证修复中仅有17个同时移除了两处注入编辑。大多数遗留故障是配置常量，其正确值在任务文档中并未说明。当Opus无法看到代码时，它在10/50个此类任务中能同时指出两个故障。随后，我们为四个当前模型提供了每个故障机器人的相同测量数据，这些数据经过精心挑选，使得在模拟器中只有真正的原因能全部产生这些结果。模型在94个任务中最多在38个上正确指出原因。当它们同时获得每个假设的模拟器输出时，几乎在所有任务上都能答对。而它们自己对输出的预测并未带来可检测的提升。在来自真实修复缺陷拉取请求的97个任务上，Claude Haiku 5.5——在生成任务上表现最弱的模型——得分最低，而其他三个模型之间没有明显排序。

Authors: Soham Dan

Measuring the Conservatism of Latent Safety Filters for World Models WorldModel

latent safety filter conformal calibration world model overlap visual navigation

简要说明：本文提出了一种衡量世界模型中潜在安全滤波器保守性的方法，证明了重叠度量可量化拒绝安全动作的最小比例，并在视觉导航任务中比较了三种滤波器设计。

TLDR: This paper introduces a method to measure the conservatism of latent safety filters in world models, proving that the overlap metric quantifies the minimum safe actions refused, and compares three filter designs in a visual navigation task.

Abstract: A latent safety filter decides from the latent of a world model whether a planned action is safe. Conformal calibration sets the threshold of the filter so that it accepts an unsafe action only with a small probability. However, the filter can still be conservative and refuse many safe actions, depending on the latent. To measure the conservatism that a latent forces on the filter, we group similar latents and actions into cells. A filter that gives one decision per cell can refuse the unsafe transitions of a cell only by refusing the safe ones in it as well. We call the share of safe transitions that lie in such cells the overlap. We prove that the overlap is the minimum share of safe transitions that such a filter has to refuse in order to accept no unsafe transition in the data. Both the overlap and the conformal calibration can be applied to any latent. We use this to compare three existing designs, in which the safety labels train a classifier on top of the world model, the world model itself, or a separate encoder beside it. In a visual navigation task, the separate encoder has the lowest overlap, and at the same conformal level its filter refuses the fewest safe actions and lets the planner reach the most goals of the three.

摘要（中文）：摘要：潜在安全过滤器根据世界模型的潜在表示来判断计划动作是否安全。共形校准为该过滤器设定阈值，使其仅以较小概率接受不安全动作。然而，过滤器仍可能过于保守，并拒绝许多安全动作，具体取决于潜在表示。为衡量潜在表示对过滤器施加的保守程度，我们将相似的潜在表示与动作分组为单元。若过滤器为每个单元给出单一决策，则拒绝某个单元中的不安全转移只能以同时拒绝其中的安全转移为代价。我们将此类单元中安全转移所占比例称为重叠率。我们证明，为使过滤器在数据中不接受任何不安全转移，重叠率是其必须拒绝的安全转移的最小比例。重叠率与共形校准均可应用于任何潜在表示。我们据此比较了三种现有设计，其中安全标签分别用于在世界模型之上训练分类器、训练世界模型本身，或训练与之并列的独立编码器。在视觉导航任务中，独立编码器的重叠率最低，且在相同共形水平下，其过滤器拒绝的安全动作最少，使得规划器在三种设计中达成目标数量最多。

Authors: Johannes Mootz, Mani Amani, Reza Akhavian

Neural Circuit Architectural Priors for Rat Locomotion Other

embodied simulation neural architecture locomotion spinal circuits GPU-accelerated training

简要说明：本文提出Rat v2生物力学大鼠模型和基于脊髓回路的生物神经架构Rat NCAP，通过GPU加速仿真训练，无需模仿学习即可产生真实步态和神经活动。

TLDR: This paper presents Rat v2, a biomechanical rat body and Rat NCAP, a biologically grounded neural architecture based on spinal circuits, trained via GPU-accelerated simulation to produce realistic locomotion gaits and neural activity without imitation learning.

Abstract: Animals generate behavior through continuous interactions between their neural circuits, bodies, and environment. Embodied simulations study these interactions by testing neural circuit models in biologically realistic settings. Recent efforts have simulated diverse animals, and emerging work on biologically grounded neural architectures has begun to integrate circuit connectivity and single-unit dynamics from experimental data into artificial neural networks, introducing stronger inductive biases and closer mechanistic alignment with biology. How can we develop embodied simulations that enable the study of increasingly complex bodies and neural circuits? In this work, we address the challenge through coordinated advances in the simulated body, neural architecture, and training infrastructure. We introduce Rat v2, an efficient and flexible biomechanical body for simulating rat behavior. To control this body, we develop Rat NCAP, a biologically grounded neural architecture for locomotion based on mammalian spinal circuits that incorporates cell-type-specific connectivity and a novel flexor-extensor neuromechanical interface. To optimize circuit parameters, we develop GPU-accelerated simulation and training infrastructure. The model learns to locomote at different speeds and transition between gaits without imitation learning, producing locomotion statistics, kinematics, and cell-type-specific neural activity consistent with experimental data. Analyses reveal that the neuromechanical interface substantially affects trainability and gait quality, and in silico cell-type ablations reproduce known gait phenotypes and predict gait changes under graded perturbations. Together, these findings support the view that embodied simulations at an intermediate level of abstraction can simultaneously reproduce complex behavior and yield mechanistic insights into the neural circuits that generate it.

摘要（中文）：动物通过其神经回路、身体与环境之间的持续交互产生行为。具身模拟通过在生物学真实环境中测试神经回路模型来研究这些交互。近期研究已对多种动物进行了模拟，而新兴的基于生物学的神经架构研究开始将实验数据中的回路连接性和单单元动力学整合到人工神经网络中，引入了更强的归纳偏置，并使机制与生物学更加对齐。我们如何发展能够支持对日益复杂的身体和神经回路进行研究的具身模拟？在本工作中，我们通过在模拟身体、神经架构和训练基础设施方面的协调推进来应对这一挑战。我们引入了Rat v2，一个高效且灵活的生物力学身体模型，用于模拟大鼠行为。为了控制该身体，我们开发了Rat NCAP，一种基于哺乳动物脊髓回路、融合了细胞类型特异性连接性和新型屈肌-伸肌神经力学接口的生物学基础神经架构。为了优化回路参数，我们开发了GPU加速的模拟与训练基础设施。该模型无需模仿学习即可学习以不同速度运动并在步态之间转换，产生的运动统计、运动学特征及细胞类型特异性神经活动均与实验数据一致。分析表明，神经力学接口显著影响可训练性和步态质量，而计算机内的细胞类型消融实验重现了已知的步态表型，并预测了分级扰动下的步态变化。综合来看，这些发现支持以下观点：在中等抽象层次上的具身模拟能够同时再现复杂行为，并为生成该行为的神经回路提供机制性洞见。

Authors: Nikhil X. Bhattasali, Jaron Cui, Lerrel Pinto, Grace W. Lindsay

Feedback-Linearised Trajectory Tracking via Model-Informed Robust Geometric DDPC Manipulation

Data-driven predictive control Feedback linearisation Grassmannian manifold Trajectory tracking Manipulator control

简要说明：本文提出一种基于模型反馈线性化与Grassmann流形鲁棒优化的数据驱动预测控制方法，用于机械臂轨迹跟踪，仿真表明其跟踪性能优于双积分器MPC。

TLDR: This paper presents a data-driven predictive control method for robotic manipulator trajectory tracking that uses model-based feedback linearization and geometric robust optimization over Grassmannian manifolds to handle nonlinear residual dynamics, demonstrating improved tracking over double-integrator MPC in simulations.

Abstract: Data-driven predictive control (DDPC) predicts system responses from recorded trajectories, but nonlinear dynamics can limit the accuracy of fixed linear predictors. This paper studies geometric robust DDPC for trajectory tracking of a fully actuated manipulator using model-based feedback linearisation. A mechanical model maps virtual acceleration commands into joint torques, while recorded data capture residual dynamics arising from imperfect model parameters. The controller minimises worst-case prediction error over an open Grassmannian ball centred at the fitted trajectory subspace. Simulations on a planar 2R manipulator under gravity compare the proposed method with double-integrator model predictive control (MPC) and direct regularised data-enabled predictive control (DeePC). Results show improved tracking over double-integrator MPC despite increased torque effort, while performance relative to DeePC depends on the reference trajectory.

摘要（中文）：数据驱动预测控制（DDPC）根据记录轨迹预测系统响应，但非线性动力学可能限制固定线性预测器的精度。本文研究基于模型反馈线性化的全驱动机械臂轨迹跟踪几何鲁棒DDPC方法。机械模型将虚拟加速度指令映射为关节力矩，而记录数据捕获因模型参数不完善而产生的残余动态。控制器在拟合轨迹子空间为中心的开格拉斯曼流形球上最小化最坏情况预测误差。在重力作用下的平面2R机械臂仿真中，将所提方法与双积分器模型预测控制（MPC）和直接正则化数据使能预测控制（DeePC）进行比较。结果表明，尽管力矩消耗增加，所提方法相较于双积分器MPC在跟踪性能上有所提升，而与DeePC相比的性能则取决于参考轨迹。

Authors: Pranav Gupta, Deepan Muthirayan, Ravi Banavar

WoRD: Diffusion-Based Posterior Inference for Online Goal Recognition Other

goal recognition diffusion trajectory prior posterior inference Bayesian

简要说明：WoRD利用学习的轨迹先验和扩散模型，从部分观测中推断智能体的目标，并在模拟机器人、行人和车辆场景中生成校准的后验目标信念。

TLDR: WoRD uses a learned trajectory prior with diffusion to infer an agent's goal from partial observations, producing calibrated posterior beliefs over goals in simulated robot, pedestrian, and vehicle settings.

Abstract: Goal recognition is the task of inferring an agent's intended goal from its observed behavior. Most existing work focuses on high-level symbolic recognition, abstracting away the continuous motion through which agents reach their goal. Methods that do reason over continuous trajectories rely on an explicit dynamics model that is hard to acquire and rarely transfers across settings. Neither approach explicitly learns how agents move toward each candidate goal, limiting accuracy on ambiguous trajectory prefixes where such knowledge is most needed. We present WoRD (Waypoint Recognition with Diffusion), which uses a learned trajectory prior to infer the agent's goal from partial observations. At each step, WoRD runs one warm-started denoising chain per candidate goal, steers each chain toward the observed trajectory through a closed-form log-likelihood gradient, and reweights the resulting samples by Bayes' rule into a calibrated posterior over goals. We evaluate WoRD on simulated robot settings, pedestrian trajectories, and vehicle trajectories using four metrics targeting distinct failure modes. Across all three settings, the same inference procedure preserves calibrated multimodal beliefs through ambiguous prefixes where filter- and classifier-based observers collapse to a single mode or grow overconfident.

摘要（中文）：目标识别是一项从智能体已观测行为中推断其预期目标的任务。现有研究大多聚焦于高层级的符号识别，忽略了智能体达成目标所依赖的连续运动过程。那些确实对连续轨迹进行推理的方法，则依赖于难以获取且难以在不同场景间迁移的显式动力学模型。这两种方法均未显式学习智能体如何朝每个候选目标运动，从而在轨迹前缀存在歧义时限制了识别精度——而恰恰在这些场景下，此类知识最为关键。 我们提出WoRD（基于扩散的航点识别），该方法利用学习得到的轨迹先验，从部分观测中推断智能体的目标。每一步中，WoRD针对每个候选目标运行一条热启动去噪链，通过闭式对数似然梯度将每条链引导至观测轨迹，并通过贝叶斯规则将所得样本重加权，形成校准的目标后验分布。我们在仿真机器人场景、行人轨迹和车辆轨迹上，使用四种针对不同失效模式的指标对WoRD进行评估。在上述三种场景中，相同的推理流程均能在歧义前缀阶段保持校准的多模态信念，而基于滤波器和基于分类器的观测方法在此类阶段会坍缩至单一模态或变得过度自信。

Authors: Almog Anschel, Sarah Keren

Capability Composition in Heterogeneous Teams via Barrier-Guided Diffusion Sampling Other

multi-robot diffusion sampling barrier constraints heterogeneous teams trajectory generation

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于障碍引导的扩散采样方法，通过编码物理能力约束并利用个体智能体的演示，在无需合作演示的情况下生成异构多机器人团队的合作轨迹。

TLDR: This paper proposes a barrier-guided diffusion sampling method to generate cooperative team trajectories for heterogeneous multi-robot teams without requiring demonstrations of cooperation, by encoding physical capability constraints and using individual agent demonstrations.

Abstract: The agents in a heterogeneous team can cooperate to accomplish tasks that exceed their individual capabilities. The team trajectories for a cooperative task can be generated by a generative model, provided that the model has been trained on demonstrations of the agents cooperating. Yet, demonstrations of cooperation are costly and may not exist for tasks that the team has never performed. The conditions under which the agents can combine their capabilities, however, are physical properties of the team and are known before any demonstration is collected. We encode the conditions as constraints on the team trajectories, and we enforce the constraints while sampling from generative models trained on demonstrations of each agent alone. We prove that the proposed method can generate every team trajectory that satisfies the constraints, although the demonstrations contain no cooperation. Hence the constraints determine which team trajectories can be generated, and the demonstrations determine how likely each team trajectory is. Numerical results on two cooperative tasks show the effectiveness of the method, which generates cooperative team trajectories that satisfy the constraints and requires no retraining when agents join or leave the team. Finally, we implement the method on a multi-robot testbed.

摘要（中文）：异构团队中的智能体可以通过协作来完成超出其个体能力的任务。针对协作任务的团队轨迹可以由生成模型生成，前提是该模型已基于智能体协作的演示数据完成训练。然而，协作演示数据成本高昂，且对于团队从未执行过的任务，此类数据可能并不存在。然而，智能体能够结合各自能力的条件是团队的物理属性，并且在收集任何演示数据之前便已知晓。我们将这些条件编码为对团队轨迹的约束，并在从基于各智能体单独演示训练得到的生成模型中进行采样时强制执行这些约束。我们证明，尽管演示数据中不包含协作行为，所提方法仍能生成所有满足约束的团队轨迹。因此，约束决定了哪些团队轨迹可以被生成，而演示数据则决定了每条团队轨迹的可能性大小。两个协作任务的数值结果表明了该方法的有效性，其能够生成满足约束的协作团队轨迹，并且在智能体加入或离开团队时无需重新训练。最后，我们在多机器人测试平台上实现了该方法。
